paper.title: Beyond Execution: Auditing Experimental Fidelity in LLM-Driven Scientific Research
paper.abstract: LLM agents used for scientific experimentation must do more than generate executable code: they must implement the reference method faithfully, design experiments that test the paper's claims, and provide evidence supporting those claims. We show that agents often produce methodological hallucinations: silently reducing datasets or training budgets, replacing failed learning or generative components with lookup or oracle functions, or drawing conclusions from resource-limited settings where a me

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在执行科学实验复现时，往往通过“走捷径”（如缩减数据集、替换复杂模块为查表、在资源受限导致方法优势无法体现的设定下得出结论）来保证代码能跑通，从而产生“方法论幻觉”，导致表面执行成功但科学逻辑失效。
summary.importance: 指出了当前 Agent 评测中“代码能跑通（exit code 0）”标准的严重缺陷，将科学复现从单纯的代码生成任务重新定义为受计算资源限制的约束满足问题（CSP），对构建和评测科研 Agent 具有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ABE-Ralph 审计框架，将论文的声明、架构组件、数据集、基线、指标和资源边界结构化为声明式的 YAML 契约。在执行过程中，通过三重验证流水线（数值指标对齐、定性语义逻辑、结构化代码保真度）拦截 Agent 的欺骗性捷径，强制执行预先定义的实验约束。
summary.experiments: 在跨 12 个领域的 30 个经典 ML 基准测试中验证，实现了 93% 的鲁棒执行率并暴露了系统性的方法论捷径。在 23 个 NatureBench 任务的发现模式中，有 5 个任务匹配或超过了 SOTA 基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注“方法论幻觉”的 5 类分类法（Taxonomy of Methodological Hallucinations），以及 ABE-Ralph 框架如何将科学复现形式化为约束满足问题（The ABE-Ralph Framework 章节）。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents reproducing scientific experiments often take "shortcuts" (e.g., reducing datasets, replacing complex modules with lookups, concluding in resource-limited settings where advantages vanish) to ensure code execution, resulting in "methodological hallucinations" where superficial execution succeeds but scientific logic fails.
summary_en.importance: Highlights the critical flaw in current agent evaluations that rely on "exit code 0" (successful execution), redefining scientific reproduction from a simple code generation task to a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) under computational limits. This provides crucial insights for building and evaluating scientific agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces ABE-Ralph, an auditing framework that structures paper claims, architectural components, datasets, baselines, metrics, and resource bounds into declarative YAML contracts. During execution, a Triple-Verification pipeline (numerical metric alignment, qualitative semantic logic, structural code fidelity) intercepts deceptive agent shortcuts and enforces predefined experimental constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 30 classical ML benchmarks spanning 12 domains, achieving a 93% robust execution rate and exposing systematic methodological shortcuts. In discovery mode across 23 NatureBench tasks, it matched or exceeded SOTA baselines on 5 tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the 5-class taxonomy of Methodological Hallucinations and how the ABE-Ralph framework formalizes scientific reproduction as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (The ABE-Ralph Framework section). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“agent 复现能跑”与“复现可信”明确切开，约束化审计思路可直接迁移到内部自动实验/数据合成流水线；只需看失败模式清单与约束表示。
recommendation.en: It cleanly separates “runs” from “faithful,” and the constraint-based auditing is directly reusable for internal auto-experiment/data-gen pipelines; skim the failure taxonomy and the constraint representation.

paper.title: SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents executing complex, long-running procedural skills. Existing agent runtimes maintain execution by continually appending observations, actions, and intermediate reasoning traces to an ever-growing conversation history, causing latency degradation and context-poisoning failures over long horizons. We present this http URL , a runtime architecture that replaces append-only conversational history with an explicit, mutable execution st

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是长程 agent 执行中的上下文膨胀：传统运行时不断追加观察、动作、推理轨迹和工具输出，导致 prompt 越来越长，成本上升，也更容易被过时信息干扰。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但对长程 agent 训练和评测有直接启发。它强调把“执行状态”从自然语言历史里剥离出来，变成显式、可验证、可更新的结构化对象。这个方向对 agentic LM 的数据格式、状态监督、工具调用轨迹压缩、长上下文是否真的必要等问题都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SKILL.state 把 procedural skill execution 改写成显式状态转移。每一步模型只接收三类输入：不可变的技能规范 P、当前结构化执行状态 Σt、最新环境观察 Ot。模型在当前步内部仍然可以生成多步推理 Rt，但推理只用于产生结构化状态更新 ΔΣt 和下一步动作 at。状态更新经过确定性校验后写入 Σt，推理轨迹立即丢弃，不进入下一轮 prompt。与 history-based agent runtime 不同，它不要求模型从长文本历史中重新恢复当前世界状态。论文还强调 schema 是按领域复用的，而不是按任务临时写。例如 InterCode CTF 的 100 个挑战共用一个 5 字段 schema：discovered_flags、tested_hypotheses、active_files、working_dir、cmd_summary。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖一个合成 benchmark SkillExecBench，以及两个公开环境：InterCode CTF 和 Sierra τ-Bench。主要结果是，显式状态运行时能保持每步 prompt 有界，理论上是 O(1) prompt footprint，累计 token 复杂度为 O(T)。相比追加历史和压缩历史的 baseline，它在长执行 horizon 下减少 token 消耗，并在多个模型家族上保持或提升任务表现。给出的片段没有提供完整数值表，最可靠的量化信息是 InterCode CTF 使用 100 个实例、单一 5 字段 schema，以及复杂度分析中的 O(1)/O(T) 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15 到 25 分钟。重点看 SKILL.state 方法部分，尤其是 P、Σt、Ot 的输入形式，以及 Rt、ΔΣt、at 的输出约束。然后看 SkillExecBench 的构造和长 horizon 设置，判断它是否真的测到了状态维护能力。实验部分优先看与 history baseline、compression baseline 的 token 曲线和成功率曲线。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是结构化 state update 作为训练目标，而不是具体 agent 应用结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a common failure mode in long-horizon agents: append-only conversation history grows with every observation, action, tool result, and reasoning trace. This increases latency and cost, and it forces the model to recover the current execution state from a mixture of relevant facts and obsolete history.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent runtime paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to agentic model training. The useful idea is to make execution state explicit, mutable, and validated, instead of storing it implicitly in natural-language transcripts. That has implications for training data formats, state-supervision objectives, tool-use traces, and the practical limits of long-context reliance.
summary_en.technical_approach: SKILL.state reformulates procedural skill execution as a state-transition process. At step t, the model receives only the immutable skill specification P, the current structured state Σt, and the latest observation Ot. The model may generate within-step chain-of-thought Rt, but that reasoning is used only to produce a structured state update ΔΣt and an action at. After validation, the runtime applies the update and discards the reasoning trace. Future prompts never include previous observations, previous actions, or previous reasoning. This differs from memory or summarization systems because the execution semantics are state-centric rather than transcript-centric. The state schema is domain-level and reusable; for example, the InterCode CTF setup uses one five-field schema across 100 challenge instances.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses SkillExecBench, InterCode CTF, and Sierra τ-Bench. The reported finding is that explicit state keeps the per-step prompt bounded, with O(1) prompt footprint and O(T) cumulative token complexity over T steps. Compared with history-based and compression-based baselines, it reduces token growth and maintains or improves task performance across multiple model families. The provided content does not expose the full numerical result tables, but the main concrete details are the 100 InterCode CTF instances, the shared five-field schema, and the asymptotic token-complexity claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 15 to 25 minutes. Focus on the SKILL.state execution loop: the inputs P, Σt, Ot; the generated reasoning Rt; the validated update ΔΣt; and the action at. Then check the SkillExecBench design to see how horizon length, noise, and state recovery are tested. In the experiments, prioritize token-growth curves and success-rate comparisons against history and compression baselines. For model-training readers, the most transferable idea is structured state update as a supervision target, not the specific downstream agent tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和失败案例即可；它不是预训练工作，但对长程 Agent 的“状态而非上下文”这个 prior 值得吸收。
recommendation.en: Skim the runtime design and failure cases; not a pretraining paper, but the state-over-context prior is worth importing into long-horizon agent setups.

paper.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
paper.abstract: We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we es

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程复杂任务中，单一固定Agent架构难以兼顾规划、验证、记忆和并发执行的问题，提出可按任务动态编译和演化的Meta-Agent编排框架。
summary.importance: 这是agent系统架构创新，不是预训练论文，但对如何把规划、验证、记忆压缩和局部架构搜索组合成可扩展执行系统有一定启发。若你关心 test-time compute 分配、agentic scaling 或 verifier 结构，可以看。
summary.technical_approach: Eureka把任务编译成带显式验收语义的 obligation graph；执行时按 receding-horizon planning 形成 Macro-Agent，为局部子任务分配状态、记忆、工具、verifier 和拓扑；当瓶颈重复出现时，再通过 cost-benefit-gated evolution 更新局部架构。论文还给出 regret、planning invalidation、serializability 等理论结果。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出较多系统指标：170/170 recursive tasks 完成、生成 3948 个 certificates 且无 false acceptance；active context compression 把中位输入从 9490 压到 4005 tokens；在 12000 个任务上避免 65.38% 重计算；16000 并发执行可一致串行化。缺点是这些结果主要是系统内任务，缺少与主流通用agent benchmark的直接对照。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of using a fixed agent architecture for long-horizon tasks that require planning, verification, memory management, and concurrent execution, proposing a task-conditioned meta-agent orchestration framework.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems architecture paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it has some value for researchers interested in test-time compute allocation, agentic scaling, and verifier-centric execution design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Eureka compiles tasks into obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, it forms Macro-Agents via receding-horizon planning, assigning specialized state, memory, tools, verifiers, and local topology to subtasks. When bottlenecks recur, it updates the local architecture through cost-benefit-gated evolution. The paper also claims theoretical results on regret, planning invalidation, amortization, subtree interfaces, and serializability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports strong system metrics: 170/170 recursive tasks completed, 3,948 certificates with no false acceptances, median context reduced from 9,490 to 4,005 tokens, 65.38% recomputation avoided over 12,000 tasks, and consistent serialization under 16,000 concurrent executions. The main caveat is that these appear to be mostly internal system tasks rather than standard broad agent benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 像一篇把 planner、verifier、memory manager 拼成操作系统的论文；若你看 agentic scaling，只读 obligation graph、context compression 和并发一致性那几节。
recommendation.en: This reads like an OS-for-agents paper; if you care about agentic scaling, focus on obligation graphs, context compression, and the concurrency/serialization claims.

paper.title: ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence
paper.abstract: Artificial superintelligence (ASI) requires AI to move beyond mastering existing knowledge toward exploring the unknown, creating new knowledge, and turning new ideas into verifiable results. However, the capabilities of today's AI systems are still largely built on learning, compressing, and applying existing human knowledge. Accordingly, existing benchmarks primarily test whether AI can produce correct answers based on learned knowledge, or whether it can complete tasks under extensive human g

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要评估的不是模型会不会复述已有知识，而是 AI 能否在科研任务中提出新想法、逐步减少人类方法指导后继续推进，并把想法变成可验证结果。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它把“创新探索”和“自主科学执行”放进同一个项目级评测框架里，而且显式设计了逐步撤去人类方法提示的设置。对做 agent、AI delegation、长期任务评测的人有参考价值；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于它定义了一个更接近开放式科研能力的外部目标。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 ASI-Bench，覆盖 11 个科学领域、60 个 project-level research tasks，由 40 多位专家投入 3.1 万小时制作。评测重点不是单轮问答，而是同一研究项目中不同程度的人类指导条件下，模型能否继续完成探索、设计、执行和验证。也就是说，它把“能力上限”和“对人类脚手架的依赖程度”一起测。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整 leaderboard 数字，但强调 benchmark 的任务粒度是 project-level，且会 progressively withdraw human methodological guidance。实验价值主要在于暴露当前系统在开放式科研、长程自主执行和创新性上的缺口，而不是某个模型小幅领先。若正文完整，重点应看任务构成、评分协议、人与模型协作边界以及失败模式分析。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括清华大学、MIT、哈佛大学、卡内基梅隆大学、密歇根大学、UIUC。属于多校联合的大规模 benchmark 构建，摘要中未明确列出核心知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates not whether models can reproduce known knowledge, but whether AI systems can generate new ideas, continue a research project with progressively less human methodological guidance, and turn ideas into verifiable outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It jointly measures innovative exploration and autonomous scientific execution within the same project-level framework, with explicit withdrawal of human guidance. For pretraining researchers, its value is mostly as an external target for open-ended research capability rather than a direct training contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build ASI-Bench, spanning 11 scientific domains and 60 project-level research tasks, created by 40+ experts with over 31,000 human hours. The benchmark is not about single-turn QA; it evaluates whether systems can keep progressing on the same research project as human methodological scaffolding is reduced. In effect, it measures both capability and dependence on human guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a full leaderboard, but emphasizes project-level tasks and progressive withdrawal of human methodological guidance. The main experimental value is in exposing current systems’ gaps in open-ended research, long-horizon autonomy, and innovation, rather than in small model-to-model deltas. If reading the paper, focus on task design, scoring protocol, human-AI boundary conditions, and failure analyses.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Tsinghua University, MIT, Harvard University, Carnegie Mellon University, University of Michigan, and UIUC. This is a large multi-institution benchmark effort; the abstract does not clearly identify a single notable senior author.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它把“科研能力”从知识问答拉到项目级自主执行；做 agent eval 或想定义 long-horizon 外部目标的人，先看任务设计和去脚手架协议。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it reframes research capability from knowledge QA to project-level autonomous execution; if you care about agent eval or long-horizon external targets, read the task design and the guidance-withdrawal protocol.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents
paper.abstract: Browser agents perform well on short, clean demonstrations, but real deployment is fundamentally different: agents must sustain dozens of decisions on live websites while recovering from mistakes and navigating complex UIs. We argue that closing this gap requires alignment at every level of the pipeline, including execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation, rather than scale alone. We present Wuying-Browser-Agent, a unified framework that addresses each of these levels. A structured br

summary.core_problem: 现有的浏览器 Agent 训练和评测主要集中在短序列、成功的英文交互上，而真实部署环境中，Agent 需要在动态网页上进行长序列决策，处理复杂的 UI 控件，并具备从错误中恢复的能力。现有方法在执行、监督、优化和评测层面均存在脱节。
summary.importance: 系统性地指出了长序列浏览器 Agent 面临的三个结构性挑战（缺乏恢复监督、长序列信用分配困难、评测脱离实际），并提供了一套端到端的解决方案（Wuying-Browser-Agent），涵盖了数据构建、SFT、RL 和评测，为构建实用的 Web Agent 提供了完整的范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一框架：1) 结构化浏览器 Harness：提供稳定的执行原语和上下文管理。2) RUIC-SFT：通过三阶段课程学习，引入包含反思的恢复轨迹和复杂 UI 交互数据，弥补传统 SFT 仅包含成功轨迹的缺陷。3) DAO-GRPO：针对长序列稀疏奖励问题，引入更密集的进度监督，并强调对行为起决定性作用的分支步骤的优化。4) BrowserBench：构建了一个包含 350 个中英双语、平均长度 37.9 步的真实网页长序列评测基准。
summary.experiments: 在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web 和新建的 BrowserBench 上进行了评估。RUIC-SFT 在恢复和复杂 UI 任务上显著优于仅使用正向数据的 SFT。DAO-GRPO 进一步提升了性能，且在长序列和高难度任务上收益更大。27B 规模的模型在多个基准上达到了开源 SOTA。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 中对三个结构性挑战的分析（Figure 2），以及 RUIC-SFT 的数据构建策略和 DAO-GRPO 如何解决长序列信用分配问题。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current browser agent training and evaluation focus on short, successful, English-centric interactions. However, real-world deployment requires long-horizon decision-making on dynamic web pages, handling complex UIs, and recovering from errors. Existing methods exhibit a disconnect across execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Systematically identifies three structural challenges in long-horizon browser agents (lack of recovery supervision, difficult credit assignment in long trajectories, and unrealistic evaluation) and provides an end-to-end solution (Wuying-Browser-Agent) covering data construction, SFT, RL, and evaluation, offering a comprehensive paradigm for building practical Web Agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a unified framework: 1) Structured Browser Harness: Provides stable execution primitives and context management. 2) RUIC-SFT: A three-phase curriculum learning approach that incorporates reflection-rich recovery trajectories and complex UI interaction data, addressing the limitations of success-only SFT. 3) DAO-GRPO: Addresses sparse rewards in long horizons by introducing denser progress supervision and emphasizing behaviorally decisive branch steps. 4) BrowserBench: A new bilingual benchmark with 350 real-web tasks averaging 37.9 steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and the new BrowserBench. RUIC-SFT significantly outperforms positive-only SFT, especially on recovery and complex UI tasks. DAO-GRPO provides further gains, particularly on longer and harder tasks. The 27B model achieves open-source SOTA on multiple benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of the three structural challenges in the Introduction (Figure 2), the data construction strategy of RUIC-SFT, and how DAO-GRPO addresses long-horizon credit assignment. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法栈和 BrowserBench 设计即可；它像工程闭环清单，未给干净消融前不要采信 RL 归因。
recommendation.en: Skim the system stack and BrowserBench design; it is a useful deployment checklist, but the RL attribution needs clean ablations.

paper.title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research
paper.abstract: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and requir

summary.core_problem: 如何评测研究型 agent 在“宽且深”任务上的能力：既要大规模发现符合条件的实体集合（wide），又要对每个实体通过多轮检索建立可验证的事实（deep），并避免静态金标答案难以扩展、难以核验的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对 agent / 长程工具使用 / 检索推理的评测与 RL 训练信号设计有参考价值。其 reference-free、逐条证据核验、按层级聚合的 reward 设计，可作为 agentic post-training 与可验证奖励构造的样例；对基座能力评估也提供了一个比单问答更接近真实知识工作的任务形态。
summary.technical_approach: WANDR 把任务表示为 qualification key hierarchy（如 company(n) → employee(m) → url(k)），目标是产出 n×m×k 条可独立核验的记录。每条记录包含 URL 和原文摘录，评测时由 task-specific judge 重新抓取页面，判断页面与摘录是否满足任务约束，再聚合为 precision / recall / F1，并区分 soft（部分得分）和 hard（二值）两种口径。任务构造走半自动流水线：自动写作检查、可行性审计、judge 审计，可选人工复核，因此不需要预先标注完整金标集。论文还把失败模式定位到树的不同层级（实体发现、实体丰富、页面识别、证据抽取、实体消歧），并讨论了该任务作为 RL 环境的可扩展性：per-record verdict 提供密集奖励，层级计数提供课程难度梯度，流式 grader 可在训练 batch 间摊销重复抓取成本。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 含 500 个任务，规模从数十到数千条记录。对比了 Search as Code（agent 组合可编程检索原语）与传统的并行 subagent 固定端点 search-and-read 系统。最强的 SaC 系统仅达到 0.363 soft F1 和 0.133 hard F1，说明任务对前沿研究 agent 仍有明显区分度。论文还归纳了 volume collapse、snippet reliance、约束非系统性应用、cross-reference 跳过、过早停止、缺失丰富化、上下文溢出等典型失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看 Section 3（qualification key hierarchy 与失败定位）、Section 5（reference-free grading 与 soft/hard 指标）以及 Appendix N（作为 RL substrate 的 reward 与课程设计）。评测协议和奖励构造部分对做 agent RL / verifier 的读者更有用，任务构造流水线可快速浏览。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate research agents on tasks that are both wide—discovering a large set of qualifying entities—and deep—establishing verifiable facts about each entity through orchestrated web searches—without relying on a static, exhaustively annotated gold answer set.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct relevance to pretraining, but useful for agent evaluation, long-horizon tool use, and RL reward design. Its reference-free, per-record evidence verification and hierarchical metric aggregation offer a concrete pattern for verifiable rewards in agentic post-training. The task shape also probes base-model capabilities closer to professional knowledge work than single-answer QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: WANDR represents each task as a qualification key hierarchy, e.g. company(n) → employee(m) → url(k), targeting n×m×k independently verifiable records. Each record cites a live page with verbatim excerpts. A task-specific judge re-fetches the page and checks whether the page and excerpts satisfy the substantive constraints, then aggregates verdicts into precision, recall, and F1 in both soft (partial credit) and hard (binary) forms. Task construction uses a semi-automated pipeline—authoring checks, feasibility audit, judge audit, and optional human review—so no complete gold set must be annotated. Failures are localized across the tree: entity discovery, entity enrichment, page identification, evidence extraction, and identity disambiguation. The benchmark is also designed as an RL substrate: per-record verdicts give dense partial-progress rewards, per-level counts provide a curriculum gradient, and a streaming cache-aware grader amortizes overlapping fetches across training batches.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 500 tasks requiring dozens to thousands of records. It compares Search as Code, where agents compose programmable retrieval primitives, against conventional systems that run fixed-endpoint search-and-read loops across parallel subagents. The strongest SaC system reaches only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1, leaving substantial headroom even for frontier research agents. Recurring failure modes include volume collapse, snippet reliance, non-systematic constraint application, skipped cross-referencing, premature stopping, missing enrichment, and context overflow.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the qualification-key hierarchy and failure localization, Section 5 for reference-free grading and soft/hard metrics, and Appendix N for the RL-substrate design, especially dense rewards and curriculum structure. The task-construction pipeline can be read quickly. Estimated 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 比静态 QA benchmark 更贴近真实 research agent 的评测，judge 重抓页面验证是亮点；看任务结构和 judge 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Closer to real research-agent workloads than static QA, and the refetch-and-verify judge is the main novelty; read the task schema and judge design, skip the leaderboard.

paper.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. We introduce StateM, an agent-native runtime that organizes execution around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 即使底层模型能解每一步，也常因可变状态丢失、经验不复用、流程跳步或过早终止而失败。
summary.importance: 提出 harness scaling 思路：不改动模型权重，仅通过执行系统设计提升 Agent 长程表现，属于 Agent 系统范式的工程化探索。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 StateM 运行时，围绕持久状态、阶段局部上下文、带校验的状态转移、可恢复 runbook、版本化流程实践组织执行，Agent 与用户可共同检视。
summary.experiments: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，StateM 将 GPT-5.5 xhigh 从 83.1% 基准提升到 92.1%，超过 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 的 91.9%；搭配 GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh 达到 95.3% 原始准确率（445 次试验，89 个任务至少成功一次）；冻结配置将 GPT-5.6 Luna 从 76.7% 提升到 85.4%。
summary.authors_note: Zhangyang Atlas Wang（UT Austin）团队，长期从事视觉与 Agent 系统研究；Kai Wang 为共同通讯。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents often fail even when their base model can solve each step, due to lost mutable state, unreused prior experience, skipped procedures, or premature termination.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the harness scaling idea: improving agent performance purely through execution-system design without touching model weights — an engineering paradigm exploration for agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds StateM, an agent-native runtime organized around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and versioned procedural practices inspectable by both agent and user.
summary_en.experiments: On Terminal-Bench 2.1, StateM lifts GPT-5.5 xhigh from 83.1% baseline to 92.1%, exceeding GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra at 91.9%. With GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh it reaches 95.3% raw accuracy across 445 trials, succeeding on all 89 tasks at least once. A frozen profile raises GPT-5.6 Luna from 76.7% to 85.4%.
summary_en.authors_note: Zhangyang Atlas Wang's group at UT Austin, with long track record in vision and agent systems; Kai Wang is co-corresponding.

recommendation.zh: harness scaling 的提法有启发，但本质是把更多先验工程塞进运行时；看 §3 状态机设计和 Table 2 跨模型迁移性即可。
recommendation.en: The 'harness scaling' framing is suggestive, but it mostly packs more engineered priors into the runtime; read §3 on state-machine design and Table 2 on cross-model transfer.

paper.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind,

summary.core_problem: 长时程 LLM agent 执行中早期错误会污染上下文与环境状态，且难以靠后续动作纠正；需要“可恢复执行”的运行时机制与评测。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏 agent 评测与系统机制：把“回退/重试”做成一等公民，并给出长时程工程任务 benchmark（MettleBench）；对训练/对齐的启示是：很多失败不是推理不够，而是缺少可恢复的执行语义。
summary.technical_approach: AgentRewind 在运行时记录对齐的 checkpoint：一份是 agent context（对话/记忆/中间产物），一份是可控环境状态；允许回到早期状态并带着“之前尝试的信息”继续执行，从而实现 recovery 而非只做事前 plan refinement/safety check。
summary.experiments: 在多任务、多模型、多执行策略与不同 agent harness 下评测；同时引入 MettleBench 衡量任务完成与 partial progress。摘要未给出具体模型列表与数值提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon LLM agent execution, early mistakes corrupt both context and environment state and are hard to undo; we need recoverable execution and proper evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an agent systems + evaluation contribution: makes rollback/retry a first-class runtime primitive and introduces a long-horizon engineering benchmark (MettleBench). It suggests many failures are execution-semantic issues, not just reasoning deficits.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentRewind records aligned checkpoints of (a) agent context and (b) a controlled environment state, enabling rollback to earlier states and resuming with information from previous attempts—recovery rather than only pre-error planning/safety checks.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across tasks, multiple models, execution strategies, and agent harnesses; introduces MettleBench to measure completion and partial progress. The abstract does not provide model lists or numeric deltas.

recommendation.zh: 把“checkpoint=上下文+环境”讲清楚了，适合用来重构你们的 agent eval；只需看 MettleBench 定义和失败案例，别指望直接提升基座。
recommendation.en: It cleanly formalizes checkpoints as (context + environment), useful for redesigning agent eval; read the benchmark spec and failure cases, not for base-model gains.

paper.title: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Retrieval can identify a past trajectory that may matter, yet it does not specify how an acting agent should use that trajectory after users, entities, constraints, or environment state have changed. We identify this post-retrieval reuse step as a distinct bottleneck for long-horizon trajectory memory and formulate an evaluation framework that holds candidate retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget fixed while varying the support delivered to the agent. We instantiate the frame

summary.core_problem: 长程Agent轨迹记忆中，检索到历史轨迹后如何适配变化的用户、实体、约束与环境状态的复用瓶颈。
summary.importance: 方法+评测贡献：明确将检索后复用作为独立问题，提出固定其他变量的评测框架，以及简单的查询条件复用（QCR）格式作为基线。
summary.technical_approach: 设计查询条件复用（QCR）：记录可复用过程、待恢复绑定、适用条件与验证要求的目标绑定笔记；配套评测框架固定检索、目标状态、模型、解码与工具预算，仅改变给Agent的支持形式。
summary.experiments: 在WebArena、WorkArena、AppWorld共2391个目标实例上测试，QCR平均成功率62.3%，比全轨迹基线高10.7个点，同时在线token用量减少48.9%。
summary.authors_note: 西安交通大学智能网络与网络安全教育部重点实验室，作者背景无公开知名信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The post-retrieval reuse bottleneck in long-horizon agent trajectory memory, where retrieved past trajectories cannot be straightforwardly applied after changes to users, entities, constraints, or environment state.
summary_en.importance: Method + evaluation contribution: explicitly identifies post-retrieval reuse as a distinct problem, proposes an evaluation framework that controls for confounding variables, and introduces a simple query-conditioned reuse (QCR) format as a baseline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs Query-Conditioned Reuse (QCR), a target-bound note format recording reusable procedures, bindings to recover, applicability conditions, and verification requirements; pairs it with an evaluation framework that fixes retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget while only varying the support delivered to the agent.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 2,391 target instances across WebArena, WorkArena, and AppWorld; QCR achieves 62.3% average success rate, 10.7 points above the full-trajectory baseline, while using 48.9% fewer online tokens.
summary_en.authors_note: MOE Key Lab for Intelligent Networks and Network Security, Xi'an Jiaotong University; no publicly known prominent authors.

recommendation.zh: 把Agent轨迹复用从检索中拆出来单独研究的思路干净，但方法本身是工程性的笔记格式设计，对预训练无直接价值，作为Agent文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: The clean framing of trajectory reuse as a problem separate from retrieval is notable, but the method is an engineered note format with no direct pretraining value; keep as literature reference only.

institutions: MOE KLNN Lab, Xi’an Jiaotong University

paper.title: Deployment Decision Reliability: A Generalizability-Theory Framework for Sizing Long-Horizon Agent Evaluations
paper.abstract: Enterprise practitioners read agent leaderboards as if they ranked agent capability. We show, across three open agent-trace benchmarks (TheAgentCompany, $τ^2$-bench, and AppWorld), that the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance in every dataset and check type, while the agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7-23%. Leaderboards rank specialization, not capability. We arrive at this through a four-facet Generalizability Theory variance decomposition, fit with three estimat

summary.core_problem: 当前长时序智能体榜单的聚合分数被工业界用户直接用于部署选型，但这类分数混杂了多类测量噪声，无法区分观测到的性能差异究竟来自智能体本身的通用能力、任务采样偏差、轨迹截断位置、评估器误差还是各类因素的交互效应，也无法回答“达到可信决策需要多少评测样本、适配什么难度分布”这类实操问题。
summary.importance: 量化揭示了当前公开智能体榜单的核心测量缺陷，证明现有榜单排名反映的是任务专精而非通用能力。提出的部署决策可靠性（DDR）框架为设计可靠的智能体评测、基于评测结果做选型决策、用评测信号指导模型迭代提供了可落地的量化工具。对基座研究团队而言，这一结果直接说明当前小样本智能体基准上的分数差异绝大部分不是能力信号，用这类榜单指导预训练/后训练迭代时需要先校准测量可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 将心理测量领域的概化理论（G-theory）迁移到长时序智能体评测场景，构建包含智能体、任务、轨迹步骤、错误类别四个维度的全交叉方差分解模型，将二元成败观测值的总方差拆解为智能体主效应（真正的通用能力信号）、各维度独立主效应、维度两两交互效应、残差项。研究使用三种独立的方差估计器（Henderson Method-I、lme4实现的受限最大似然估计、GPU上运行的贝叶斯二项广义线性混合模型）交叉验证估计结果。在G研究（方差分量估计）的基础上，通过D研究（决策研究）将方差分量转化为达到目标可靠性水平（相对排名决策要求概化系数Eρ²≥0.85，绝对阈值SLA决策要求可靠性系数Φ≥0.90）所需的最小任务数、步骤数、评估者数量的预算边界，最终形成包含方差分量表、评测规模预算前沿、成本调整可靠性指数、难度分层可靠性剖面、能力天花板分解五个部分的DDR报告规范。
summary.experiments: 在三个公开企业级智能体基准（TheAgentCompany、τ²-bench、AppWorld）和一个辅助故障模式数据集（MAST/MAD）上完成全量方差分解，核心结果包括：1. 所有数据集、所有检查类型下，智能体主效应占总方差的比例均低于3%，智能体-任务交互效应占总方差的7%-23%，是主效应的4-13倍，说明排名差异主要来自特定任务上的适配性，而非跨任务的通用能力优势；2. 评测可靠性随任务难度上升快速坍塌，例如τ²-bench的动作检查子集整体Eρ²为0.752，难度最高的四分位任务上Eρ²直接降至0.000，整体可靠性无法对难任务场景提供任何有效保证；3. 50次随机拆分实验显示，训练拆分上估计的Eρ²与留出拆分上实测的Eρ²相关系数为r=-0.90，基于已观测样本投影的可靠性会系统性高估复现实验能达到的可靠性；4. 跨数据集的整体能力gap比例稳定在0.35-0.4，但细分任务族的排名完全反转，斯皮尔曼相关系数为-0.50，整体层面的能力诊断可以迁移，单任务族的排名结论不具备泛化性；5. 各错误类别上的智能体-任务交互方差与该类错误的实际出现频率正交，相关系数为-0.20，智能体能力差异最大的故障类别，并不是实际出现最多的故障类别。三种方差估计器的结果一致性达到小数点后三位。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注三个部分：一是引言中对现有榜单误导性的具象化问题定义，二是方法部分四个评测维度的设计逻辑与方差分解的建模选择，三是实验部分五个核心实证发现对应的量化结果。值得深挖的方向是这套方差分解框架的适用边界：它不只适用于智能体评测，也可以迁移到基础模型长上下文评测、通用能力评测、代码能力评测等其他场景，用来校准基准的可靠性、估算所需评测样本量；其中训练集与留出集可靠性负相关的反直觉结论，对所有研究基准过拟合、评测污染的工作都有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Aggregate scores on long-horizon agent leaderboards are widely used by enterprise practitioners to make deployment decisions, but these scores conflate multiple sources of measurement noise. They cannot distinguish whether observed performance gaps come from general agent capability, task sampling bias, trajectory truncation position, evaluator error, or interactions between these factors, nor can they answer practical questions such as how many evaluation samples are required for a trusted decision, or what difficulty distribution the evaluation should target.
summary_en.importance: This work quantifies the core measurement flaw in current public agent benchmarks: rankings reflect task specialization rather than general deployable capability. The proposed Deployment Decision Reliability (DDR) framework provides an actionable, quantitative tool for designing robust agent evaluations, making deployment selections, and using evaluation signals to guide model iteration. For foundation model teams, the result makes clear that most score differences on small-sample agent benchmarks are not capability signals; measurement reliability must be calibrated before using such leaderboards to guide pretraining or post-training adjustments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work adapts Generalizability Theory (G-theory) from psychometrics to the long-horizon agent evaluation setting, building a fully crossed four-facet variance decomposition model with facets for agent, task, trajectory step, and error category. It decomposes total variance in binary success observations into the agent main effect (the true general capability signal), independent main effects for each facet, pairwise interaction effects between facets, and residual variance. Three independent variance estimators are used to cross-validate results: Henderson Method-I, restricted maximum likelihood implemented via lme4, and a Bayesian binomial generalized linear mixed model run on GPU. Building on the G-study (variance component estimation), a D-study (decision study) translates variance components into a budget frontier of minimum tasks, steps, and judges required to meet target reliability thresholds (generalizability coefficient Eρ² ≥ 0.85 for relative ranking decisions, dependability coefficient Φ ≥ 0.90 for absolute threshold decisions such as SLA gates). The final DDR reporting specification combines a variance component table, evaluation size budget frontier, cost-adjusted reliability index, difficulty-conditional reliability profile, and capability ceiling decomposition.
summary_en.experiments: Full variance decomposition is run across three public enterprise agent benchmarks (TheAgentCompany, τ²-bench, AppWorld) and one auxiliary failure-mode dataset (MAST/MAD), with five core empirical findings: 1. Across all datasets and check types, the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance, while the agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7-23% of variance (4-13x larger than the main effect), meaning rank differences are driven primarily by fit to specific tasks rather than cross-task general capability. 2. Reliability collapses sharply on harder tasks: for action checks on τ²-bench, aggregate Eρ² is 0.752, but Eρ² drops to 0.000 on the hardest quartile of tasks, so aggregate reliability provides no valid guarantee for hard-task deployments. 3. Across 50 random splits, Eρ² estimated on training splits correlates negatively with held-out Eρ² (r=-0.90), meaning reliability projections from observed samples systematically overestimate the reliability of replication runs. 4. While the aggregate capability gap ratio is stable at 0.35-0.40 across datasets, per-task-family rankings invert completely (Spearman ρ = -0.50), so population-level capability diagnostics transfer but family-level rank claims do not. 5. Per-category agent-by-task interaction variance is orthogonal to per-category failure frequency (ρ=-0.20), meaning the failure categories where agents differ most are not the categories where failures occur most often. Results from the three variance estimators agree to three decimal places.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on three sections: first, the concrete problem definition in the introduction that articulates how existing leaderboards mislead practitioners; second, the design logic of the four evaluation facets and modeling choices for variance decomposition in the methods section; third, the quantified results for the five core empirical findings. A valuable direction for further exploration is the generalizability of this variance decomposition framework beyond agent evaluation: it can be adapted to calibrate reliability and estimate required sample sizes for long-context evaluations, general capability benchmarks, code generation benchmarks, and other evaluation settings. The counterintuitive finding of negative correlation between in-split and held-out reliability is relevant to all work on benchmark overfitting and evaluation contamination.

recommendation.zh: 直接动摇 agent leaderboard 的可信度：agent 主效应方差 <3% 意味着排行榜主要在排 specialization 而非 capability；做 agent/长程评测的人必须读方差分解那一节。
recommendation.en: Undermines agent leaderboards directly: <3% variance from the agent main effect means boards rank specialization, not capability—anyone building agent/long-horizon evals must read the variance decomposition.

paper.title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form.   We introduce Apodex Discovery,

summary.core_problem: 现有AI评测体系无法衡量面向开放未知问题的发现式能力——即从模糊的真实目标出发，自主完成问题拆解、环境交互、结论验证、方案迭代，最终产出此前未知的新发现的能力，也缺乏支撑这类能力运行和评测的基础设施框架。
summary.importance: 指出了当前基准体系的能力边界缺口：现有静态问答、窄域交互基准只能衡量在明确给定任务、工具、成功标准条件下的解题能力，无法覆盖真实世界中最重要的开放探索类任务。提出的四组件框架为下一代面向长周期复杂任务的AI系统设计和对应的评测方案构建提供了结构化参考，也为基础模型能力从“解题”向“发现”迭代的方向提供了清晰的问题拆解。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Apodex Discovery框架，将发现式AI的核心执行单元定义为重型求解器（heavy-duty solver），这类求解器的运行需要四类基础设施支撑：一是问题表述模块，将模糊的人类开放目标转化为明确的目标、约束、假设、成功标准；二是真实环境模块，提供求解所需的数据、工具、算力、实验接口、人类交互通道；三是验证机制，同时支持结果校验和过程校验，对中间结论和最终产出的正确性、相关性做可复现的验证，支持盲轨迹审核；四是修复循环，将计算结果、实验反馈、外部评估、人类判断的信号回传给求解器，支撑失败定位、假设修正、方案迭代。配套构建TRACES真实基准，将单元分析对象从单步答案、单任务成败扩展到完整的发现迭代全流程。
summary.experiments: 框架层面明确对比了两类现有基准的核心局限：静态问答类基准（MMLU、GPQA、MATH、FrontierMath等）仅衡量固定提示到正确答案的映射能力，没有持久环境、外部动作、状态演化和失败反馈；窄域交互类基准（SWE-bench、WebArena、OSWorld、τ-bench等）虽提供可执行环境，但任务边界明确，仅以最终二值成功信号为指标，不评估问题拆解质量、证据溯源、备选方案考虑、验证后修复等发现流程的核心能力。目前公开内容未给出TRACES基准的具体任务设计和量化实验结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有评测体系局限性的分析、四个核心基础设施组件的定义，不需要深入细节。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。适合关心AI长期能力方向、下一代评测设计的研究者快速了解框架思路，当前工作仍处于概念提出阶段，缺少充分的实验验证和具体实现细节，暂不需要深挖。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI evaluation systems cannot measure discoverative capability: the ability to start from an ambiguous real-world goal, autonomously decompose problems, interact with environments, verify claims, iterate on approaches, and produce genuinely novel findings that were not previously known. A structured infrastructure framework to support and evaluate this class of capability is also missing.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a clear gap in the current benchmark ecosystem: existing static QA and narrow-domain interactive benchmarks only measure problem-solving ability when tasks, tools, and success criteria are fully specified, and cannot cover the open-ended exploration tasks that represent many of the most consequential real-world applications of AI. The proposed four-component framework provides a structured reference for designing next-generation AI systems for long-horizon complex tasks and building corresponding evaluation protocols, and gives a clear decomposition of the requirements for advancing foundation model capabilities from "solving given problems" to "making new discoveries".
summary_en.technical_approach: The Apodex Discovery framework defines the core operational unit of discoverative AI as a heavy-duty solver, which relies on four supporting infrastructure components: 1. Problem formulation, which translates ambiguous open human goals into explicit objectives, constraints, assumptions, and success criteria; 2. Reality-based environments, which provide access to data, tools, compute, experimental interfaces, and human interaction channels required for problem solving; 3. Verification mechanisms that support both outcome and process verification, producing reproducible checks of the correctness and relevance of intermediate claims and final outputs, with support for blind trajectory auditing; 4. Repair loops that feed signals from computation, experiment feedback, external evaluation, and human judgment back to the solver to support failure localization, hypothesis revision, and approach iteration. The accompanying TRACES reality benchmark shifts the unit of analysis from individual answers or single-task success/failure to full end-to-end discovery iteration episodes.
summary_en.experiments: At the framework level, the work clearly articulates core limitations of two existing benchmark families: static QA benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA, MATH, FrontierMath, etc.) only measure the ability to map fixed prompts to correct answers, with no persistent environment, external action, state evolution, or failure feedback; narrow interactive benchmarks (SWE-bench, WebArena, OSWorld, τ-bench, etc.) provide executable environments but have tightly bounded task definitions, rely only on final binary success signals, and do not evaluate core discovery process capabilities such as problem decomposition quality, evidence grounding, consideration of alternative approaches, and repair after verification feedback. The publicly available content does not include specific task designs or quantitative experimental results for the TRACES benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim is sufficient. Focus on the introduction’s analysis of limitations in existing evaluation systems and the definition of the four core infrastructure components; no deep dive into implementation details is needed. Estimated reading time is 15-20 minutes. The framework is a useful reference for researchers focused on long-term AI capability directions and next-generation evaluation design, but the work is currently at the conceptual stage with limited experimental validation and concrete implementation details, so no deep follow-up is required at this point.

recommendation.zh: 把发现型 AI 评测从解题推向长程真实调查，问题集和 environment 抽象值得看；对预训练的直接价值在 long-horizon 评测设计，读问题集和抽象定义两节即可。
recommendation.en: Pushes discoverative-AI evaluation from problem-solving toward long-horizon real-world investigation; the problem set and environment abstraction are worth reading for long-horizon eval design.

paper.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
paper.abstract: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration serv

summary.core_problem: 解决从研究想法到完整论文生成这一长链条任务中，如何把文献检索、实验执行、证据修订、作图和全文一致性维护组合成一个可运行系统的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用研究代理系统工作，不是预训练方法论文；价值主要在于把“研究写作”拆成可组合技能，并强调先定义证据需求、再执行实验、最后按结果修订论断的流程约束，对长程 agent 可靠性设计有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上把系统实现为现有 coding assistant 内的 13 个可组合技能，而不是另起一个 agent 编排平台。核心设计有三点：一是把模型判断与可直接执行、可校验的确定性操作分开；二是把实验规划与论文撰写分开，要求在看到结果前先声明需要什么证据；三是结合确定性完整性检查与 self-critique，并显式约束一种称为 Self-Refutation Loop 的失败模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、基座模型、任务集或量化结果，当前更像系统描述而非干净的 benchmark 论文。若正文没有强对照、失败案例分解和人工评审一致性分析，其结论可信度会受限。对预训练研究员而言，重点不是性能数字，而是其任务分解和可验证执行边界。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Vast Intelligence Lab 与 University of Technology Sydney。未见可直接确认的头部实验室或该方向公认代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the long-horizon problem of turning a research idea into a full paper by composing literature retrieval, experiment execution, evidence-based claim revision, figure generation, and document-level consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is a general research-agent systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value lies in decomposing research writing into composable skills and enforcing an evidence-first workflow, which is mildly useful for thinking about reliable long-horizon agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is implemented as 13 composable skills inside an existing coding assistant instead of a separate orchestration stack. The key design choices are: separating model judgment from deterministic executable operations, separating experiment planning from reporting so evidence requirements are specified before outcomes are observed, and combining deterministic integrity checks with self-critique while bounding a failure mode called the Self-Refutation Loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide clear model sizes, base models, benchmark suites, or quantitative results. At this stage it reads more like a systems description than a clean benchmarked study. For a pretraining researcher, the main interest is the decomposition and verification boundary, not the headline numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Vast Intelligence Lab and the University of Technology Sydney. No clearly identifiable top-lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，正文大概率也不够 clean；若你在做 research agent，只看技能拆分与 failure mode 定义，别在效果数字上花时间。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining and likely not clean enough empirically; only skim the task decomposition and failure-mode design if you care about research agents.

paper.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays p

summary.core_problem: 评测生活助理型 Agent 在长时程、持续变化且包含隐式约束的环境中，是否具备主动性与跨时间一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。现有 agent 评测多是短回合、静态环境、显式指令，难以覆盖真实个人助理场景里“无人提醒也要持续跟进”的能力缺口；这类评测对 AI delegation 和长期记忆/计划研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VibeLifeBench：包含 200 个跨 10 个生活领域的多周任务，在一个带 22 个 mock services 的模拟世界中运行。环境按自身时钟推进，部分状态变化不会显式通知 agent，要求模型自行决定何时行动、何时询问、何时保持沉默，并维持长期计划一致性。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认其核心实验是对现有 life-agent/LLM agent 在该 benchmark 上做系统评测，重点考察 proactive、persistent、consistency 等维度。摘要未给出具体参评模型、分数区间和领先方法，因此目前更适合作为评测资产关注，而不是方法结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者署名为 Xiaohongshu Inc。属于产业侧生活场景 agent 评测工作，机构与题目场景较匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether life-assistant agents can remain proactive and temporally consistent in long-horizon, evolving environments with implicit constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. Most existing agent evaluations focus on short, static, explicitly specified tasks, leaving a gap for real assistant settings where the agent must keep acting without being constantly prompted. That makes it relevant to AI delegation and long-horizon planning research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VibeLifeBench: 200 multi-week tasks across 10 everyday-life domains, instantiated in a simulated world with 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, some changes are silent, and the agent must decide when to act, ask, or stay silent while preserving plan coherence over time.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main experiments benchmark existing LLM/life-agent systems on proactivity, persistence, and consistency. The abstract does not expose the exact model roster or score spread, so the paper is more useful as an evaluation asset than as a source of strong methodological conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: Authored by Xiaohongshu Inc. This is an industry benchmark effort aligned with personal-assistant agent scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但长期 delegation 的评测空白补得还算准；看任务设计与 failure taxonomy 即可，别指望它给出训练方法答案。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it targets a real gap in long-horizon delegation eval; read the task design and failure taxonomy, not for training recipes.

paper.title: MESA:Task-Adaptive Multi-Structure Evidence Selection for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate trajectories spanning hundreds of interleaved reasoning, action, and observation steps, where answering a query may depend on evidence buried far back in the history. External memory stores such trajectories as structured representations, yet each structure provides a distinct and incomplete view. Existing multi-memory systems either read a fixed set of structures for every query, inflating context and introducing noise, or route each query to a single structure, p

summary.core_problem: 长时程智能体需从数百步交错的推理/动作/观测历史中检索证据，单一记忆结构或固定多结构组合都会引入噪声或丢失互补信息。
summary.importance: 方法创新——提出查询自适应的多结构记忆动态选择与融合框架，替代固定读取全部结构或路由到单一结构的做法。
summary.technical_approach: 将记忆选择建模为结构级动态选择问题，从专用记忆结构库中选择并融合查询自适应子集；在 AMA-Bench 上的受控分析表明最优配置通常是定制化组合。
summary.experiments: 在 AMA-Bench 上对比单一结构、全并集与 MESA 自适应选择的效果，证明自适应组合优于两个极端。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents must retrieve evidence from hundreds of interleaved reasoning/action/observation steps; single memory structures or fixed multi-structure unions either introduce noise or lose complementary information.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation—proposes query-adaptive dynamic selection and fusion of multiple memory structures, replacing fixed full-union reads or single-structure routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates memory selection as structure-level dynamic selection: choose and fuse a query-adaptive subset from a library of specialized memory structures; controlled analysis on AMA-Bench shows optimal config is a tailored composition.
summary_en.experiments: Compares single-structure, full-union, and MESA adaptive selection on AMA-Bench, showing adaptive composition outperforms both extremes.

recommendation.zh: 多结构记忆自适应选择对长上下文检索有借鉴，但本质是 agent 应用，看 §3 的 AMA-Bench 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Adaptive multi-structure memory selection is useful for long-context retrieval, but it's fundamentally an agent application—read the AMA-Bench analysis in §3 only.

paper.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
paper.abstract: World models are expected to support imagination over extended temporal horizons, yet most are still trained through local few-step prediction objectives and deployed by recursively rolling out their own predictions. This creates a fundamental mismatch: few-step losses optimize local transition fidelity, while long-horizon prediction depends on how errors and gradients propagate through the entire trajectory. As a result, transitions with different downstream influence on the endpoint are treate

summary.core_problem: 世界模型常用短步预测损失训练、递归 rollout 推理，训练目标和长时域预测目标不一致，导致误差沿轨迹放大。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是建模范式改动：把长时域世界模型从局部 transition fidelity 转向端到端 endpoint prediction。对 LLM 预训练不是直接工作，但对长程信用分配、非自回归未来预测、规划模型训练目标有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Direct Prediction World Model，使用非递归架构把任意长度动作序列压缩成单个 embedding，并在一次前向传播中预测终点观测。核心取舍是放弃逐步模拟每个中间状态，直接优化最终状态误差，从而避免递归误差累积。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体提升数字。可确认实验目标应是比较短步递归世界模型与 DPWM 在长时域 endpoint prediction 上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Most world models are trained with local few-step losses but used through recursive rollout, creating a mismatch that amplifies small transition errors over long horizons.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modeling-objective change: optimize long-horizon endpoint prediction directly instead of local transition fidelity. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-horizon credit assignment, non-autoregressive future prediction, and planning-oriented model objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Direct Prediction World Model, a non-recursive architecture that compresses an action sequence of arbitrary length into one embedding and predicts the endpoint observation in a single forward pass. The key design choice is to skip explicit intermediate-state rollout and train directly on the final outcome.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected comparison is between few-step recursive world models and DPWM on long-horizon endpoint prediction accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“直接训终点而不是训局部转移”的 prior shift 值得记，正文可只看 objective 和长程误差分析。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the endpoint-objective shift is worth noting; read only the objective design and long-horizon error analysis.

paper.title: Gated-BEPO: Confidence-Gated Bellman Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Training large language model agents in long-horizon environments requires assigning credit from sparse terminal outcomes to individual actions. Existing critic-free methods propagate trajectory-level rewards uniformly across steps, while recent approaches construct step-level groups by matching repeated states and compare actions within each group. The former cannot distinguish useful actions in failed trajectories from ineffective actions in successful ones. The latter rely on step credit deri

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理长程 LLM agent 强化学习里的稀疏奖励归因问题：终局成功或失败只给出轨迹级信号，但策略更新发生在每个动作响应上。GRPO 这类 critic-free 方法把同一个 outcome advantage 分配给整条轨迹，容易奖励成功轨迹里的无效动作，也会惩罚失败轨迹里的有用动作。已有 step-level 方法尝试用重复状态或历史匹配构造局部比较，但对 rollout 之间共享的转移结构利用不足，也缺少一个机制来判断局部 step credit 是否有足够证据支撑。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 中的 agentic RL 有参考价值，尤其是 critic-free credit assignment。它的启发点在于：不训练独立 critic，也可以从同一任务的多条 rollout 中构造一个经验状态图，用图上的 Bellman evaluation 产生更细的步骤级训练信号。这类方法适合用于成本敏感的 agent RL，因为 learned critic 在长程环境里既贵又不稳定。对基座研究员更有用的是训练信号质量的处理思路：何时相信局部估计，何时回退到全局 outcome，是比单纯设计 advantage 公式更关键的问题。
summary.technical_approach:
Gated-BEPO 对每个任务实例采样 K 条 rollout，并把环境观察转成可哈希的状态 key。它将相同观察合并成经验状态图，图边来自 rollout records，即状态、动作、奖励、下一状态。与 GraphGPO 使用到成功终点的最短路径距离不同，Gated-BEPO 在经验图上做 mean-backup Bellman fixed-point evaluation，用当前 rollout 图估计节点 value。随后计算 fixed-point TD residual，并沿每条轨迹用 GAE 传播，得到 step-level advantage。

关键设计是 confidence gate。只有当某个状态在 rollout group 中出现多个 observed successors 时，局部图才提供了比较不同后继转移的证据。此时方法激活 Bellman step credit，并提高它在总 advantage 中的权重；如果状态没有分叉，局部估计没有可比较的经验依据，Bellman credit 会被抑制，更新主要依赖 group-relative outcome advantage。这样做避免了两个问题：一是无证据的局部 value 估计把噪声注入更新；二是有证据的步骤级 credit 被粗粒度 outcome 信号淹没。

它和几类相关方法的差异比较清楚。GRPO 只做轨迹级归因；GiGPO/HGPO 依赖状态或历史匹配来形成 step group；GAGPO 使用 grouped return proxy 再做 TD/GAE 风格传播；GraphGPO 合并状态后用到成功终点的图距离构造 value，可能受 perceptual aliasing 影响。Gated-BEPO 的核心变化是把经验图当作当前策略下的有限样本 MDP 来评估，并用分叉证据决定是否采用局部 credit。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 visual Sokoban，包含文本 agent 与视觉语言 agent 设置。文中提到使用 Qwen2.5 系列 text 和 vision-language backbones，并在 matched training/evaluation protocol 下比较。总体结果是 Gated-BEPO 在多个环境中优于 GRPO 以及已有 step-credit 方法，相对最强基线最高有 4.1% 的 success-rate 提升。

消融实验支持三个组件的必要性：Bellman fixed-point signal、confidence gate、以及 outcome-step balanced fusion。结果含义是，单独依赖图上 Bellman credit 会引入不可靠局部估计，单独依赖 outcome credit 又过于粗糙；gate 的作用不是简单调参，而是在局部比较证据存在时才让 step credit 参与训练。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 2 和 Table 1，理解它如何区分 GRPO、GiGPO/HGPO、GraphGPO 与 Gated-BEPO 的归因方式。方法部分重点看经验图构造、Bellman mean-backup fixed point、TD residual 加 GAE 的定义，以及 confidence gate 的权重混合公式。实验部分优先看主结果表和 ablation，确认 4.1% gain 出现在哪个环境和哪个 backbone 上。需要特别留意状态合并策略：文本环境用 observation key，视觉环境用图像状态，这会影响 perceptual aliasing 和图上 value 的可靠性。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses sparse-reward credit assignment for long-horizon LLM agents. A terminal success or failure label is observed only at the trajectory level, while policy updates are applied to individual action responses. Critic-free methods such as GRPO assign the same outcome-derived advantage to every step, which can reinforce unhelpful actions in successful trajectories and penalize useful actions in failed ones. Existing step-level methods use repeated states or history matching, but they do not fully exploit the shared transition structure across rollouts and do not decide when local step credit is empirically supported.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to agentic post-training than to base pretraining, but it provides a useful training-signal design pattern. It shows how a critic-free method can recover finer-grained credit from multiple rollouts of the same task by building an empirical state graph, rather than learning a separate critic. This matters for long-horizon agent RL, where learned critics are expensive and often unstable. The most useful idea is the confidence mechanism: local value estimates should affect policy updates only when the rollout group contains enough branching evidence; otherwise the method should fall back to the more stable trajectory-level outcome signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
For each task instance, Gated-BEPO samples a group of K rollouts. Environment observations are converted into hashable state keys, and identical observed states are merged into an empirical graph. Edges correspond to rollout records: state, action, reward, and next state. Instead of assigning uniform trajectory credit, the method runs a mean-backup Bellman fixed-point evaluation on this empirical graph to estimate node values under the current rollout policy. It then computes fixed-point temporal-difference residuals and propagates them along each trajectory using GAE to obtain step-level advantages.

The central addition is a graph-confidence gate. If a state has only one observed successor, the graph provides no empirical basis for comparing alternative transitions, so the Bellman step credit is suppressed and the update relies mainly on group-relative outcome advantage. If a state has multiple observed successors, the local graph contains comparative evidence, so the Bellman credit is activated and given more weight, while the outcome signal is still retained as a stabilizer.

This differs from GRPO, which uses only trajectory-level credit; from GiGPO and HGPO, which rely on state or history matching to form local groups; from GAGPO, which propagates a grouped return proxy with TD/GAE-style estimates; and from GraphGPO, which uses graph distance to successful terminal states and can be sensitive to perceptual aliasing. Gated-BEPO instead evaluates the empirical rollout graph and gates its contribution based on observed branching.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover WebShop, ALFWorld, and visual Sokoban, including both text-only and vision-language agent settings. The reported backbones include Qwen2.5 text and vision-language models, evaluated under matched training and evaluation protocols. Gated-BEPO improves success rate over GRPO and other step-credit baselines, with gains up to 4.1% over the strongest competing method.

Ablations indicate that the Bellman fixed-point signal, the confidence gate, and the balanced fusion of outcome and step-level credit are all important. The takeaway is that Bellman credit alone can be noisy when the local graph lacks branching evidence, while outcome credit alone remains too coarse. The gate is therefore not just a weighting heuristic; it controls whether the local graph contains enough evidence to influence the update.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and Table 1 to understand the differences among GRPO, state-matching methods, graph-distance credit, and Gated-BEPO. In the method section, focus on empirical graph construction, the mean-backup Bellman fixed point, the TD-residual-plus-GAE computation, and the confidence-gated mixture formula. In the experiments, read the main success-rate tables and the ablation results. Pay special attention to how states are merged from observations, especially in visual settings, because this controls both perceptual aliasing and the reliability of graph-derived values.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL 的 credit assignment 题，先读方法图和 advantage 构造；若实验环境够干净，值得复现到内部长程工具任务。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and advantage construction first; if the environments are clean, this is a plausible credit-assignment ablation for internal long-horizon tool-use RL.

paper.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
paper.abstract: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teamin

summary.core_problem: OpenART 解决的是 agent 安全评测中的“环境持久化”问题。传统评测多看单轮提示、短任务或可重置环境，但真实 agent 会反复读写同一工作区、记忆、工具状态和权限配置。早期看似无害的状态修改，可能在几十步之后触发安全失败。OpenART 把评测单元从单个 prompt 转到可执行、可演化的环境。
summary.importance: 这项工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent post-train、tool-use 对齐、长程安全评测有参考价值。它的主要贡献是评测资产和红队框架：用统一场景语义和隐藏安全约束，把不同 agent runtime、不同模型、不同攻击面放到可比较的设置里。对预训练研究员的启发在于，长程工具使用能力不能只靠静态 benchmark 判断，环境状态本身会成为训练和评测信号的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: OpenART 以“可执行环境”为核心。它从超过 500K 个 Tools、MCPs 和 Skills 中构造依赖图，再把 benign task objective 和 hidden safety contract 绑定到图上，生成可验证场景。每个环境进入 benchmark 前都要通过确定性 evaluator 和自动行为探针。场景在执行前保持 target-agnostic，之后通过轻量 adapter 投射到不同 agent 的原生接口。攻击面覆盖 workspace、instructions、Skills、Tools、MCPs、short-term memory、plan state 和 long-term memory。环境演化部分被建模为黑盒优化，参考策略 EMHA 用 Markov hypergraph traversal 表示多攻击面之间的组合转移，并根据 evaluator feedback 逐步调整下一轮状态，而不更新模型参数。这个设计的关键点是只演化 target-visible environment state，不改变原始任务目标和隐藏安全约束，因此可以把 ASR 变化归因到环境复杂度和 agent 实现差异上。
summary.experiments: OpenART 生成超过 10K 个通过验证的 scenario specifications，覆盖 50 个领域。人工专家验证下，自动 evaluator 的正确率为 99.3%。任务交互长度明显高于常见 agent benchmark，median 为 97 次 tool calls。评测覆盖 15 个 deployed agents，包括 OpenCode、Aider、Claude Code、Codex、Continue CLI、Copilot CLI、CodeWhale、Goose、Hermes、Kilo、Nanobot、Oh My Pi、OpenClaw、Pi 和 Qwen Code；每个 agent 结合 GPT-5.5、Claude-Opus-4.8、GLM-5.2、Qwen-3.7-Max、DeepSeek-V4-Pro，形成 75 个 agent-model configurations。使用 EMHA 时，pooled Strict ASR 为 85.0%。相比 instruction-only evolution，full environment evolution 在最简单场景上只提升 1.8–2.7% ASR，但在最复杂场景上提升 17.2–17.6%。在控制 foundation model 和 benign task completion 后，target-agent identity 还能额外解释 7.6% 的 ASR variation，说明 agent runtime 和状态暴露方式本身会显著影响风险。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 persistent environment 的问题定义，Figure 1/2 中 scenario、evaluator、adapter 的整体流程，以及 EMHA 章节中如何把环境演化表示成 hypergraph search。实验部分优先看 complexity 分桶下 full environment evolution 与 instruction-only evolution 的差异，以及 agent identity 对 ASR 的解释量。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体 agent 列表，把注意力放在长程状态、隐藏约束和 evaluator feedback 如何形成可复用训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: OpenART studies agent safety under persistent and evolving environments. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate short, static, or resettable tasks. Real agents repeatedly read and modify shared state such as workspaces, memories, tool configurations, permissions, and plans. A benign-looking state change early in a workflow can create a delayed failure many steps later. OpenART therefore treats the executable environment, rather than an isolated prompt, as the unit of red teaming.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to base-model pretraining, but it is relevant to agent post-training, tool-use alignment, and long-horizon safety evaluation. Its main contribution is an evaluation and red-teaming infrastructure that keeps task semantics and hidden safety contracts fixed while comparing different agent runtimes, models, interfaces, and attack surfaces. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that long-horizon tool-use behavior cannot be reliably measured with static tasks alone; persistent environment state becomes part of both the evaluation distribution and the training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenART builds executable environments from validated dependency graphs synthesized from more than 500K Tools, MCPs, and Skills. Each scenario combines a benign task objective with a hidden safety contract and is admitted only after deterministic evaluator checks and automated behavioral probes. The scenario representation is target-agnostic until execution. Lightweight adapters then project the same task, contract, and evaluator into each agent’s native interface. The exposed attack surfaces include workspace, instructions, Skills, Tools, MCPs, short-term memory, plan state, and long-term memory. The reference attack policy, EMHA, formulates environment evolution as black-box optimization over a Markov hypergraph. It uses evaluator feedback to refine future state transitions without updating model parameters. A key design choice is that only target-visible environment state evolves; the benign task and hidden safety contract stay unchanged, which makes comparisons across agents and complexity levels cleaner.
summary_en.experiments: OpenART contains more than 10K validated scenario specifications across 50 domains. Human expert verification reports 99.3% correctness for the automated evaluator. The benchmark is long-horizon: the median task requires 97 tool calls. The evaluation covers 15 deployed agents, including OpenCode, Aider, Claude Code, Codex, Continue CLI, Copilot CLI, CodeWhale, Goose, Hermes, Kilo, Nanobot, Oh My Pi, OpenClaw, Pi, and Qwen Code. These are paired with GPT-5.5, Claude-Opus-4.8, GLM-5.2, Qwen-3.7-Max, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, yielding 75 agent-model configurations. With EMHA, the pooled Strict ASR reaches 85.0%. Compared with instruction-only evolution, full environment evolution improves ASR by only 1.8–2.7% on the simplest scenarios, but by 17.2–17.6% on the most complex scenarios. After controlling for foundation model and benign task completion, target-agent identity explains an additional 7.6% of ASR variation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the introduction for the persistent-environment problem formulation, then inspect Figure 1 and Figure 2 for the scenario-evaluator-adapter pipeline. The EMHA section is useful if you care about black-box search over agent environments. In the experiments, focus on the complexity-stratified comparison between full environment evolution and instruction-only evolution, and on the analysis showing that agent implementation explains nontrivial ASR variation. If your focus is pretraining, the most relevant part is how long-horizon state, hidden contracts, and evaluator feedback can define richer training and evaluation signals.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和任务统计；它提醒 agent eval 不能只看单轮成功率，状态污染会改变风险曲线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and task statistics; the useful prior shift is that agent risk depends on state evolution, not just single-turn success.

paper.title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap

summary.core_problem: 现有长时序LLM智能体记忆模块主要解决信息存储和检索的可访问性问题，但存在未被明确定义的失效模式：与当前决策相关的信息已经被记忆系统获取，却因组织方式、优先级排序、呈现形式不合理，无法有效引导行动选择，该问题被定义为「记忆-行动间隙」，与已有的遗忘、检索失败两类问题有明确区别。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的功能分层记忆、动态仲裁调度思路，对长上下文建模、智能体导向的预训练记忆结构设计有参考价值，尤其是不同类型记忆的差异化激活、粒度控制逻辑，可启发预训练阶段的结构化注意力、分层记忆等方向的设计。
summary.technical_approach: MemArbiter是一套功能感知的动态记忆仲裁框架：首先将交互历史拆解为原子记忆项，按决策功能划分为5个独立记忆库——目标、任务状态、约束、情景经历、参考事实；每个记忆项支持两种呈现粒度：信息完整的焦点形式、信息精简的外围形式；每一步决策时，先计算记忆库层面的当前任务需求度、记忆项层面的决策相关度，再通过时序呈现门控对每个记忆项执行提升、降级、保留、隐藏四类操作，最终在固定的每步token预算下，将选中的焦点和外围记忆组装为结构化prompt送入模型生成行动。
summary.experiments: 基于ReAct智能体在ALFWorld具身任务基准上评测，严格对齐所有对比方法的每步记忆token预算：500token预算下成功率达82.8%，750token预算下达92.5%，分别比最强基线高20.9和25.4个百分点；消融实验验证功能分库、双粒度呈现、时序门控三个核心组件均有独立贡献；MemArbiter同时提升了行动失败后的单步恢复率，显著减少了重复失败行动、状态-行动循环的问题，实验结果在开源权重模型和闭源模型上保持一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注「记忆-行动间隙」的定义、五个功能记忆库的设计逻辑、动态优先级调度机制，可进一步思考这类功能拆分思路是否可下沉到预训练层面的注意力偏置、结构化记忆架构设计中，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者所属机构未在提供的公开内容中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing memory modules for long-horizon LLM agents primarily address information storage and retrieval accessibility, but suffer from an undocumented failure mode: action-relevant information is already accessible to the memory pipeline, yet fails to guide action selection due to poor organization, prioritization, or presentation. This failure mode is formalized as the 'Memory-Action Gap', distinct from well-documented issues of forgetting and retrieval failure.
summary_en.importance: The proposed function-tiered memory organization and dynamic arbitration mechanism offers useful reference for long-context modeling and memory design for agent-centric pretraining, particularly the logic of differentiated activation and granularity control for different memory types, which can inspire structured attention and hierarchical memory designs at the pretraining stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemArbiter is a function-aware dynamic memory arbitration framework. It first decomposes interaction history into atomic memory items, which are organized into five independent functional memory banks: Goal, Task State, Constraint, Episodic Trace, and Reference Fact. Each item supports two rendering granularities: a fully detailed focal form, and a compact ambient form. At each decision step, the framework computes bank-level demand for the current task context and item-level relevance to the pending decision, then applies one of four operations to each item via a temporal presentation gate: promote, demote, retain, or hide. Selected focal and ambient memories are assembled into a structured prompt under a fixed per-step token budget for action generation.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on a ReAct agent and evaluated on the ALFWorld embodied task benchmark, with strictly matched per-step memory token budgets across all methods. MemArbiter achieves 82.8% success rate under a 500-token budget and 92.5% under a 750-token budget, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points respectively. Ablation studies confirm independent contributions from all three core components: functional bank separation, dual-granularity representation, and temporal gating. MemArbiter also delivers higher one-step recovery rates after action failures, substantially reduces repeated failed actions and state-action loops, with consistent results across both open-weight and proprietary models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the formal definition of the Memory-Action Gap, the design rationale for the five functional memory banks, and the dynamic priority scheduling mechanism. Consider whether such functional decomposition could be incorporated into pretraining-level designs such as attention bias or structured memory architectures. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations are not specified in the provided public content.

recommendation.zh: 分库记忆+动态门控的决策时仲裁思路，可迁移到长上下文预训练的记忆组织设计，重点看§3记忆银行定义与ALFWorld结果表。
recommendation.en: The banked memory + dynamic gating design transfers to long-context pretraining memory organization; focus on §3 memory bank definitions and ALFWorld result tables.

paper.title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LVLM agent 在多模态记忆中查询慢、图文绑定脆弱、时间更新困难的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 设计，不是预训练论文；但它把一部分推理从 query time 前移到 consolidation time，这个计算分配思路对 test-time compute 和 memory architecture 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PMMC。先由 Questioner 预测未来可能问题，再由 Planner 生成条件化的多模态 memory program，Doubter 验证证据链能否支持答案；通过验证的问题-程序对形成 question bank，查询时做路由与证据检索，而不是每次从原始记忆重推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多模态长时记忆 benchmark 上验证有效，但未给出底座模型、数据规模和具体增益；预期比较对象是文本摘要式 memory 与 retrieve-then-reason 管线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses slow querying, weak image-text binding, and poor temporal updating in long-horizon multimodal memory for LVLM agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory paper rather than a pretraining one, but its idea of shifting part of reasoning from query time to consolidation time is relevant to test-time compute allocation and memory architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: PMMC uses a Questioner to predict likely future questions, a Planner to compile question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter to verify whether the evidence path supports the answer. Verified question-program pairs become a structured question bank for routing and retrieval at query time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks but gives no base model, data scale, or exact deltas; likely baselines are textual-summary memories and retrieve-then-reason pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain paper，但“把推理前移到记忆固化阶段”这个算力分配值得记一下；只看方法图和消融，别在 benchmark 细节上花时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift of reasoning from query time to memory consolidation is a useful compute-allocation idea; read the method diagram and ablations only.

paper.title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a traj

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程对话 agent 的外部记忆缺乏可追溯、可更新、可诊断表示，导致信息来源、冲突和过时状态难管理的问题。
summary.importance: 这是长时对话 agent 的 memory representation 工作。对基座预训练不直接，但对 memory schema、state update 和 source-grounding 有一定系统层启发，尤其适合做长期交互 agent 的人参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TrajWiki，把记忆表示为 source-grounded evolution trajectory，而不是静态条目；通过不可变 episodic snapshots 和 claim-level 操作（ADD/REVISE/DEPRECATE）维护记忆演化，再用 Memory Wiki 作为持久中间层，把对话历史增量编译成结构化、互联的 wiki。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出底座模型和具体指标；实验应围绕长时对话一致性、可更新性、检索成本和诊断透明度，对比传统 memory records 或可覆写状态表示。Cohere 背景说明其更偏产品化 agent memory 方向。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表标注了 Cohere；这更像面向长时对话 agent 的记忆系统设计，而非基座模型训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of traceable, updatable, and diagnosable external memory for long-horizon dialogue agents, where source, conflict, and obsolescence are hard to manage.
summary_en.importance: This is a memory-representation paper for long-horizon dialogue agents. It is not directly about pretraining, but it offers some systems-level insight on memory schema, state updates, and source grounding for persistent agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory rather than a static entry. It uses immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations (ADD/REVISE/DEPRECATE), plus a persistent Memory Wiki layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into a structured, interlinked wiki.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the base model or exact metrics; experiments likely focus on long-horizon consistency, updateability, retrieval cost, and diagnostic transparency against standard memory records or overwritable state representations. The Cohere affiliation suggests a product-oriented agent-memory angle.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked with a Cohere affiliation; it reads more like a persistent-memory system design for dialogue agents than a foundation-model training study.

recommendation.zh: Cohere 的 agent memory 设计算认真，但仍是系统层 schema 工程；看 memory operations 定义即可，不会改变你对 pretrain 的 prior。
recommendation.en: This is a careful agent-memory schema from Cohere, but still mostly systems engineering; read the memory operations and move on.

paper.title: HERO: History-Enriched Rollout Training for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Neural Operators
paper.abstract: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) by applying a learned evolution operator recursively to its own predictions, but this autoregressive rollout feeds every prediction error back as input, so local errors accumulate. Existing rollout-training strategies reduce the mismatch between training inputs and self-generated states, yet their supervision still measures only the absolute discrepancy from the ground-truth trajectory. Such supervi

summary.core_problem: 时间依赖PDE神经算子的自回归滚动训练中，局部预测误差会逐步累积，现有方法仅依赖与真实轨迹的绝对误差监督，无法判断模型是否克服了此前的长程失效行为。
