It treats training budget as a turn-level resource rather than a flat token-level quantity. That is a useful lens for RL pretraining, agentic mid-training, continual tool-use training, and any setting where the model generates its own multi-step training distribution. The reported gains are practical: comparable or better accuracy with up to 2.29x lower wall-clock time, plus a clear diagnosis of where supervision is lost along the trajectory.
summary_en.technical_approach: TurnOPD has two controllers. The first is an adaptive rollout-depth controller. Instead of always rolling out to the maximum horizon, it periodically probes turn-level statistics and selects a current rollout depth using survivor-weighted KL and a coverage threshold. The motivation is that late turns may have little reliable supervision because few trajectories survive to them, while blindly truncating rollouts would remove rare but important deep decisions. The controller therefore balances effective KL quality with a coverage-side lower bound; the figure summarizes this as choosing H=max(Heff, Hcov). The second component is a progressive turn-normalized loss controller. Standard token-normalized KL overweights early turns. Pure turn normalization can overcorrect by assigning too much weight to sparse, noisy late-turn samples. TurnOPD uses a linear mixture, Lmix=(1-a)Ltoken+aLround, and increases a over training. Early training keeps the stable token-level signal; later training shifts more weight toward deeper turns once shallow interaction behavior has been learned. The method differs from vanilla OPD by jointly controlling how far to collect trajectories and how to allocate KL loss across turns.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic numbers are important. On ALFWorld, the deepest third of turns receives only 3.6–4.5% of total KL loss under standard OPD. On Multi-Hop Search, the corresponding share is 11–13%. This supports the claim that token-level KL aggregation systematically starves deep decisions. The evaluation covers ALFWorld for embodied planning, WebShop for web navigation, and Multi-Hop Search over PopQA, NQ, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA. TurnOPD improves minimal-time Avg@4 across the tested tasks and models. On ALFWorld-1.7B, Same-Step Avg@4 rises from 83.0 to 86.3, while 100-step wall time drops from 4.42 hours to 1.93 hours, giving a 2.29x speedup. On WebShop, both accuracy and time improve, with wall time reduced from 1.57 hours to 1.24 hours. The ablations separate the two effects: adaptive depth is the main efficiency lever and nearly halves wall time on ALFWorld-1.7B, while linear KL blending improves Same-Step Avg@4 by reallocating supervision to deeper turns. Coverage-floor studies show that the rollout horizon can be tuned smoothly between conservative and aggressive settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in detail; 60–90 minutes is a reasonable budget. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the two mismatches: external mismatch from fixed rollout depth, and internal mismatch from token-level loss allocation. In the method section, focus on the probe procedure, survivor-weighted KL, the coverage lower bound, and the rule used to pick rollout depth. For the loss controller, check the exact definitions of Ltoken, Lround, and the schedule for a; the key design choice is avoiding strict turn normalization at the beginning of training. In the experiments, inspect the time–accuracy curves, the deepest-third KL-loss analysis, module ablations, and the coverage-floor study. A useful follow-up question is whether low KL at late turns means real teacher-student agreement or degraded supervision under self-generated context; that distinction will matter when applying the controller to stronger teachers, larger students, or mixed KL-plus-RL training.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 loss budgeting 细节；turn 级 KL 分配是干净的训练信号问题，可迁移到长程 RLVR 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the loss-budgeting details; turn-level KL allocation is a clean supervision-quality idea worth testing in long-horizon RLVR ablations.

paper.title: EdgeBench: Unveiling Scaling Laws of Learning from Real-World Environments
paper.abstract: Pretraining scaling laws reveal that model capability improves predictably with data and compute. But learning from real world environments after deployment remains far less understood. Analyzing roughly 38,000 hours of agent interaction with the environment across 134 real world tasks, we find, to the best of our knowledge, the first evidence that overall performance during environment learning follows a log-sigmoid scaling law with remarkably high precision, reaching R^2 = 0.998. Across model

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题不是“agent 能不能做长任务”，而是“agent 在真实环境中通过交互学习时，整体性能是否也像预训练 scaling law 那样 obey 某种稳定函数形式”。作者认为，部署后的环境学习能力会越来越重要，因为很多知识不在静态训练语料里，而在工具、私有数据、反馈循环和持续变化的现实环境里。现有 benchmark 大多任务短、反馈弱，测到的是一次性解题能力，不足以测学习动态。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为核心贡献是 agent benchmark 和 environment-learning scaling law，而不是预训练方法本身。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它把“训练后继续从环境中学习”量化成可拟合的曲线，并给出一个 log-sigmoid 形式，这对理解 pretrain 之后的能力增长边界、以及 continual adaptation 的收益递减很有参考价值。第二，它强调长时程表现不只取决于底模静态能力，还取决于经验积累、上下文保留和反馈利用方式。这些观察会反过来影响对长上下文、记忆机制、在线更新、以及 post-train 数据闭环的研究。量级上，这更像一个评测基础设施和经验规律发现，而不是能直接迁移到预训练 recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法主体是构建 EdgeBench，并在其上拟合环境学习曲线。

Benchmark 设计上，作者刻意避开短平快任务，转而收集 134 个真实工作流风格的长时程任务，覆盖六类能力，包括科研与机器学习、系统与软件工程、组合优化、形式数学、专业知识工作、交互式游戏等。每个任务都运行在可执行 workspace 中，既允许 agent 本地快速试错，也提供较慢但更权威的 judge feedback，接近现实中的“本地调试 + 外部评审/提交反馈”结构。任务允许至少 12 小时连续运行，部分分析扩展到 72 小时。作者还记录专家完成这些任务所需时间，平均 57.2 小时，最高 320 小时，用来说明任务并非被当前模型轻易饱和。

分析上，作者把 agent 在环境中的累计交互时间作为自变量，把 benchmark 平均表现作为因变量，发现曲线可被 log-sigmoid 高精度拟合，R^2=0.998。除了经验拟合，他们还给出一个理论解释：把环境学习看成 latent task graph 上的 frontier expansion 过程，agent 随着探索逐步扩展可达前沿，平均进展自然呈现先慢、后快、再饱和的 S 形，但横轴取对数时间后更稳定。这个理论部分的价值不在严格证明，而在给出一个可解释的生成机制，说明为什么不是简单的 power law 或纯对数律。

作者还比较不同代际 frontier agents 的学习速度，声称自 2025 年 9 月以来，学习速度大约每三个月翻倍。另一个重要实验设计是把“连续经验积累”与“独立重启多次尝试”区分开来，说明长时程收益并不只是更多 sample budget，而是 agent 是否能把过去失败转成后续有效策略。这个点对任何研究在线学习或 test-time adaptation 的人都比 benchmark 分数本身更重要。
summary.experiments:
最核心的结果有四组。第一，约 3.8 万小时、134 个任务上的总体性能随环境交互时间呈现稳定的 log-sigmoid 曲线，拟合精度 R^2=0.998；作者还报告这一形式在不同任务家族、不同更长 horizon、以及用早期轨迹预测后期表现时都保持稳定。第二，长时程运行确实带来持续收益，分析延伸到 72 小时，说明这不是前几小时的短暂提升。第三，不同模型代际之间，环境学习速度提升很快，作者给出的经验结论是大约每三个月翻倍。第四，学习动态本身决定长期表现：连续运行优于独立重启，长上下文有助于保留经验，案例分析显示 judge/local feedback 能把大量无效试探沉淀成少数稳定改进。

从预训练研究者视角，最值得看的不是绝对分数，而是这些对照：continuous experience vs restart、不同上下文长度、早期轨迹对后期成绩的可预测性。如果这些结果稳，说明“会不会积累经验”已经是独立于静态底模能力的一条能力轴。

需要保留一点谨慎。EdgeBench 的任务构成、judge 设计、agent scaffold 都会影响曲线形状；R^2 很高说明拟合好，不等于机制已被完全识别。另一个潜在问题是，不同任务的归一化和平均方式可能会让总体曲线比单任务曲线更平滑。因此读实验时要同时看 aggregate fit 和 family-level / task-level dispersion。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看引言和 benchmark 设计，判断 EdgeBench 是否真的测“从环境学习”，还是只是更长的 agent execution。重点看任务是否有多级反馈、是否允许持续试错、以及 judge 与本地环境如何分离。

然后直接看 scaling law 主图和拟合公式，确认作者比较过哪些候选函数，log-sigmoid 为什么优于 power law、纯 log 或指数饱和。若理论部分篇幅不长，建议顺带看 latent task graph / frontier expansion 的推导，因为这部分决定这篇工作是不是只有经验曲线，还是有一点机制解释。

实验部分优先看四块：1）全 benchmark 与各 task family 的拟合；2）12h 到 72h 的 horizon 外推；3）continuous learning vs restart；4）context length 和经验保留。预计 30 分钟能完成有效泛读。若只关心对基座研究的启发，可以把具体任务细节略过，集中看学习动态分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a different question from standard agent benchmarks: when an agent learns from interaction in real-world environments after deployment, does its performance follow a stable scaling law analogous to pretraining scaling laws? The authors argue that this matters because many useful capabilities are not fully contained in static training corpora. They live in tools, private data, iterative feedback, and changing environments. Existing benchmarks are usually too short and too weak in feedback to measure actual learning dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core pretraining research is limited, since the main contribution is an agent benchmark plus an empirical law for environment learning, not a pretraining method. Still, it has two useful implications. First, it treats post-deployment learning as a measurable scaling process and proposes a log-sigmoid law, which is relevant for thinking about continual adaptation and diminishing returns beyond pretraining. Second, it shows that long-horizon performance depends not only on the base model’s static competence but also on experience accumulation, context retention, and feedback usage. That feeds back into research on long context, memory, online updating, and the pretrain-to-posttrain data loop. This is best read as evaluation infrastructure plus an empirical regularity, not as a recipe paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main components: building EdgeBench and fitting environment-learning curves on top of it.

On the benchmark side, the authors deliberately avoid short tasks and instead curate 134 realistic, workflow-like tasks across six capability families, including scientific research and ML, systems and software engineering, combinatorial optimization, formal mathematics, professional knowledge work, and interactive games. Each task runs inside an executable workspace that supports both fast local exploration and slower, more authoritative judge feedback, resembling real workflows where local iteration and external evaluation coexist. Tasks allow at least 12 hours of continuous agent interaction, with some analyses extended to 72 hours. The paper also reports human expert effort, averaging 57.2 hours and reaching 320 hours, to argue that the tasks are not trivially saturable.

On the analysis side, the independent variable is cumulative environment interaction time, and the dependent variable is benchmark-level performance. The central empirical finding is that average performance is fit extremely well by a log-sigmoid curve, with R^2 = 0.998. The authors also propose a theoretical explanation: environment learning is modeled as frontier expansion on latent task graphs. As the agent explores, it gradually expands the reachable frontier of useful states or strategies, producing slow-then-fast-then-saturating progress. On a log-time axis, this yields a stable sigmoid-like form. The value of this theory is not formal rigor so much as a plausible mechanism for why the law is not a simple power law or pure logarithmic trend.

The paper also compares frontier agents across release generations and claims that learning speed has roughly doubled every three months since September 2025. Another important design choice is the comparison between continuous experience accumulation and independent restarts. This separates true learning from mere repeated sampling, and that distinction is more important than the benchmark score itself for anyone interested in online adaptation or test-time learning.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four main result blocks. First, across roughly 38,000 hours of interaction and 134 tasks, overall performance follows a highly stable log-sigmoid curve as a function of environment interaction time, with R^2 = 0.998. The paper further claims that this functional form holds across task families, under longer horizons, and when forecasting later performance from early trajectories. Second, gains continue over long horizons, with analyses extending to 72 hours, so the effect is not just an early transient. Third, learning speed appears to improve rapidly across model generations, with the headline empirical trend being a doubling roughly every three months. Fourth, learning dynamics matter in their own right: continuous runs outperform independent restarts, longer context helps retain experience, and case studies show how local and judge feedback can convert many failed probes into a few durable improvements.

From a pretraining researcher’s perspective, the most informative comparisons are not the absolute scores but the controls: continuous experience versus restart, different context lengths, and the predictability of late performance from early trajectories. If those findings are robust, then “ability to accumulate experience” is becoming a distinct capability axis beyond static pretrained competence.

A note of caution is warranted. The exact curve shape can depend on task composition, normalization, judge design, and the agent scaffold. A very high R^2 means the fit is clean, not that the mechanism is uniquely identified. Also, benchmark-level averaging can smooth away substantial task-level variation. When reading the experiments, it is worth checking both the aggregate fit and the dispersion across families or individual tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the benchmark design. The key question is whether EdgeBench really measures learning from environment feedback, rather than just longer execution. Look for multi-level feedback, support for iterative trial-and-error, and the separation between local workspace and judge environment.

Then go straight to the main scaling-law figure and the fitted functional form. Check what alternative functions were compared and why log-sigmoid is preferred over power-law, pure log, or standard saturation curves. If the theory section is concise, it is worth reading the latent task graph and frontier expansion argument, because that determines whether the paper offers more than an empirical fit.

In the experiments, prioritize four parts: benchmark-wide and family-level fits, horizon extension from 12 to 72 hours, continuous learning versus restart, and context-length effects on experience retention. A useful skim should take about 30 minutes. If your interest is mainly in implications for foundation-model research, you can skip many task-specific details and focus on the learning-dynamics analyses.

recommendation.zh: 新交互场景下的scaling测量，注意log-sigmoid形状很大程度来自任务性能天花板，重点看跨代学习速度趋势即可。
recommendation.en: Scaling measurement in a novel real-world agent regime; the log-sigmoid shape is largely driven by task performance ceilings, focus on the cross-generation learning rate trend.

paper.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agentic LLMs are increasingly limited by finite context windows, as extended interaction trajectories can exceed the maximum context length before a task is completed. Context compaction offers a natural solution by summarizing previous interaction states and continuing the rollout under a compressed context, but incorporating compaction into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. We propose CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning strategy to train long-horizon agentic LLMs wi

summary.core_problem: CompactionRL 解决的是长程 agent RL 中的上下文瓶颈：交互轨迹会超过固定 context window，但简单扩大上下文代价高，推理时做摘要又没有被训练目标约束。核心问题是，如何在固定工作上下文预算下，把“执行任务”和“压缩历史”一起纳入 RL，让模型学会生成会影响后续决策的摘要。
summary.importance: 这篇属于 post-train 与 pretrain 接口上的重要方法工作。它不是单纯做长上下文推理技巧，而是把 context compaction 变成策略的一部分，并把摘要 token 放进同一个任务奖励优化回路。对基座研究的启发有三点。第一，长程能力不一定只靠更长 context，也可以靠可训练的状态压缩。第二，agent RL 的训练单位不再天然是完整 rollout；压缩会把一条轨迹切成长度不同、时间位置不同的 segment，损失归一化和 credit assignment 会直接影响训练信号质量。第三，summary 不是外部 memory 组件，而是模型要学习的中间状态表示，这与持续预训练、长程记忆和 latent state modeling 都有联系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 PPO，而不是沿用 GRPO 式的 group-relative 完整 rollout 优化。原因是 compaction 会让每个任务产生数量可变的轨迹段，固定 group normalization 很难处理段长、压缩次数和时间距离的差异。CompactionRL 在 rollout collection 中加入压缩机制：当历史长度接近上下文预算 C，剩余空间低于阈值 T_comp 时，系统追加固定 summarization instruction，由当前可训练 policy 生成 summary；随后用 summary 加最近一小段交互历史重建 context，agent 继续执行任务。assistant action 和 summary generation 都作为 policy 产生的 token，被同一个最终任务奖励优化。两个技术细节很关键。第一是 token-level loss normalization，用来减少长 summary 或长 action 在 PPO loss 中获得过大权重的问题。第二是 cross-trajectory GAE，用 critic 在压缩边界之外传播 advantage，避免把压缩后的 segment 当成独立样本而切断时间信用分配。这样，摘要质量对后续成功的影响可以通过最终奖励回传到生成摘要的 token。
summary.experiments: 实验在长程 agentic coding 任务上验证，模型包括 GLM-4.7-Flash 和 GLM-4.5-Air。对比基线是带 inference-time compaction 的基础模型，即只在推理阶段做压缩而不通过 RL 学习压缩策略。CompactionRL 在 GLM-4.7-Flash 上使 SWE-bench Verified 提升 5.5 分，Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升 6.8 分；在 GLM-4.5-Air 上分别提升 7.0 分和 3.1 分。这个结果说明，收益不只是来自“能继续跑更长轨迹”，还来自训练期间让模型学会生成对后续决策有用的压缩状态。由于摘要和执行共享最终任务奖励，实验更接近真实长程 agent 的训练约束：任务成功通常只有稀疏反馈，中间摘要没有人工标签。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 introduction 中对 GRPO/完整 rollout 假设失效的分析，这是理解方法动机的关键。然后看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，确认 compaction 何时触发、summary 如何进入重建 context、哪些 token 参与 PPO 更新。方法部分重点读三块：compaction rollout collection、token-level loss normalization、cross-trajectory GAE。实验部分优先看 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 主结果表，再看是否有去掉 learned compaction、去掉 token normalization、去掉 cross-trajectory GAE 的消融。最值得深挖的是 credit assignment：summary token 距离最终奖励很远，critic 与 GAE 的设计是否稳定，决定了方法能否扩展到更长 horizon 和更多工具调用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: CompactionRL addresses a training problem in long-horizon agentic RL: interaction histories can exceed a fixed context window, while inference-time summarization is not optimized by the task reward. The goal is to train the model to execute the task and to generate the compacted state that later decisions will depend on.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong post-training method with clear implications for foundation-model training. It treats context compaction as a learned policy action rather than an external memory heuristic. The contribution matters because long-horizon ability does not have to come only from larger context windows; it can also come from trained state compression under a fixed context budget. It also exposes a training issue that is easy to miss: once a rollout is split by compaction, segment length, segment position, and delayed reward all affect the quality of the RL signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built on PPO. The choice is deliberate: group-relative methods such as GRPO assume groups of comparable complete rollouts, while compaction creates a variable number of segments per task. During rollout collection, when the remaining context budget falls below a threshold, the model receives a fixed summarization instruction and samples a summary using the current policy. The next context is reconstructed from that summary plus a short tail of recent interaction, and the agent continues the task. Both ordinary action tokens and summary tokens are optimized under the same final task reward. Two design choices carry most of the method. Token-level loss normalization reduces bias from segments or summaries with different lengths. Cross-trajectory GAE preserves temporal credit assignment across compaction boundaries, so that the final outcome can still assign credit or blame to summary tokens generated much earlier.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments focus on long-horizon agentic coding. On GLM-4.7-Flash, CompactionRL improves over a base model with inference-time compaction by 5.5 points on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 points on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On GLM-4.5-Air, the gains are 7.0 and 3.1 points on the same two benchmarks. These numbers indicate that training the compaction behavior is better than adding summarization only at inference time. The setup is also realistic for agent RL: the summary has no separate supervision, and its usefulness is learned through sparse task-level reward.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the motivation explaining why complete-rollout group optimization breaks under compaction. Then inspect Figures 1 and 2 to follow the compaction trigger, reconstructed context, and the tokens included in the PPO update. In the method section, focus on rollout collection with compaction, token-level loss normalization, and cross-trajectory GAE. In the experiments, prioritize the main SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 tables, then check ablations for learned compaction, normalization, and cross-boundary advantage estimation if provided. The deepest point is credit assignment: summary tokens are far from the final reward, and the stability of the critic and GAE determines whether the method can scale to longer horizons and more complex tool-use tasks.

recommendation.zh: 把“总结=推理技巧”改成“总结=可学习动作”这点值得立刻复现；重点看 token-level 归一化与 cross-trajectory GAE，别被单点 Pass@1 吸走注意力。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing for the shift from “summarization as inference hack” to “summarization as a learnable action”; focus on token-level normalization and cross-trajectory GAE, not the headline Pass@1.

paper.title: QVal: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act over long horizons, where a single trajectory can contain hundreds or thousands of actions. In these settings, outcome-only rewards provide too sparse guidance, failing to inform the model about the goodness of intermediate actions. Dense supervision methods aim to solve this problem by scoring intermediate steps, from intrinsic confidence to self-distillation and embedding similarities. However, it is common practice to evaluate them by measuring the downstream perfo

summary.core_problem: 长程 LLM Agent 的训练需要密集监督信号，但现有做法通常把信号接入完整 RL 或后训练流程后再看最终收益。这种评估成本高，而且把信号质量、RL 算法、归一化、loss 接法、优化细节等因素混在一起。QVal 试图回答一个更直接的问题：不做训练，能否先判断某个中间步骤打分信号是否接近真实 action value。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口有参考价值。长程 Agent 训练的瓶颈之一是信用分配，尤其是几百到几千步轨迹中，结果奖励很难告诉模型哪一步有用。QVal 提供了一个低成本筛选 dense supervision 的协议，可以在昂贵训练前排除质量较差的信号。更重要的是，它把 dense reward、value signal、test-time search heuristic 放到同一个 Q-value 对齐框架下比较，减少了只看最终训练曲线带来的误判。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是构造由 state-action pair 组成的数据集，每个样本标注一个 reference Q-value，即从该状态动作继续执行、在某个专家参考策略下的期望回报。专家策略在简单环境中可以来自最优策略；在开放环境中则用较强模型的多次 rollout 估计，通常取较优轨迹形成参考。被评估的方法只需要对同一批 state-action pair 打分，然后计算 Q-alignment，也就是这些分数能否按 reference Q-value 正确排序。这样，直接 prompting、intrinsic confidence、自蒸馏、embedding similarity、代码生成式信号、ranking predictor、预训练模型打分等不同来源的 dense signal 可以在同一输入、同一目标、同一上下文下比较。
summary.experiments: QVal-v1.0 覆盖四类多轮环境：TerminalBench 的编程和终端交互、OpenApps 的图形界面和应用操作、ALFWorld 的具身文本环境、FrozenLake 的目标导航。实验评估了 21 种 dense supervision 方法，分为七个方法族：direct prompting、intrinsic signals、code generation、self-distillation、ranking-based prediction、pre-trained models、embedding similarity。主要结果是 direct prompting 和 ranking 方法平均 Q-alignment 更强；同一方法族内增加复杂度通常没有明显收益；code-based 方法在较小、结构化环境中表现较好，但在更开放的任务上变弱；文本观测比图像观测更容易得到稳定对齐；action-value 和 state-value 两类目标下的方法相对排序大体保持一致。结果也说明环境难度不能用单一排序解释，不同方法族会受状态空间、动作空间、模态和反馈形式不同影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。先看引言和 Figure 1，确认 QVal 如何把 dense supervision 转成 Q-value 排序问题。再看方法部分中 reference Q-value 的构造方式，重点判断专家策略和 best-of-rollouts 会引入什么偏差。实验部分建议重点看 21 种方法的分组结果、不同环境上的排名变化、文本与图像观测差异、action-value 与 state-value 的对照。若关心 Agent RL 训练信号，最值得深挖的是 Q-alignment 与真实后训练收益之间未来如何校准；这决定它能否成为训练前筛选指标，而不只是一个离线诊断工具。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon LLM agents need dense supervision, but most methods are evaluated only after being integrated into a full RL or post-training pipeline. That makes evaluation expensive and hard to interpret, because the measured gain mixes the quality of the signal with algorithmic details, normalization, loss integration, optimization choices, and other engineering factors. QVal asks a narrower question: before running training, can a dense signal be tested for whether it orders intermediate actions like a reference action-value function would?
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about the post-training interface rather than base pretraining. It is still relevant to foundation-model research because long-horizon agent training is increasingly limited by credit assignment. Outcome-only rewards are weak when trajectories contain hundreds or thousands of actions. QVal gives a cheap filter for candidate value signals before expensive RL runs. It also places reward shaping, dense value estimation, self-distilled feedback, and test-time search heuristics under a common Q-value alignment view.
summary_en.technical_approach: QVal builds datasets of state-action pairs. Each pair receives a reference Q-value: the expected return after taking that action and continuing under an expert reference policy. In simple environments, the expert can be an optimal policy; in more open-ended environments, the reference is estimated from rollouts of a strong model, often using the best among several continuations. A candidate dense supervision method then scores the same state-action pairs. The metric, Q-alignment, measures how well the candidate scores rank samples relative to the reference Q-values. This design allows direct prompting, intrinsic confidence, self-distillation, embedding similarity, code-based signals, ranking predictors, and pretrained-model-based scoring to be compared with the same inputs and targets.
summary_en.experiments: QVal-v1.0 covers four multi-turn environments: TerminalBench for programming and terminal interaction, OpenApps for computer and application use, ALFWorld for embodied reasoning, and FrozenLake for navigation. The study evaluates 21 dense supervision methods across seven families: direct prompting, intrinsic signals, code generation, self-distillation, ranking-based prediction, pretrained models, and embedding similarity. Direct prompting and ranking methods perform best on average. Code-based methods are strong in smaller and more structured environments, but degrade in more open-ended settings. Added complexity within a family rarely improves alignment over simpler variants. Text observations generally yield stronger alignment than image observations. The relative ordering of methods is largely preserved between action-value and state-value targets, while no single notion of environment difficulty explains all results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand the reduction from dense supervision evaluation to Q-value ranking. Then read the method section on how reference Q-values are constructed, especially the use of optimal policies versus strong-model rollouts. In the experiments, focus on the family-level comparison of 21 methods, the environment-wise rank changes, the text-versus-image observation gap, and the action-value versus state-value comparison. The main point to examine critically is whether Q-alignment will correlate with actual post-training gains; that determines whether QVal becomes a practical pre-RL screening tool or remains an offline diagnostic benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 做长horizon Agent RL/密集监督的研究员必看，Q对齐性的设计可直接复用在内部监督信号的筛选与优化中
recommendation.en: A must-read for researchers working on long-horizon agent RL or dense supervision; the Q-alignment design can be directly reused for internal supervision signal screening and optimization

institutions: Tübingen AI Center, University of Tübingen

paper.title: FinPersona-Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Psychometric Stability of Autonomous Financial Agents
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous financial agents initialized with explicit behavioral mandates such as "preserve capital" or "avoid speculative bets" that are meant to govern every decision throughout deployment. In practice, however, as market context accumulates over long horizons, these mandates gradually lose their behavioral influence, a phenomenon we formalize as Mandate Salience Decay (MSD). To measure MSD objectively, we introduce FinPersona-Bench, a

summary.core_problem: 评估自治金融 agent 在长时程部署中是否会逐步遗忘初始行为 mandate，并把这种现象形式化为 Mandate Salience Decay。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 与评测协议，而不是金融应用本身。它对后训练和 agent 对齐有启发：静态 persona/mandate 并不会在长时程交互中稳定保真。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FinPersona-Bench，在一个可控的合成市场中将可观测价格与隐藏基本面解耦，构造三类可证伪失败模式：平静市场无信号交易、崩盘时恐慌抛售、泡沫期忽视基本面。用这些情境测量 mandate 随时间衰减的程度。
summary.experiments: 评测 18 个前沿与开源 LLM，给定三种行为画像，从严格保守到激进增长。结果显示 MSD 会随时间累积，并在长时程决策中系统性削弱初始行为约束。摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 MBZUAI、东京大学、McGill、京都大学；作者中 Preslav Nakov、Zhuohan Xie 具有较高识别度。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether autonomous financial agents gradually forget their initial behavioral mandates over long-horizon deployment, formalizing the effect as Mandate Salience Decay (MSD).
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and evaluation protocol rather than a finance application per se. It is relevant to post-training and agent alignment because it tests whether static personas or mandates remain behaviorally stable over time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces FinPersona-Bench, a controlled synthetic market where observable price is decoupled from hidden fundamental value. It defines three falsifiable failure modes: trading without signal in calm markets, panic-selling during crashes, and ignoring fundamentals during bubbles, and uses them to measure mandate decay over time.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates 18 frontier and open-source LLMs under three behavioral profiles ranging from strict capital preservation to aggressive growth. The headline finding is that MSD compounds over time and systematically weakens the intended behavioral constraints in long-horizon decision making. The abstract does not provide model names or exact effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include MBZUAI, the University of Tokyo, McGill, and Kyoto University; Preslav Nakov and Zhuohan Xie are recognizable names.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你：persona/constitution 这类静态条件在长 rollout 里会衰减；只看 benchmark 设计和 failure mode 定义，别被金融外壳劝退。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful warning that static personas or constitutions decay over long rollouts; read the benchmark design and failure modes, not the finance wrapper.

paper.title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in interactive world models (IWMs), existing benchmarks evaluate action following only at trajectory level and ignore memory and interaction physics. We introduce WorldRoamBench, an open-world benchmark for long-horizon stability across four dimensions, each with tailored innovations: (i) Action: per-frame action metric bypassing cross-model semantic scale disparity and exposing failures hidden by trajectory; (ii) Vision: segment-based drift metric capturing non-monotonic

summary.core_problem: 现有交互式世界模型评测忽略长时稳定性、记忆与物理一致性，导致模型“看起来会动但不稳定/不守物理”的问题被掩盖。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark + 指标协议：把 long-horizon stability 拆成 Action/Vision/Physics/Memory 四维度，并给出更细粒度的度量；对做多模态/世界模型预训练与评测闭环的人有用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldRoamBench：1) Action 用逐帧动作度量避免轨迹级语义尺度不一致；2) Vision 用 segment-based drift 捕捉中途崩坏；3) Physics 用 controllability-gated 评测力学/光学/3D一致性；4) Memory 用 action-decoupled 协议评测场景记忆（transition-localized 3D 点云重建）与主体记忆（tracking+VLM 推理）。
summary.experiments: 提供 600+ 测试用例，覆盖 Nature/Urban/Indoor、第一/第三人称、WASD 10-60s 交互；摘要未列出被测模型列表与具体分数，但强调能暴露轨迹级评测隐藏的失败模式。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing interactive world model evaluations miss long-horizon stability, memory, and physics consistency, hiding failures behind trajectory-level metrics.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark/metric contribution: decomposes long-horizon stability into Action/Vision/Physics/Memory with tailored protocols; useful for multimodal/world-model pretraining + eval loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldRoamBench introduces (1) per-frame action metrics, (2) segment-based drift for vision collapse, (3) controllability-gated physics plausibility scoring across mechanics/optics/3D consistency, and (4) action-decoupled memory tests via transition-localized 3D point-cloud reconstruction and tracking+VLM reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: 600+ test cases across Nature/Urban/Indoor, 1st/3rd person, WASD interactions for 10–60s; abstract doesn’t list evaluated models/scores but claims it reveals failures missed by trajectory-only eval.

recommendation.zh: 做世界模型/多模态交互预训练的可以只看指标设计：逐帧 action + segment drift 很可能比“起终点对比”更诚实。
recommendation.en: If you work on interactive world models, focus on the metric design—per-frame action and segment drift are likely more honest than start-vs-end trajectory eval.

paper.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
paper.abstract: Mobile GUI agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks that require reading, updating, and reusing task-relevant data across pages and applications. Existing memory methods treat memory largely as passive storage, where past observations are accumulated and retrieved when needed. Yet retrieving a value does not reveal its current role in the workflow. The agent must still infer from accumulated records whether the value should be used now, has already been used, or must wait for a later dependen

summary.core_problem: GUI 长程任务里，单纯“把过去存下来/检索出来”的被动记忆不足以驱动执行：即使检索到值，模型仍需要在每一步从杂乱记录中重建“当前任务状态”（哪些子目标已完成、哪些值已使用/待用、下一步是否合法），在重复字段、相似值、干扰项、过期状态下容易重复操作或漏操作。论文要解决的是：让 GUI agent 的记忆从“记录库”变成可直接用于决策的“任务驱动状态”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 侧的“长轨迹状态表示 + 记忆使用策略学习”有启发，尤其是把记忆从 RAG/轨迹摘要提升为显式的执行状态机（stateful memory）。如果做通用 agent 或者做长上下文/外部记忆接口，这类结构化状态的定义与训练闭环（SFT 教结构、RL 教使用）值得借鉴。对纯基座预训练的影响主要体现在：未来若要把交互轨迹纳入持续预训练或 mid-train，应该把监督信号从 token-level 记录转向 state transition（状态更新）与 action validity（动作合法性）。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Active Task-Driving Memory (ATMem)：不是按时间堆叠的笔记/摘要，也不是手工固定 schema 的 tracker，而是从任务指令诱导出一个层级化、可扩展的“执行状态”。ATMem 由四块组成：
1) Workflow Progress：记录当前阶段、哪些 app-level 文件/对象已处理或待处理；
2) Constraints：把指令里的逻辑条件独立编码，避免与具体字段结构耦合；
3) Schema：抽取最小任务相关数据单元（字段）及属性；
4) ItemContent：存储具体实例的观测值，并维护执行状态（例如 pending/ready/used/verified 等）。
交互闭环：每次新观测或操作结果后，模型更新 ATMem；决策时把 ATMem 与当前 GUI 观测、历史一起输入来选动作。
训练分两阶段：
- SFT：用“verified trajectories”教模型生成/更新合法 ATMem，并在预测动作时引用它（解决“会写状态”）。
- STR-GRPO：一种 memory-aware 的在线 RL，目标是学会“何时、如何依赖 ATMem 才能提高完成率”（解决“会用状态”）。全文目前给到的细节重点在动机、状态设计与训练框架，STR-GRPO 的具体实现细节在截断内容里未完整展开。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的定量信息主要有：在 AndroidWorld 任务中，约 83% 涉及数据操作（查找/验证/修改/提交）并会改变后续可行动作集合，这是 ATMem 设计的经验依据。其余关键结果（任务成功率提升幅度、与 history/RAG/summary memory 的对比、SFT vs SFT+RL 的增益、长轨迹长度分桶表现、错误类型统计）在给定全文片段中未出现，无法据全文补全具体数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 1 的失败案例与 83% 数据操作统计，理解“检索到值仍会做错”的具体形态。
- 重点看 ATMem 四段结构的定义：哪些信息被显式状态化（provenance、status、constraints、role），哪些仍留给模型隐式推断。
- 如果要复现或迁移到别的交互环境，优先追 STR-GRPO：它如何把“使用 ATMem”变成可优化的策略（奖励如何定义、rollout 如何组织、reference/teacher 是否介入）。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟抓住核心观点；若要落地到自家 agent memory，需要再精读训练细节与错误分析部分（未包含在当前片段）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon mobile GUI workflows, “passive memory” (logs, summaries, retrieval) is not enough: even if the agent retrieves the right value, it still has to reconstruct the current workflow state (what is done, what is pending, what is already used, what action is valid now). This reconstruction becomes brittle with repeated fields, similar values, distractors, and stale states. The paper targets a memory design that directly drives execution by externalizing task state, not just storing observations.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on base pretraining recipes, but useful for post-training and agent research where state representation and memory usage policy matter. The key takeaway for foundation-model builders is the interface: supervise the model to produce/update an explicit task state (state transitions), then use online RL to make the model actually rely on that state for higher success rates. If interaction trajectories are used in continual pretraining or mid-training, the supervision should likely shift from raw histories to structured state updates and action validity signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Active Task-Driving Memory (ATMem) reframes memory as an explicit, hierarchical execution state rather than a chronological note or a fixed hand-engineered tracker. ATMem contains: (1) Workflow Progress (phase + which app-level files/objects are completed/pending), (2) Constraints (instruction logic encoded independently from schema), (3) Schema (minimal task-relevant fields and properties), and (4) ItemContent (observed instance values plus execution status such as pending/ready/used/verified). The agent updates ATMem after each observation/outcome and conditions action selection on ATMem + current GUI observation + history.
Training is two-stage: SFT on verified trajectories to learn to construct/update ATMem and reference it for action prediction; then STR-GRPO, an online RL method intended to optimize the policy of using ATMem for task completion. The provided full-text excerpt emphasizes motivation and state design; STR-GRPO implementation details are not fully visible in the snippet.
summary_en.experiments: From the available content, the main quantitative anchor is that ~83% of AndroidWorld tasks involve data operations (find/verify/modify/submit) that change the execution state, motivating stateful memory. Concrete performance numbers (success rate gains, ablations vs history/retrieval/summaries, SFT vs SFT+RL deltas, length-bucket robustness, error breakdowns) are not present in the provided excerpt, so they cannot be reported faithfully.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with Figure 1 to internalize the failure mode: “value retrieved but wrong action due to missing state binding.”
- Focus on the ATMem schema (the four sections) and ask what is made explicit (provenance, status, constraints, role) versus left implicit.
- If you care about training dynamics, jump to STR-GRPO: how it turns ‘using memory’ into an optimizable behavior (reward design, rollout organization, any teacher/reference assistance).
Time: ~20–30 minutes for the core idea; longer if you want to port the memory/state design to another interactive environment.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是pretrain论文，但把“记忆=检索”改成“记忆=显式执行状态”很对，读方法图和错误分析就够，值得拿去审视你自己的agent state abstraction。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift from memory-as-retrieval to memory-as-explicit execution state is the right abstraction; read the method figure and failure analysis, then revisit your own agent state design.

paper.title: SWE-INTERACT: Reimagining SWE Benchmarks as User-Driven Long-Horizon Coding Sessions
paper.abstract: We introduce SWE-Interact, a new testbed for evaluating coding agents on multi-turn, interactive, user-driven software engineering tasks. Existing frontier SWE benchmarks typically provide complete requirements upfront and evaluate agents on autonomous implementation. In contrast, SWE-Interact places agents in a realistic developer workflow: a carefully designed user simulator starts with vague or incomplete instructions, progressively reveals requirements, inspects the agent's workspace, and pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作把 SWE 评测从“一次性给全需求、让 agent 自主实现”改成“用户逐步澄清需求、审查代码、要求修改”的长程交互会话。核心问题不是代码能力本身，而是 coding agent 能否在含糊初始指令下发现用户意图，并在多轮反馈中保持实现的一致性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 agent eval 有参考意义。它提醒模型能力评测不能只看单轮任务完成率，还要看意图发现、计划确认、基于历史修改继续工作的能力。对于训练侧，启发点主要在数据构造：真实 coding-agent 轨迹不是完整规格说明到补丁的单步映射，而是 goal discovery、plan、approval、implement、revise、submit 的循环。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 SWE-bench Pro、SWE Atlas Refactoring、DeepSWE 各选 25 个任务，共 75 个任务，并把原本完整的任务说明拆成多轮交互。用户模拟器带有人设、任务目标和工具权限，可以检查 agent 的 workspace、搜索文件、查看 diff、运行命令，并根据实现状态逐步释放需求或提出修正。这比静态 API 式用户模拟更接近真实开发流程，因为反馈不是预先写死的，而是依赖 agent 当前工作区状态。
summary.experiments: 给定内容展示了任务构造、交互流程和 benchmark 设计目标，但没有提供完整模型对比表、成功率数字或失败模式统计的具体结果。可以确定的规模是 75 个多轮任务，来源覆盖三个已有 SWE benchmark，每类 25 个。评测重点应包括 agent 在模糊初始请求、计划确认、增量需求、回归修复和最终提交中的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 的问题定义、Figure 1 的交互流程，以及 Task Design 中如何把单轮 SWE 任务转换成多轮会话。若关注 agent 训练数据，可以额外看用户模拟器如何检查 workspace 和生成反馈；若只关注基座预训练，可跳过大部分 benchmark harness 细节。
summary.authors_note: Scale AI Research；作者姓名在给定内容中未显示。

summary_en.core_problem: SWE-INTERACT reframes software-engineering evaluation from one-shot implementation with a fully specified prompt into a user-driven, multi-turn coding session. The main question is whether coding agents can infer user intent from vague requests, adapt to newly revealed requirements, and preserve correctness while revising their own prior work.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining is limited, but the benchmark is useful for agent evaluation and data design. It points to a mismatch between common coding datasets and real coding-agent usage: real sessions often contain goal discovery, planning, approval, implementation, revision, and submission loops rather than a single prompt-to-patch mapping.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt 75 tasks from three existing SWE benchmarks: 25 from SWE-bench Pro, 25 from SWE Atlas Refactoring, and 25 from DeepSWE. Each original fully specified task is converted into a multi-turn workflow. A persona-conditioned user simulator starts with an incomplete request, reviews plans, inspects the workspace, searches files, reads diffs, runs commands, and reveals requirements or corrections based on the agent’s current implementation. This differs from static user simulators because the feedback depends on the live workspace state.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content describes the benchmark construction and interaction protocol, but does not include concrete success rates, model comparisons, or quantitative failure-mode statistics. The confirmed scale is 75 multi-turn tasks drawn evenly from three source benchmarks. The intended evaluation targets intent discovery, iterative refinement, requirement incorporation, regression avoidance, and final task completion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, Figure 1 for the interaction loop, and the task-design section explaining how single-turn SWE tasks are converted into user-driven sessions. Readers interested in agent training data should also inspect the user-simulator design and workspace-aware feedback mechanism.
summary_en.authors_note: Scale AI Research; author names are not shown in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练研究员的价值在§3的任务设计与§5的失败模式分析，可反推长程推理与交互能力的训练信号缺口。
recommendation.en: For pretraining researchers, focus on §3 task design and §5 failure modes, which reveal gaps in training signals for long-horizon reasoning and interactivity.

paper.title: ViPSim: Collaborating Visual and Parameter Spaces for Consistent Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
paper.abstract: Embodied World Models (EWMs) have emerged as a scalable and risk-free paradigm for advancing embodied intelligence, enabling the safety-critical evaluation of Vision-Language-Action systems. However, their reliability as evaluation benchmarks and foundational simulators is often hindered by the representation gap between low-dimensional actions and high-dimensional video synthesis. This gap results in a lack of geometric correspondence, manifesting as accumulated trajectory drift and inconsisten

summary.core_problem: 解决 embodied world model 在长时序 rollout 中，低维动作参数与高维视频生成之间缺少几何对应，导致轨迹漂移和机器人-物体交互不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 这是面向具身智能的视频世界模型工作。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对 VLA、动作条件视频生成、长时序模拟器可靠性有参考意义，尤其是把显式几何先验和参数空间约束结合起来。
summary.technical_approach: ViPSim 将建模空间拆成 Visual Space 和 Parameter Space。Visual Space 注入端执行器姿态投影、相机视角、深度几何和机器人形态 mask 等密集结构先验；Parameter Space 维护低维动作和状态参数，用于约束长时序生成过程。核心思路是让视频生成不只依赖像素预测，而要被机器人运动参数持续校正。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或量化结果。预期实验关注长时序视频生成一致性、轨迹漂移、机器人-物体交互保真度，以及作为 VLA 系统评估模拟器的可用性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles drift and inconsistent robot-object interaction in long-horizon embodied world models caused by weak correspondence between low-dimensional actions and high-dimensional video synthesis.
summary_en.importance: This is not core LLM pretraining work, but it is relevant to VLA and multimodal world-model research. The useful idea is to constrain action-conditioned video generation with explicit geometry and parameter-space state.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViPSim couples a Visual Space with a Parameter Space. The Visual Space provides dense structural grounding through projected end-effector pose, camera perspective, depth-informed geometry, and robot morphology masks. The Parameter Space maintains low-dimensional action and state variables that regularize long-horizon generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to focus on long-horizon consistency, trajectory drift, robot-object interaction fidelity, and usefulness as a simulator for VLA evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只需看结构约束怎么接入视频世界模型；它提示 VLA 模拟器不能只靠像素扩散硬滚。
recommendation.en: Skim the geometry-conditioning design; it is a reminder that VLA simulators cannot rely on pixel-only rollouts.

paper.title: SWE-MeM: Learning Adaptive Memory Management for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon software engineering agents often need to manage lengthy and noisy interaction histories under limited context budgets. Existing memory management methods typically rely on static compression workflows or impose rigid constraints on compression timing and granularity. Moreover, these approaches fail to jointly optimize memory management and issue resolution capabilities to improve performance while reducing token usage. We present SWE-MeM, a training framework for proactive and on-d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长程 coding agent 的上下文管理问题：交互历史又长又噪，固定阈值 summarization 或固定粒度压缩不能判断哪些信息该保留、何时该压缩，也没有和最终解题成功率一起优化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent post-train 和长上下文使用方式有参考价值。关键点是把 memory management 从外部规则变成模型可学习的动作，并把“少用上下文”和“解决 issue”放在同一个训练目标里。对于训练长程工具调用模型，这类设计比单纯扩 context window 更贴近实际瓶颈：很多失败不是窗口不够长，而是模型无法主动维护可用工作记忆。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-MeM 给 agent 一个显式的 compress 工具，让模型自己决定何时压缩、压缩哪一段、如何写摘要。工具参数包括 analysis、start_step_number、end_step_number、content 和 remaining_work。analysis 记录当前进展和未解决子任务；start/end 指定要替换的历史跨度；content 是压缩后的摘要；remaining_work 被追加到轨迹末尾，用来保持任务连续性。压缩后的摘要以后还可以再次被压缩，因此形成渐进式 memory。训练上，作者先合成带 memory-tool 调用的解题轨迹。轨迹中的任务行动由待训练的 base model 生成，专有模型只用于判断是否应主动触发压缩和生成 memory-tool 参数。随后使用 curriculum fine-tuning 学习主动压缩行为，再用 Memory-aware GRPO 做强化学习。Memory-aware GRPO 的重点是按 memory 行为切分轨迹并做 step-level credit assignment，使模型同时优化 issue resolution 和 memory 决策，而不是只压缩 token。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，在 32K context budget 下评估。Qwen3-4B-Instruct 达到 43.4% resolve rate，Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 达到 60.2%。论文声称相对已有 memory management 方法，在解题率和交互轮数上都有优势。更有信息量的实验点是效率比较：已有静态压缩方法可以降低 peak context length，但可能增加总 token 使用和交互步数；SWE-MeM 试图让压缩动作服务于解题路径，而不是只服务于窗口长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分的 memory tool 定义和 Figure 2，理解它如何把历史片段替换为摘要并保留 remaining work。然后看 trajectory synthesis 和 curriculum training，判断数据合成是否会把专有模型的偏好注入 memory 策略。最后看 Memory-aware GRPO 和 SWE-Bench Verified 主表。消融实验若完整呈现，重点关注三项：去掉主动触发、去掉 curriculum、去掉 memory-aware credit assignment 后，resolve rate、token usage、interaction rounds 分别如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: SWE-MeM addresses memory management for long-horizon coding agents. Append-only ReAct-style histories become long and noisy, while fixed summarization rules cannot decide which information remains useful, when compression should happen, or how compression affects final issue resolution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to agent post-training than to base pretraining. Its useful idea is to make memory management a learnable agent action rather than an external heuristic. The work also treats context reduction and task success as a joint optimization problem. This is important because many long-horizon failures are caused not only by limited context length, but also by poor maintenance of working memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method gives the agent a flexible compress tool. The model decides when to call it, which history span to compress, and what summary should replace that span. The tool takes analysis, start_step_number, end_step_number, content, and remaining_work. The analysis records progress and unresolved subtasks; start and end identify the span to replace; content is the compressed memory entry; remaining_work is appended to preserve task continuity. Compressed entries can be compressed again later, enabling progressive memory refinement. Training starts with synthesized trajectories that include proactive memory-tool calls. The base model generates the task-solving actions, while a proprietary model is used only for trigger judgment and memory-tool argument synthesis. The model is then trained with curriculum fine-tuning and Memory-aware GRPO, which uses memory-aware trajectory splitting and step-level credit assignment to optimize both issue resolution and memory decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation is on SWE-Bench Verified under a 32K context budget. SWE-MeM reports a 43.4% resolve rate with Qwen3-4B-Instruct and 60.2% with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. The paper reports better resolve rates and fewer interaction rounds than prior memory-management baselines. The key experimental claim is that static compression can reduce peak context length while still increasing total token use or the number of interaction steps, whereas adaptive compression is trained to support the actual repair trajectory.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the memory-tool formulation and Figure 2 to understand how selected history spans are replaced while remaining work is preserved. Then read the trajectory synthesis and curriculum training sections, especially the role of the proprietary model in generating memory actions. Finish with Memory-aware GRPO and the SWE-Bench Verified results. If ablations are available, the most useful ones are removing proactive triggering, curriculum learning, and memory-aware credit assignment, then checking resolve rate, token usage, and interaction rounds.

recommendation.zh: Memory-aware GRPO的步级信用分配设计有参考价值，做长上下文Agent后训练的重点看§3的训练目标和轨迹切分方法
recommendation.en: The step-level credit assignment design of Memory-aware GRPO is referential; long-context agent post-training researchers should focus on the training objective and trajectory splitting in §3

paper.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
paper.abstract: For agents to learn continuously from interaction with the world at test time, they must be able to explore effectively, acquire new world knowledge and skills, retain relevant episodic experiences, and plan over long horizons. To evaluate these key abilities of test-time continual learning agents, we introduce AgentOdyssey, a novel evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics, and long-horizon tasks. Critically, AgentOdyssey goes beyo

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent benchmark 多数评估静态推理能力，难以研究模型在部署过程中通过交互、记忆和试错持续学习的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近评测基础设施，而不是预训练方法。对基座研究的价值在于，它把 test-time continual learning 拆成可诊断能力：探索、情景记忆、世界知识获取、技能学习和长程规划。这些能力与预训练和后训练的接口相关，尤其是记忆机制、上下文学习、工具使用、长期任务数据合成，以及是否需要参数更新的 test-time training。它不直接给出新的 LM objective，但能帮助判断现有 LLM agent 的瓶颈来自模型先验、上下文管理、记忆压缩，还是规划策略。
summary.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey 是一个可程序化生成开放式文字游戏的评测框架。环境被形式化为 POMDP，状态包含地点图、物体分布、NPC、时间和 agent 自身状态；agent 通过自然语言动作与环境交互，只能看到局部文本观察。生成端使用面向长程游戏的 ontology，定义地点、物体、NPC、action rules 和 step rules。action rules 描述 agent 动作的效果，step rules 描述环境自身动态，例如 NPC 行为。LLM 用于合成实体和规则，随后用程序合成进行验证和自动修复，以保证游戏系统可执行、任务可达、反馈一致。评测端不只看游戏进度，还包含世界知识、情景记忆、物体探索、动作探索、动作多样性和调用成本等诊断指标。
summary.experiments: 提供内容中没有完整实验表格和具体数字。可确认的是，作者评估了多类 agent 范式，并报告当前 agent 在长程、非重置环境中存在明显限制；影响有效任务跨度的因素包括探索效率、短期记忆组织、经验到语义知识的抽象，以及能否把早期经历用于后续规划。作者特别强调短期记忆在 agent test-time training 中的重要性，这一点符合长程环境的直觉：如果经验不能被稳定保留并压缩成决策相关信息，后续参数更新或检索增强都难以发挥作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–40 分钟。优先看 AgentOdyssey 的 ontology、POMDP formalization、game verification/auto-fixing 机制，以及 metrics 设计。若只关心预训练接口，可跳过具体游戏示例，重点看评测维度如何映射到记忆、知识获取和技能学习。值得深挖的是生成环境的可控性：任务难度是否能随实体数、规则数、依赖链长度稳定扩展；自动验证是否能排除不可解任务；诊断指标是否能预测 agent 在真实长程任务中的失败模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in agent evaluation: most benchmarks measure static inference, while real agents may need to learn continuously during deployment through interaction, memory, and trial-and-error.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation and environment-generation contribution, not a pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it decomposes test-time continual learning into concrete abilities: exploration, episodic memory, world-knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. These abilities sit at the interface between pretraining, post-training, memory systems, and test-time adaptation. The benchmark can help distinguish whether an agent fails because the base model lacks priors, because the memory system loses useful information, because the planner cannot manage long dependencies, or because test-time updates are poorly conditioned.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey procedurally generates open-ended text games. The environment is modeled as a POMDP: the hidden state contains a graph of locations, objects, NPC instances, time, and agent state, while the agent receives partial textual observations and feedback after each natural-language action. The generation engine is built around an ontology for long-horizon games, covering entities such as locations, objects, and NPCs, plus rules such as action rules and step rules. Action rules define the effects of agent actions; step rules define autonomous environment dynamics, such as NPC behavior. LLMs synthesize entities and rules, and a program-synthesis-based verifier checks and repairs generated games so that the resulting environments are executable and internally consistent. The evaluation suite includes not only task progress but also diagnostic metrics for world knowledge, episodic memory, object and action exploration, action diversity, and model cost.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied text does not include full tables or numerical results. The visible claims are that the authors compare diverse agent paradigms and find clear limits in current agents under long-horizon, non-resettable settings. The reported bottlenecks include inefficient exploration, poor short-term memory organization, weak abstraction from episodes into reusable knowledge, and limited ability to use earlier experiences for later planning. The emphasis on short-term memory in test-time training is technically plausible: if recent experience is not preserved and compressed into decision-relevant state, retrieval-based learning and parametric test-time updates both lose useful signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–40 minutes. Read the ontology, POMDP formalization, game verification and auto-repair mechanism, and metric definitions. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip many game examples and focus on how the benchmark operationalizes memory, knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. The key points to inspect are controllability and validity: whether difficulty scales cleanly with entity count, rule count, and dependency length; whether verification removes unsolvable games; and whether the diagnostic metrics predict failures in more realistic long-horizon agent tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读评测协议和诊断指标即可；它不是预训练方法，但 test-time continual learning 的任务假设值得纳入 agent eval 视野。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and diagnostic metrics; it is not a pretraining method, but the test-time continual-learning assumption is worth tracking for agent evaluation.

paper.title: BiPACE: Bisimulation-Guided Policy Optimization with Action Counterfactual Estimation for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Stepwise group-based RL is an attractive way to train long-horizon LLM agents without a learned critic: it reuses multiple sampled rollouts to estimate local advantages. Its weakness is less visible but more fundamental: every group-relative estimator assumes that the steps it compares are equivalent for credit assignment. We show that current agentic variants violate this assumption through a state-action credit mismatch. The observation-hash partition is overly fine on the state side, creating

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 的无 critic 分组式 RL 中，step-level advantage 估计因状态分组过细、动作归因过粗而失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇后训练信用分配方法论文，贡献不在 agent 应用本身，而在指出现有 stepwise group-based RL 的一个结构性偏差：比较的步骤并不真正可比。对做 RL-pretrain 接口、长轨迹 credit assignment、无 critic 训练的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BiPACE，一个可直接替换现有估计器的 advantage 估计方法，不引入 critic、辅助损失或额外 rollout。方法包含两部分：BiGPO 用 actor 隐状态空间中的余弦距离做聚类，近似 policy-induced bisimulation，以修正 observation-hash 过细导致的 singleton group；ACE 用动作反事实估计把状态值与动作特异 credit 分开，避免组内均值把两者混在一起。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其在长时程 agent 训练场景中做了受控比较，重点验证两点：一是当前 agentic group-relative estimator 确实存在 state-action credit mismatch；二是 BiPACE 在不增加 rollout 成本的前提下改善 step-level 学习信号。未见参数量、基座模型和具体 benchmark 细节，需读正文确认 setup 是否足够干净、收益是否跨环境稳定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自芝加哥大学、港科大（广州）、斯坦福大学和中科大。机构组合较强，但作者名单里暂无可直接确认的业界高辨识度一线 RLHF/agent 研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a failure mode in critic-free, stepwise group-based RL for long-horizon LLM agents, where step-level advantage estimates are distorted by overly fine state partitioning and overly coarse action credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training credit-assignment paper rather than an agent application paper. Its value is in identifying a structural bias in current group-relative estimators: the compared steps are not actually equivalent for credit assignment. That matters for RL-pretrain interfaces, long-trajectory optimization, and critic-free training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes BiPACE, a drop-in advantage estimator that does not add a critic, auxiliary losses, or extra rollouts. It has two parts: BiGPO clusters steps by cosine distance in the actor hidden-state geometry as an empirical policy-induced bisimulation proxy, fixing the singleton-group issue from observation hashing; ACE uses action counterfactual estimation to separate state value from action-specific credit instead of collapsing both into a within-group mean.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments are designed to show two things: current agentic group-relative estimators suffer from a state-action credit mismatch, and BiPACE improves step-level learning signals without extra rollout cost. The abstract does not expose model size, base model, or benchmark details, so the cleanliness of the setup and robustness across environments need verification in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Chicago, HKUST (Guangzhou), Stanford University, and USTC. The institution mix is strong, though no widely recognized frontline RLHF/agent author can be confidently identified from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 核心，但它把“组内步骤可比”这个默认前提拆掉了；若你在做 GRPO/长轨迹 RL，先看方法假设再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it usefully breaks the hidden assumption that grouped steps are comparable; if you work on GRPO-style long-horizon RL, inspect the estimator assumptions before deciding to reproduce.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
paper.abstract: Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary ov

summary.core_problem: 论文关注开放式、多步 persuasion agent 中的误差累积问题，尤其是早期检索或策略选择失误如何在长轨迹中放大并导致问题漂移与迎合。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 系统方法，不是基座预训练工作。价值在于它指出语义检索在主观任务中会把“主题相似”误当成“策略可迁移”，对做 agent memory/RAG 的研究员有参考意义，但对 pretrain 的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将标准 RAG 的失败归因于 semantic leakage：检索器按词汇/语义相似度取回内容，混入了与当前任务无关但表面相似的主题信息。为此提出 Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG)，通过离散类别瓶颈先把策略映射到 taxonomy，再按类别路由检索，以解耦论证结构与主题内容，减少长程轨迹中的污染传播。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 zero-shot、cross-domain 设定下，TS-RAG 相比标准语义检索能更好迁移抽象逻辑，并在不对称部署中帮助轻量模型借助重模型生成的策略库。未见模型参数、数据规模和量化提升幅度，说明更像系统概念验证而非大规模严谨 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies compounding failures in open-ended, multi-step persuasion agents, where early retrieval or strategy errors amplify over long trajectories and lead to drift and sycophancy.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining work. Its main value is the observation that semantic retrieval can confuse topical similarity with strategic transferability in subjective tasks. Useful for agent memory/RAG work, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute failures of standard RAG to semantic leakage: retrieval based on lexical/semantic overlap pulls in topically similar but strategically irrelevant content. They propose Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), which inserts a discrete categorical bottleneck by mapping strategies into a taxonomy and routing retrieval through that taxonomy, decoupling argumentative structure from topical content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims zero-shot cross-domain gains over standard semantic retrieval, especially for transferring abstract logic, and highlights asymmetric deployments where smaller models benefit from strategy libraries produced by stronger models. No model sizes, dataset scales, or effect sizes are given, so this reads more like a systems proof-of-concept than a large-scale clean benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 想做 agent memory/RAG 可以看它对 semantic leakage 的诊断；但实验信息不够干净，先读问题定义和方法图，别急着把 taxonomy bottleneck 当通用解。
recommendation.en: Worth a look for its semantic-leakage diagnosis in agent memory/RAG, but the setup looks under-specified; read the problem framing and method figure before treating the taxonomy bottleneck as a general solution.

paper.title: SAFARI: Scaling Long Horizon Agentic Fault Attribution via Active Investigation
paper.abstract: As autonomous agents tackle increasingly complex multi-step, multi-agent tasks, their execution trajectories have scaled beyond the constraints of even the largest context windows. Current methods for effectively diagnosing agent failures load the full trajectory into an LLM's context window, which suffers from attention dilution and fails when agentic traces inevitably exceed context limits. To address this, we introduce SAFARI (Scaling long-horizon Agentic Fault AttRibution via active Investig

summary.core_problem: 长时序多智能体执行轨迹长度可达百万token级别，现有故障归因方法要么全量加载轨迹到模型上下文窗口导致注意力稀释，超出上下文长度限制后直接失效，要么依赖超长上下文窗口方案，成本高且效率低，无法在长轨迹下稳定定位最早的未修正错误步骤。
summary.importance: 该工作提出用主动检索+假设验证的闭环替代被动全量上下文加载的长序列处理思路，对智能体可靠性评测、长上下文任务的信息处理范式设计有参考价值，但其本身属于智能体应用层方法，与基座预训练直接关联较弱，仅在长序列效率优化方向有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将故障归因流程从“全量轨迹喂入模型”改为工具增强的主动调查闭环：1）给调查智能体配置两个专用工具，read工具读取指定偏移位置的连续轨迹片段，search工具支持基于正则的全轨迹关键词/错误标识检索，无需将全轨迹载入上下文；2）加入持久化短期记忆模块，上下文窗口达到预算时保留关键调查证据，避免已收集信息随历史轮次被驱逐丢失；3）设置强制验证环节：调查智能体输出结论前需将故障假设拆解为最多3个可证伪的原子论断，并行发送给独立推理评估器核验证据对论断的支撑度，平均置信度低于70分时根据评估反馈补充检索，达标后再输出最终故障位置。
summary.experiments: 在Who&When和TRAIL两个长时序智能体故障归因基准上测试：在上下文窗口受限的设定下，性能显著优于全量加载上下文的基线和现有长上下文故障检测方法，能够定位超出模型原生上下文长度的百万token级轨迹中的故障，基线方法在该长度下完全失效；验证环节可稳定提升归因准确率，整体token消耗比全量加载方案低一个量级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的主动调查闭环设计和验证阶段机制，无需深究实验细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。其主动检索替代全上下文加载的思路可作为长序列预训练效率优化的方向参考，但方案本身不直接适用于核心预训练流程。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multi-agent execution traces can scale to millions of tokens, exceeding the native context window of even the largest LLMs. Existing fault attribution methods that load full trajectories into context suffer from attention dilution and hard context limits, while approaches relying on extended context windows carry high cost and poor efficiency, leading to failed attribution on very long traces.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates a paradigm of replacing passive full-context ingestion with active retrieval and hypothesis-driven exploration to scale beyond context window limits, with relevance to agent reliability evaluation and long-sequence information processing design. As an application-layer agent method, it has limited direct relevance to base LLM pretraining, offering only indirect inspiration for long-sequence efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAFARI replaces end-to-end trajectory loading with a closed-loop active investigation framework: (1) An investigator agent is equipped with two specialized tools: a read tool to pull contiguous trajectory segments at specified offsets, and a regex-based search tool to jump directly to relevant spans without loading the full trace. (2) A persistent short-term memory module retains key evidence across iterations, preventing loss of collected information when old conversation turns are evicted to meet context budgets. (3) A mandatory verification stage requires the agent to decompose fault hypotheses into up to 3 falsifiable atomic claims, which are sent in parallel to independent reasoning evaluators to check if cited evidence supports each claim. If average confidence falls below a 70-point threshold, the agent collects additional evidence based on evaluator feedback before finalizing attribution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the Who&When and TRAIL fault attribution benchmarks. Under constrained context window limits, SAFARI outperforms full-context baselines and existing long-horizon fault detection methods by a large margin, and remains functional on million-token TRAIL traces that exceed all tested models' native context windows, where baseline methods fail entirely. The verification stage delivers consistent accuracy gains, and total token consumption is roughly one order of magnitude lower than full-context approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the methodology section for the active investigation loop and verification design; deep dives into experiment details are not necessary. Allocate ~15 minutes for reading. The active retrieval paradigm may offer indirect inspiration for long-sequence pretraining efficiency research, but is not directly applicable to core pretraining workflows.

recommendation.zh: 它不改变基座建模，但对“长轨迹=长上下文”这个偷懒设定给了更干净的替代；读方法图和主表即可，别把它误当长上下文架构结论。
recommendation.en: It does not change foundation modeling, but it cleanly challenges the lazy assumption that long traces should be handled as long context; read the method figure and main table, not as an architecture claim.

paper.title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grain

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长程 Agent RL 中的信用分配问题：step-level 训练降低了上下文和显存压力，但仍把探索轨迹当成彼此独立的线性序列，导致稀疏、延迟奖励下的状态价值估计方差高，关键动作也难以被准确放大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 Agent post-training 的算法改进。它的启发在于训练信号的组织方式：长程交互数据不应只按 trajectory 或 step 切开，还可以按状态转移结构重组。对做 RL pretrain、agentic mid-training 或环境交互数据训练的人来说，G2PO 提供了一个清晰的思路：先把采样轨迹还原成状态图，再在图上估计价值和优势，减少单条轨迹偶然性带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: G2PO 的核心做法有两步。第一，把多条 Agent 探索轨迹重构成状态转移图。相同或相似的环境观察被聚合成一个 state group，动作被看作从源状态到目标状态的有向边。第二，在图上重新定义价值和优势。状态价值不再由单条轨迹的最终结果决定，而是对同一 state group 中多个样本的结果做聚合，近似估计该状态通向成功的概率。动作优势则由边两端的价值增量给出，形式上接近 1-step TD error。与 GiGPO 这类只在同一局部状态内比较动作的方法不同，G2PO 会把全图所有边的 TD error 放入一个全局参考组做标准化，从而让跨状态、跨阶段的关键转移也能得到较高权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 三个长程 Agent benchmark，模型包括 Qwen-2.5-1.5B、7B 和 14B。论文报告 G2PO 相比 prompt-based 方法和 RL baseline 都有稳定收益。相对 GRPO，在 WebShop 上最高提升 22.2% success rate，在 ALFWorld 上最高提升 14.4%。AppWorld 用于验证复杂环境观察下的有效性。作者强调该方法主要改变 advantage 估计和样本组织方式，几乎不引入额外计算成本。文中还用状态价值方差分析说明，基于单条轨迹的估计容易受后续随机失败或偶然成功影响，而 state-group 聚合能缓解这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 trajectory-level、step-level 和 graph-level 视角的对比；方法部分重点看 state grouping 的定义、value aggregation 的公式、edge-centric advantage 以及全局标准化方式。实验部分优先看 WebShop/ALFWorld 的主表和关于状态价值方差、局部归一化与全局归一化的消融。需要特别留意 state similarity 如何判定，因为这是方法能否从 benchmark 迁移到真实网页、软件环境或多模态 Agent 的关键细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL. Step-level training reduces context growth, but it still treats exploration as isolated linear trajectories, which gives noisy value estimates and weak credit assignment under sparse delayed rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its value is in how it reorganizes interaction data before applying RL. For researchers working on RL-based agent training, RL pretraining, or environment-interaction mid-training, the main lesson is that trajectories can be lifted into a state-transition graph, and the training signal can be computed on that graph rather than on individual rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: G2PO reconstructs sampled agent trajectories into a directed state-transition graph. Identical or similar observations are grouped into state groups, and actions become edges between source and destination states. State value is estimated by aggregating outcomes over all states in the same group, instead of relying on one trajectory’s terminal reward. Action advantage is then computed from the value increment across an edge, which resembles a one-step TD error in sparse-reward tasks. Unlike local group methods such as GiGPO, which compare actions only within the same state, G2PO normalizes edge-level TD errors against a global reference group containing transitions from the whole graph. This gives more weight to transitions that make large absolute progress toward task success.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld with Qwen-2.5 models at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B scale. G2PO consistently improves over prompt-based methods and RL baselines. The reported gains over GRPO reach up to 22.2 percentage points in success rate on WebShop and 14.4 points on ALFWorld. AppWorld is used to test the method under more complex observations. The claimed overhead is minimal because the method changes the advantage estimation and grouping procedure rather than adding expensive model calls. The paper also analyzes variance in state-value estimation and argues that aggregating over state groups is less sensitive to accidental success or failure in a single rollout.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the shift from trajectory-level and step-level views to a graph view. In the method section, read the definitions of state grouping, group-aggregated value estimation, edge-centric advantage, and global normalization. In the experiments, prioritize the main WebShop and ALFWorld tables, plus ablations on graph aggregation and local versus global normalization. The most important implementation detail to check is how observation similarity is defined, since this will determine whether the method transfers beyond clean benchmark environments.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法定义和 credit assignment 实验即可；若图结构优势估计稳定，值得在内部长程 agent RL 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and credit-assignment ablations; if the graph-based estimator is stable, it is worth reproducing in internal long-horizon agent RL.

paper.title: AdaMem: Learning What to Remember for Personalized Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory systems for Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically try to \emph{remember everything}, extracting memories uniformly to retain as many facts as possible. In production, however, inference cost and finite context budgets make this untenable: beyond consolidating raw dialogue into memory, an agent must exert \emph{write control}, efficiently keeping only the information each user actually cares about. Otherwise, long-horizon personalized interactions suffer \emph{memory bloat}

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“怎样存更多记忆”，而是“在长期个性化交互里，什么值得被写进记忆”。作者认为现有 LLM memory agent 大多默认一个统一写入规则：只要对话里出现事实，就尽量提取并保存。这个假设在短任务里问题不大，但在真实长周期场景里会导致 memory bloat：无关细节不断累积，占用检索预算和上下文窗口，最终让真正重要的信息更难被召回。更关键的是，记忆价值是角色相关、用户相关的。同一句对话，对商务助理和健身伙伴的重要性完全不同。AdaMem 试图解决的核心问题，就是如何让记忆写入策略从“尽量全记”变成“按用户偏好有选择地记”，并且能从反馈中持续修正。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train memory system 和 agent training interface 有现实意义。它把长期记忆问题从 retrieval 侧往前推了一步，强调 write control 才是部署瓶颈。这个视角很重要，因为很多记忆系统把主要精力放在更强的检索器或更长的上下文，却默认写入阶段是无害的；AdaMem 说明如果写入策略错了，后面再强的检索也只是在噪声里找答案。对基座研究员而言，启发主要有两点。第一，长期记忆不只是压缩问题，也是偏好建模问题；“什么该保留”本身需要学习。第二，反馈闭环可以不直接更新主模型，而是更新一个外部 memory policy，这是一种比全量 RL 或 continual finetuning 更轻的适配路径。它更像 memory management 层的方法，而不是新的语言建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
AdaMem 的核心对象是一个结构化 Memory Policy。它用 JSON 形式为每个角色 C_i 指定一段自然语言偏好描述 T_i，例如只保留业务决策和 deadline，忽略日常寒暄。整个系统按周循环，包含四步。

第一步是 Daily Extraction。每天对新对话做记忆抽取时，不再使用统一 prompt，而是把当前 policy 渲染成定制化抽取指令，让 extractor LLM 按角色偏好决定写入内容。作者还加入了 Time Anchoring：在抽取 prompt 中显式提供会话绝对日期，要求模型把“明天”“下周三”这类相对时间解析成绝对日期再存储，避免长期记忆里时间语义漂移。

第二步是 Weekly Evaluation。每周末用针对偏好相关信息构造的 QA 来测试系统，观察哪些问题答错。

第三步是 Policy Reflection。系统分析错误来源，将失败分成两类：Recall Failure，说明对话里有信息但没被写入，当前 policy 太保守；Precision Failure，说明检索出的无关记忆干扰了回答，当前 policy 太宽松。基于这些错误，模型生成一个 patch ΔP_t 去修改 policy，而不是重写整套规则。patch-style 更新的好处是局部、可追踪，也更适合失败回滚。

第四步是 Failure Rollback 和 Policy Rendering。如果新 policy 在历史验证 QA 上表现变差，就拒绝这次更新并回滚，防止 policy drift。通过这种闭环，AdaMem 试图把 memory extraction 从一次性 prompt engineering 变成持续校正的控制过程。

方法上最有意思的地方不是模型结构，而是把长期记忆系统拆成了“写入策略—反馈诊断—局部修补—回滚保护”这条控制链。它没有训练新的大型记忆模块，也不依赖复杂 agent 架构，因此比较容易嵌入现有 RAG memory stack。
summary.experiments:
实验部分包含方法评测和 benchmark 构建两层内容。作者提出了 AdaMem-Bench，用来专门测 preference-guided long-horizon memory。这个 benchmark 的设计比较贴近真实部署：多周多 session 对话、多个角色并行、角色之间存在同类语义干扰、并且提供 session-level golden memories，只把符合角色偏好的原子事实标为应保留信息，其余视为噪声。这样的标注方式比普通 QA benchmark 更适合评估写入策略是否正确。

结果上，作者报告在两种 extraction LLM 和两种 feedback 模式下，AdaMem 相比基线最高带来 +9.0% QA accuracy，同时 memory volume 缩小 9%。这个组合结果比单看准确率更有说服力，因为它说明收益不是靠“多存一点”换来的，而是通过更好的写入筛选减少噪声。作者还指出，提升主要集中在 soft preference 类别，例如情绪、承诺、日程安排等。这很合理，因为这些信息往往不是显式事实三元组，统一抽取规则最容易漏掉或误存。剩余瓶颈则在于 weak feedback 下的 policy inference，也就是系统能看到答错了，但未必总能准确推断是该放宽还是收紧哪一类规则。

从给出的内容看，实验更像系统行为验证，而不是大规模统计显著性研究。阅读时要留意几件事：基线是否包括“记全部”的强 RAG memory、是否比较了不同 extractor 模型的稳定性、rollback 触发频率有多高、以及 memory volume 的定义是 token 数、条目数还是检索上下文长度。若文中有按错误类型拆分的分析，那部分最能说明方法是否真的学会了 write control，而不是仅靠 prompt wording 改善。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点放在问题设定和 benchmark 设计，不必把它当成新的模型论文来读。先看 Introduction，作者对 memory bloat 和 write control 的论证比较清楚。然后直接看 Method，抓住 weekly closed loop、Recall/Precision failure 诊断、policy patch、rollback、time anchoring 这几个部件。实验部分优先看 AdaMem-Bench 的构造原则，再看主结果表和按类别拆分的分析，判断收益来自哪里。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以读完主线；如果只想获取启发，看方法图、错误分类定义和 benchmark 示例就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that long-term memory for personalized LLM agents is not mainly a retrieval problem but a write-control problem. Most existing systems try to remember everything: every factual statement is extracted and stored under a uniform rule. That works poorly in long-horizon deployment because memory keeps growing, irrelevant details accumulate, retrieval gets noisier, and finite context budgets are wasted on trivia. More importantly, what should be remembered is role-dependent. A manager-facing assistant and a fitness companion should preserve different parts of the same conversation. AdaMem is built to learn that selectivity: not just how to store memories, but what to store for a given user role and how to revise that policy from feedback over time.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is useful for researchers thinking about the interface between foundation models and persistent memory systems. The main contribution is conceptual and operational. It shifts attention from better retrieval over an ever-growing memory bank to better admission control at write time. That is a meaningful correction, because downstream retrieval quality is bounded by the quality of what was written in the first place. For LLM systems work, the paper also shows a lightweight adaptation route: instead of updating the base model or running full continual finetuning, one can update an external memory policy through a feedback loop. This is closer to memory management than to a new modeling paradigm, but it is a practical idea for long-horizon agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AdaMem centers on a structured Memory Policy. The policy is a JSON object that maps each character or role C_i to a natural-language extraction preference T_i, such as keeping only final business decisions and deadlines while ignoring casual chatter. The system then runs a weekly closed loop with four stages.

First is Daily Extraction. New conversations are processed by an extractor LLM, but the extraction prompt is conditioned on the current policy rather than using a generic save-everything rule. The paper also adds Time Anchoring: the prompt includes the absolute session date and instructs the model to resolve relative expressions like “tomorrow” into absolute dates before storing them. That is a small but important systems detail, because relative temporal references decay quickly in long-term memory.

Second is Weekly Evaluation. At the end of each week, the system is probed with QA examples targeting preference-aligned information.

Third is Policy Reflection. Errors are diagnosed into two categories. Recall Failure means the relevant information appeared in dialogue but was never written, so the policy is too restrictive. Precision Failure means irrelevant retrieved memories polluted the answer, so the policy is too permissive. Based on these failures, the model generates a policy patch rather than rewriting the full policy from scratch. This patch-style update is easier to inspect and easier to roll back.

Fourth is Failure Rollback and Policy Rendering. If the updated policy hurts validation performance on historical QA pairs, the change is rejected and the system reverts to the previous policy. The accepted policy is then rendered into extraction instructions for the next week. The interesting part here is not a new neural architecture but a control loop: write policy, evaluate, diagnose, patch, validate, and only then deploy. That makes the method easy to insert into existing RAG-style memory stacks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation includes both a new benchmark and the method comparison itself. The benchmark, AdaMem-Bench, is designed specifically for preference-guided long-horizon memory. It uses multi-session dialogues over multiple weeks, multiple concurrent personas, and deliberately overlapping semantic content across characters so that the system must avoid confusing similar but irrelevant memories. Each session is annotated with golden memories: atomic facts that match the character’s preference profile are labeled as relevant, while the rest is treated as noise. That setup is better aligned with the paper’s goal than generic QA benchmarks.

Empirically, the paper reports up to +9.0% QA accuracy while reducing memory volume by 9%, across two extractor LLMs and two feedback modes. That combination matters more than the accuracy number alone, because it suggests the gains come from better selectivity rather than from simply storing more information. The analysis says improvements are concentrated in soft-preference categories such as emotions, promises, and schedules. That is plausible: these are exactly the categories where a uniform extraction rule tends to either miss subtle information or over-store irrelevant details.
