The main remaining bottleneck is policy inference from weak feedback, meaning the system can observe that an answer failed but cannot always infer the right policy adjustment.

When reading the experiments, the most useful questions are practical ones: what the baselines are, how memory volume is measured, how often rollback is triggered, and whether the gains hold across different extractor models. If the paper includes error-type breakdowns by recall versus precision failure, those are likely more informative than the top-line QA score.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a systems paper on memory control, not as a model-architecture paper. Start with the introduction, where the memory-bloat argument is laid out clearly. Then read the method section with attention to five components: the weekly closed loop, the recall-versus-precision failure taxonomy, patch-based policy updates, rollback, and time anchoring. In the experiments, first inspect how AdaMem-Bench is constructed, because the benchmark design explains why the method helps. Then look at the main result table and the category-wise analysis to see where the gains come from. A focused skim should take 20 to 30 minutes. If time is short, the method figure, the failure taxonomy, and a few benchmark examples are enough to capture the main idea.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是基座论文，但把 agent memory 的关键矛盾从 retrieval 转到 write policy，方向是对的；先看 memory policy 定义和 rollback 机制。
recommendation.en: Not a core pretraining paper, but it correctly reframes agent memory from retrieval to write policy; read the memory-policy formulation and rollback mechanism first.

paper.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
paper.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of proje

summary.core_problem: 构建一个支持可控长视野（long-horizon）生成的通用交互式视频世界模型，解决自回归生成中累积的风格和颜色漂移问题。
summary.importance: 提出了 DreamX-World 1.0，这是一个支持相机导航、区域重访和事件提示的交互式世界模型。其核心贡献在于将双向视频生成器转换为少步自回归世界模型的训练 recipe，以及处理长序列生成的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据引擎：结合 UE 渲染、游戏录像和真实视频（恢复相机几何）。2. 相机控制：提出 E-PRoPE，一种轻量级投影位置编码变体。3. 训练范式：使用因果强制（causal forcing）、DMD 风格蒸馏和 long-rollout 训练，将双向视频生成器转为自回归模型。4. 稳定性：通过在自生成的长视野上下文中训练，让模型暴露于自身生成的历史中，减少自回归块之间的风格/颜色漂移。
summary.experiments: 支持逼真、游戏和风格化领域的长视频生成，实现了相机控制和事件交互。
summary.authors_note: DreamX Team

summary_en.core_problem: Building a general-purpose interactive video world model for controllable long-horizon generation, addressing style and color drift accumulated in autoregressive generation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces DreamX-World 1.0, an interactive world model supporting camera navigation, region revisits, and promptable events. The core contribution lies in the training recipe that converts a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model and stabilizes long-sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Data Engine: Combines UE rendering, gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. 2. Camera Control: Proposes E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding. 3. Training Paradigm: Converts a bidirectional video generator into an autoregressive model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. 4. Stability: Trains on self-generated long-horizon contexts to expose the model to its own generated history, reducing style/color drift across autoregressive chunks.
summary_en.experiments: Supports long video generation across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains, achieving camera control and event interaction.
summary_en.authors_note: DreamX Team

recommendation.zh: 关注其将双向生成器转为自回归模型的 long-rollout 训练技巧，对缓解长序列自回归生成的 error accumulation 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Pay attention to its long-rollout training trick that converts a bidirectional generator to an AR model; useful for mitigating error accumulation in long-sequence AR generation.

paper.title: Retrospective Progress-Aware Self-Refinement for LLM Agent Training
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents trained with reinforcement learning optimize step-wise action prediction but lack metacognitive awareness of task progress, inducing a gap that hinders long-horizon scaling. A pilot study reveals that online progress prompting hurts performance while retrospective demonstrations help, yet this capability cannot emerge from outcome-reward training alone. We present RePro, Retrospective Progress-Aware Training, a framework that trains agents to self-generate progress signals via a

summary.core_problem: 长时程 agent 的 RL 训练通常只对“每一步选什么动作”给信号，但缺少对“任务进度/是否走在正确轨道上”的可学习表征与训练信号；直接在执行时强行让模型报进度（online progress prompting）反而会引入噪声、干扰决策，导致成功率下降。论文要解决的是：如何让 agent 在不依赖额外模块的情况下，学会可用的进度自评，并把它变成可用于长时程 credit assignment 的稠密训练信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不强（更偏 agent RL / post-train），但对“训练信号设计”和“从轨迹结果反推中间监督”的思路有启发：1）展示了一个清晰的训练动态现象——在线自评会伤性能，而基于完成轨迹的回顾式标注能提升；2）给出一种把稀疏 outcome reward 变成逐步 shaping 信号的构造方式，减少长时程任务的方差；3）对后续把类似的“回顾式自监督”迁移到 mid-train / continual pretrain（例如从长文档生成的最终质量反推段落级质量信号）有参考价值。整体贡献量级属于“训练 recipe + 信号工程”的中等增益，而非范式级改变。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 forward-then-reflect：同一条轨迹分两遍生成。
- Forward：agent 正常与环境交互，在每一步除了动作外还输出一个在线进度估计（如 0-100%）。
- Reflect（Retrospective reassessment）：episode 结束后，已知最终 outcome（成功/失败或得分），模型再回看整段轨迹，对每一步的进度重新评估，得到“回顾式进度”序列。关键假设是：进度在 hindsight 下更可辨别，能作为更可靠的中间监督。
两阶段训练：
1）Retrospection Warmup：用少量外部 LLM 生成的示范，教模型学会回顾式反思的输出格式与基本行为（相当于让模型先学会‘怎么写反思’）。
2）RePro-PO：把回顾式进度用于强化学习的复合奖励（composite reward），包含三类项：
  - retrospective progress shaping：用回顾式进度给每一步分配稠密奖励/惩罚，替代只在终点给 outcome reward 的高方差信号；
  - online-retrospective alignment：约束在线进度与回顾式进度一致，避免在线自评继续成为噪声源；
  - format regularization：约束输出满足进度格式/范围等，减少 reward hacking（例如乱报进度骗 shaping）。
与常见做法的差异：不是额外训练一个 critic/价值函数去做 credit assignment，而是让 policy 自己产生一个可学习的“进度变量”，再用 hindsight 版本把它校准，并把它回灌成逐步奖励。
summary.experiments:
论文先做 pilot study（WebShop，backbone 用 DeepSeek-V4 与 GPT-5.1）：
- Online progress prompting 显著降成功率：DS-v4 35.9%→33.6%；GPT-5.1 44.1%→29.3%；平均约 -8.6%。随机进度与之接近（31.2%、32.4%），说明问题在于在线自评噪声干扰决策。
- Retrospective demonstrations（用完成轨迹+结果做回顾式进度示范，测试时 ICL）提升成功率：DS-v4 35.9%→44.1（+8.2）；GPT-5.1 44.1%→51.6（+7.5）；平均 +7.9%。随机示范仅小幅提升（+2.0、+4.3）。
主实验：在 WebShop / ALFWorld / Sokoban 上、不同模型规模下训练 RePro。WebShop 上相对 baseline RL 训练的绝对成功率提升分别为 +8.98、+11.57、+5.82（对应不同模型大小）。并报告消融均不如完整 RePro（具体消融项包括去掉 shaping / alignment / warmup 等）。
此外做 progress quality 分析：RePro 的进度估计能更好地区分成功与失败轨迹（文中表述为“显著更好”，用于证明学到的是可用的 metacognition，而非格式化输出）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25-35 分钟）：
- 先看 Pilot Study 的实验设置与 Figure 1：这是全文最关键的现象证据，解释了为什么“在线 prompting”不等于“可学习能力”。
- 再看方法部分对 composite reward 的三项分解：重点理解 shaping 如何从 hindsight 进度构造逐步信号，以及 alignment 如何抑制在线噪声。
- 最后看 WebShop 的主结果表与消融：确认增益主要来自哪一项（shaping vs alignment vs warmup），以及是否存在对特定环境的过拟合迹象。
如果只想抓住可迁移思想：把“回顾式可判别信号”蒸馏/对齐到“在线可用信号”，并用它做稠密训练。

summary_en.core_problem: RL-trained LLM agents are typically optimized for step-wise action selection with sparse outcome rewards, but they lack a learnable notion of task progress (what is done, what remains, whether the trajectory is on track). Forcing progress estimation online via prompting introduces noisy self-assessments that disrupt decision-making. The paper targets a concrete question: how to make an agent learn usable progress self-assessment and turn it into dense training signals for long-horizon credit assignment, without adding extra modules.
summary_en.importance: This is more agent RL / post-training than pretraining, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers as a training-signal design case study. It (1) documents a sharp training-time asymmetry: online self-assessment hurts, hindsight-anchored progress helps; (2) provides a recipe to convert sparse terminal rewards into per-step shaping signals using retrospective labels; (3) suggests a general pattern that could transfer to mid-training or continual pretraining: derive intermediate supervision retrospectively from full sequences and align it to an online predictor. The contribution is a solid recipe-level improvement rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RePro uses a forward-then-reflect rollout to generate two progress traces for the same episode.
- Forward pass: the agent interacts with the environment and emits an online progress estimate at each step along with the action.
- Reflect pass: after the episode ends and the final outcome is known, the model revisits the full trajectory and re-estimates step-wise progress retrospectively, producing a hindsight progress sequence that is assumed to be more reliable.
Training has two stages:
1) Retrospection Warmup: a small set of external-LLM demonstrations teaches the model the reflection format and basic behavior.
2) RePro-PO: RL with a composite reward that includes (a) retrospective progress shaping to provide dense per-step signals, (b) online–retrospective alignment to make online progress match the hindsight trace (reducing online noise), and (c) format regularization to prevent degenerate outputs / reward hacking.
Key distinction from standard approaches: instead of adding a separate critic/value model for credit assignment, RePro makes “progress” a policy-emitted latent/auxiliary variable, calibrates it with hindsight, and feeds it back as step-wise reward shaping.
summary_en.experiments:
Pilot study on WebShop with DeepSeek-V4 and GPT-5.1:
- Online progress prompting reduces success: DS-v4 35.9%→33.6%; GPT-5.1 44.1%→29.3% (≈ -8.6% on average). Random progress performs similarly poorly, indicating disruption from unreliable online estimates.
- Retrospective progress demonstrations (ICL with hindsight-annotated trajectories) improve success: DS-v4 35.9%→44.1% (+8.2); GPT-5.1 44.1%→51.6% (+7.5). Random demonstrations yield only small gains.
Main training results across WebShop / ALFWorld / Sokoban and multiple model sizes: on WebShop, RePro improves absolute success over baseline RL by +8.98%, +11.57%, and +5.82% (for different scales). Ablations underperform the full method. Progress-quality analysis shows RePro’s progress estimates better separate successful vs failed trajectories, supporting that the model learns a meaningful metacognitive signal.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the pilot study carefully and inspect Figure 1; it motivates the entire method by showing online prompting is actively harmful.
- In the method section, focus on how the composite reward is constructed (shaping, alignment, format regularization) and why each term is needed.
- Check the main WebShop table plus ablations to see which component drives gains and whether improvements are consistent across scales/environments.
If you want the transferable idea: generate reliable intermediate labels retrospectively from full trajectories, then align an online predictor to them and use the labels for dense shaping.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“结果奖励学不出中间认知变量”这件事讲得较清楚；先看负结果和 ablation，若结论稳，值得迁移到 reasoning/RL 数据设计里。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly probes a useful question: outcome-only RL may fail to induce the right latent state. Read the negative result and ablations first; if they hold, this should inform reasoning/RL data design.

paper.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
paper.abstract: Scientific progress depends on a repeated loop of exploration, experimentation, and abstraction. Researchers test candidate directions, interpret the evidence, and carry the resulting lessons into later attempts. We study how an AI agent can run this loop autonomously over long horizons. We introduce Arbor, a general framework for autonomous research that combines a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR), a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artif

summary.core_problem: 如何让 LLM agent 在长时程、低监督的“研究式优化”任务里持续积累进展：不仅能跑很多次实验，还能把失败/成功的证据沉淀为可复用的研究状态，驱动后续假设空间的收缩与扩展。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限（偏 agent 系统），但它把“长时程实验—证据—记忆—策略更新”做成了可复用框架，并用真实训练/评测/数据合成类任务验证。对做 pretrain recipe 搜索、训练稳定性排障、数据合成迭代、以及 harness/评测工程的团队，这类系统化的研究循环能降低试错成本；同时也提供了一个更贴近真实研发的评测范式（AO：Autonomous Optimization），比单步工具调用更能暴露模型在长期规划、证据归纳、与避免重复试错上的短板。
summary.technical_approach:
Arbor 将自主研究拆成两层：
- 长生命周期 coordinator：维护全局研究状态与策略，决定扩展/剪枝/合并哪些方向，并用 held-out 评测决定是否“晋升”某个候选为当前最优。
- 短生命周期 executors：在隔离的 worktree 中实现并测试单个假设（改代码、跑实验、产出结果），返回结构化证据。

核心机制是 Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR)：一个持久化的“假设树”，节点绑定四类对象：假设、实现该假设的 artifact 版本、实验/评测证据、以及从证据中抽象出的 insight。执行器回传后，系统把证据写回节点，并把可复用的结论向上抽象，更新树的搜索前沿；后续决策在这棵树上进行，而不是把每次尝试当作独立 episode。

与常见 coding agent/科研 agent 的差异点在于：
- 把“研究记忆”结构化为可审计的树（带 artifact 与证据绑定），而不是松散的对话摘要；
- 明确区分探索反馈与最终评分（dev/test protocol），并用 held-out 门槛控制过拟合与投机；
- 用隔离 worktree 降低并行试验的相互污染，使失败也能沉淀为可复用证据。
summary.experiments:
作者构造了 6 个 AO 任务，覆盖模型训练、harness 工程、数据合成等真实研发场景；每个任务给定初始 artifact、自然语言目标、任务原生指标，以及 dev/test 分离的评测协议。

结果层面：
- Arbor 在 6/6 任务上取得最佳 held-out 结果；平均相对增益超过 Codex 与 Claude Code 的 2.5×（在相同接口与资源预算下）。
- 在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，使用 GPT-5.5 达到 86.36% Any Medal（文中宣称为对比中最强）。
- 消融与转移实验的核心结论是：收益主要来自 HTR 的证据结构化与可复用 insight 的传播，而不是单纯“跑更久/试更多”。

（注：你提供的全文片段未包含每个 AO 任务的具体指标曲线、成本统计表与消融细节；若要复现级理解，需要补充实验章节与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 AO 定义与任务协议：它如何把“自主研究”落到可评测的 artifact 改进问题，并用 dev/test 分离约束投机。
- 精看 HTR 的数据结构与更新规则：节点里到底存什么、insight 如何抽象与回流、coordinator 如何据此扩展/剪枝。
- 看 6 个任务的案例页与消融：重点找“没有 HTR 会发生什么”（重复试错、局部最优、证据无法复用）以及 held-out 晋升机制如何影响搜索。
- 如果你关心 pretrain 研发落地：优先看与模型训练/评测 harness 相关的任务设置与成本分析部分。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable an LLM agent to conduct long-horizon autonomous research where progress must accumulate across many experiments—by maintaining a persistent, evidence-grounded research state that refines hypotheses over time rather than treating each attempt as an isolated episode.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an agent-systems contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to pretraining R&D workflows: recipe search, training debugging, evaluation harness iteration, and data synthesis loops. The key value is an operational abstraction (Autonomous Optimization) plus a concrete mechanism for turning experimental outcomes—especially failures—into reusable state that guides future exploration, which is often the missing piece in long-running coding/research agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Arbor is a two-level system:
- A long-lived coordinator that owns global strategy and a persistent research state, and promotes candidates only when they improve held-out evaluation.
- Short-lived executors that implement and test a single hypothesis in an isolated worktree, returning structured evidence.

The central representation is Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR): a persistent tree where each node binds (i) a hypothesis, (ii) the artifact version implementing it, (iii) experimental evidence, and (iv) distilled insights. When executor results return, Arbor writes evidence back to the corresponding node, abstracts reusable lessons upward, and updates the search frontier by expanding, pruning, or merging branches. This differs from typical coding agents by making “research memory” auditable and artifact-linked, enforcing dev/test separation to reduce overfitting, and using isolated worktrees to support parallel, non-interfering trials.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper defines six Autonomous Optimization tasks drawn from real research settings spanning model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis. Each task provides an initial artifact, a natural-language objective, a task-native metric, and a dev/test protocol.

Reported results:
- Best held-out performance on all 6 tasks.
- >2.5× average relative gain over Codex and Claude Code under the same interface and resource budget.
- On MLE-Bench Lite, Arbor reaches 86.36% Any Medal with GPT-5.5 (best among compared systems per the paper).
- Ablations/backbone/transfer/cost analyses attribute gains to the evidence-structured HTR process rather than simply longer execution.

(The excerpt provided does not include per-task metric tables/curves and detailed ablation numbers; those would be needed for reproduction-grade understanding.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the AO problem definition and the dev/test evaluation protocol; this is what makes the setting closer to real research than typical tool-use benchmarks.
- Focus on the HTR specification: what is stored per node, how insights are distilled and propagated, and how the coordinator decides expand/prune/merge.
- Scan the six task case studies and the key ablations showing failure modes without HTR (repeated trials, non-cumulative learning) and the effect of held-out promotion.
- If your interest is pretraining engineering, prioritize the tasks related to model training and evaluation harnesses, plus the cost analysis section.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory/credit assignment 设计，不直接改 pretrain；但若你关心 test-time search 如何反哺训练数据，先看它的 hypothesis tree 抽象。
recommendation.en: This is more about agent memory and credit assignment than pretraining, but the hypothesis-tree abstraction is worth noting if you care about turning test-time search into reusable training signal.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
paper.abstract: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to allevi

summary.core_problem: 如何把 embodied cognition、task planning、grounding、correction 等异构能力收进单一 embodied foundation model，并让它在长时程物理任务中闭环执行与自纠错。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值不在机器人结果本身，而在两个接口：一是 15B token 级别的自动化数据构建与能力覆盖设计，二是多任务平衡 RL recipe 如何缓解异构任务冲突。这更像 post-train/agent 侧对统一基座训练的反馈信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Embodied-R1.5，一个统一 EFM 架构，并配套三条自动数据构建流水线扩展关键能力覆盖；训练上使用 multi-task balanced RL recipe 处理任务冲突；系统上引入 Planner-Grounder-Corrector 闭环，让单模型在长时程任务中规划、定位、执行并自纠错。核心创新偏系统整合与训练配方，而不是新的基础建模范式。
summary.experiments: 模型规模 8B，训练数据系统超过 15B tokens。摘要称其在 24 个 embodied VLM benchmark 中有 16 个达到最优，超过 Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 和 GPT-5.4，并且可用少量数据微调成 VLA。由于结果集中在 embodied benchmark，且摘要未给出消融细节、数据组成和评测 clean setup，结论对基座预训练的可迁移性需要保守看待。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to unify embodied cognition, planning, grounding, and correction inside a single embodied foundation model that can execute and self-correct over long-horizon physical tasks.
summary_en.importance: For a pretraining researcher, the value is not the robotics headline itself but two interfaces: a 15B-token automated data construction system for capability coverage, and a multi-task balanced RL recipe for handling heterogeneous task conflicts. This is mainly a feedback signal from the agent/post-training side into foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embodied-R1.5 is presented as a unified EFM architecture, trained with three automated data construction pipelines to expand capability coverage. On the optimization side, it uses a multi-task balanced RL recipe to reduce cross-task interference. On the system side, it introduces a Planner-Grounder-Corrector loop so a single model can plan, ground, act, and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. The contribution is more about system integration and training recipe than a new core modeling paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 8B parameters and is trained with a data system exceeding 15B tokens. The abstract claims state-of-the-art results on 16 of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, outperforming Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4, and says the model can be fine-tuned into a VLA with little data. Since the evidence is concentrated on embodied benchmarks and the abstract lacks clean ablations, data composition, and evaluation details, transferability to base pretraining should be treated cautiously.

recommendation.zh: 更像 embodied agent 系统整合，不是基座范式论文；只建议看数据构建和 multi-task RL 配方，榜单数字先别太当真。
recommendation.en: This reads more like an embodied-agent integration paper than a base-model paradigm shift; only the data construction and multi-task RL recipe are worth a look, and the benchmark claims should be taken cautiously.

paper.title: Organize then Retrieve: Hierarchical Memory Navigation for Efficient Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their inherent statelessness, requiring all task-relevant information to be encoded in growing input contexts. The resulting degraded reasoning quality, increased inference cost, and higher latency necessitate efficient working memory mechanisms. However, existing approaches either rely on lossy compression or similarity-based retrieval, which often fail to capture temporal structure and causal dependencies required for mu

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 在上下文不断膨胀时，如何保留任务相关细节并高效检索的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 工作记忆设计问题，不直接推进基座预训练，但对长轨迹任务中的记忆组织、检索粒度和时序依赖建模有一定启发，属于系统方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HORMA，将 agent 经验组织成类似文件系统的层级记忆：上层是结构化摘要与实体组织，下层保留原始轨迹；检索时不是单纯相似度召回，而是沿层级结构做导航式访问，从而同时保留抽象概览和可回溯细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其目标场景是多步 agentic 任务，重点比较对象应包括压缩式记忆和相似度检索式记忆。论文主张该方法在推理质量、延迟和上下文成本之间取得更好平衡，但从摘要看不到是否覆盖强基线、是否做了足够干净的长轨迹消融，因此结论更适合作为系统设计信号而非稳定方法学结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Duke University 和 Snowflake AI Research。Yuxiong He 在大模型系统与训练基础设施方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to preserve task-relevant details while retrieving efficiently for long-horizon LLM agents whose context keeps growing over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a working-memory design problem for agents. It does not directly advance foundation-model pretraining, but it offers some useful ideas on memory organization, retrieval granularity, and temporal dependency handling in long trajectories. The contribution is mainly a systems/method design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HORMA, which organizes agent experience into a file-system-like hierarchy: upper levels store structured summaries and entities, while lower levels keep raw trajectories. Retrieval is done through navigation over the hierarchy rather than pure similarity search, aiming to combine abstract overview with recoverable detail.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the target setting is multi-step agentic tasks, likely compared against compression-based memory and similarity-retrieval baselines. The claimed gains are better reasoning quality, latency, and context efficiency trade-offs. But the abstract does not reveal whether the baselines are strong enough or whether the long-horizon ablations are clean, so the result is more a systems signal than a robust methodological conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Duke University and Snowflake AI Research. Yuxiong He is well known for large-model systems and training infrastructure work.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但如果你在做 agent memory 或长轨迹上下文管理，只看方法图和检索消融即可，别把它当成可迁移到 pretrain 的强结论。
recommendation.en: Limited value for pretraining itself; if you care about agent memory or long-trajectory context management, read the method figure and retrieval ablations only, and do not overgeneralize it into a pretraining result.

paper.title: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities as autonomous agents across a wide range of tasks, their performance often degrades in multi-turn long-horizon agentic tasks. Existing methods have made progress through fine-grained credit assignment to alleviate long-horizon sparse rewards and hierarchical reinforcement learning to decompose tasks and reduce long-term dependency. However, these methods still do not directly address long-context interference, in which cont

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是长程 agent 任务中的上下文干扰。许多 LLM agent 在多轮交互中持续把完整 observation-action 历史塞回上下文，历史越长，冗余信息越多，模型越难判断当前任务阶段，也更容易在后续规划和执行中漂移。HIPIF 关注的不是单纯稀疏奖励或 credit assignment，而是训练模型学会分解子目标，并把已完成子目标的历史压缩成可用进度。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更偏 agent post-training，但对预训练研究有间接启发。长上下文不只是长度问题，也是状态组织问题；把所有历史保留下来并不一定提高能力，可能降低决策质量。HIPIF 给出一个训练信号设计思路：让模型显式维护任务层级和压缩后的工作记忆，而不是依赖外部 memory 模块或额外规划模型。这个思路可迁移到长上下文预训练数据构造、轨迹压缩训练、latent state tracking 和 agentic continual learning。
summary.technical_approach: HIPIF 使用端到端训练，让 agent 围绕显式子目标执行。传统 ReAct 式 agent 在第 t 步通常条件化于完整历史；HIPIF 改为维护一个紧凑工作上下文，由当前子目标、当前子目标内的必要交互、以及已经折叠的全局进度组成。模型先提出初始子目标，然后在环境中执行动作；当它判断当前子目标已完成或应终止时，就把该子目标对应的执行历史折叠成摘要，再提出下一个子目标。为了降低子目标切换的不稳定性，方法加入 hierarchical reflection：模型需要反思当前子目标是否完成、是否需要修正，以及下一步应继续执行还是重新规划。训练侧使用 GRPO 进行子目标中心的决策优化，并引入 subgoal-oriented process rewards，分别约束子目标生成质量和子目标内执行质量。相比只做稀疏终局奖励、外部 process reward 标注或额外分解模型的方法，HIPIF 的重点是把规划、折叠、反思和执行都压到同一个 agent 策略中训练。
summary.experiments: 论文在 3 个公开 agentic benchmark 上做实验，并报告了效率分析和 case study。根据给出的全文片段，HIPIF 相比常规长历史 agent 能减少 token 使用，同时不依赖任务专属专家轨迹，也不需要额外辅助模型。实验意图是验证两点：一是显式子目标和信息折叠可以缓解长上下文干扰；二是层级反思与子目标过程奖励能提高子目标切换和子目标内执行的稳定性。片段中没有提供具体 benchmark 名称、模型参数量、训练数据规模和数值提升，因此不能补充未确认结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中三块：Subgoal-Level Information Folding、Hierarchical Reflection、Subgoal-Oriented Process Rewards。Algorithm 1 值得扫一遍，主要看训练循环如何把子目标生成、执行、折叠和 GRPO 更新串起来。实验部分优先看消融：去掉 information folding、去掉 reflection、去掉 process rewards 后性能和 token 使用如何变化。若关注长上下文训练，case study 里哪些历史被折叠、哪些信息被保留，比总分更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-context interference in long-horizon LLM agents. Standard agents keep appending the full observation-action history to the prompt. As the interaction grows, redundant and stale information makes it harder to track the current task stage and degrades planning. HIPIF focuses on training the agent to decompose the task into subgoals and compress completed progress, rather than only improving sparse-reward credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent post-training paper, but it offers a useful signal for foundation-model researchers working on long-context learning and trajectory data. Longer context is not always better if the model is not trained to organize state. HIPIF suggests that models should learn an explicit hierarchy of task state and compact progress summaries, instead of relying on an external memory component or a separate planner. The same idea is relevant to long-context pretraining data design, trajectory summarization objectives, latent state tracking, and continual agent learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: HIPIF trains an agent end to end around explicit subgoals. A conventional ReAct-style policy conditions each decision on the entire accumulated trajectory. HIPIF instead keeps a compact working context composed of the current subgoal, the necessary local interaction history for that subgoal, and a folded summary of completed progress. The model proposes an initial subgoal, executes actions under that subgoal, and decides when the subgoal is completed or should be terminated. Once a subgoal ends, its execution history is folded into a progress summary, and the model proposes the next subgoal. To make this stable, the method adds hierarchical reflection for judging subgoal completion, correcting subgoal content, and deciding whether to continue execution or replan. Training uses GRPO for subgoal-centric decisions and introduces subgoal-oriented process rewards for both subgoal generation and within-subgoal execution. The main difference from methods using only terminal rewards, external process-reward annotators, or auxiliary decomposition models is that planning, folding, reflection, and execution are trained within the same agent policy.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on three public agentic benchmarks, along with efficiency analysis and case studies. From the supplied text, HIPIF reduces token usage in long-horizon interactions and does not require task-specific expert trajectories or additional auxiliary models. The experimental design is meant to test whether explicit subgoals and information folding reduce long-context interference, and whether hierarchical reflection plus subgoal-oriented process rewards stabilize subgoal transitions and execution. The provided content does not include exact benchmark names, model sizes, training scale, or numerical gains, so those numbers should be checked in the result tables before citing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the methodology parts covering subgoal-level information folding, hierarchical reflection, and subgoal-oriented process rewards. Algorithm 1 is useful for understanding how subgoal proposal, execution, folding, and GRPO updates are connected. In the experiments, prioritize ablations that remove folding, reflection, or process rewards, and compare both task success and token usage. For long-context training, the case studies may be more informative than the aggregate score because they show what gets compressed and what remains in the active context.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；若 folding token 的训练信号干净，它会影响长上下文 agent 训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and ablations; if the folding-token supervision is clean, it matters for long-context agent training recipes.

paper.title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate observations, reasoning traces, and retrieved facts that exceed their finite context windows, making memory retention a fundamental resource-allocation problem. Existing memory systems improve management through heuristic scoring, retrieval optimization, or learned compression, but largely treat retention as a local decision problem and do not explicitly model its long-term consequences under realistic observability constraints. To fill this gap, we formul

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程语言智能体在有限上下文窗口下，如何在保留记忆时同时考虑预算约束、未来遗漏代价和信息陈旧风险的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 agent memory 管理方法论文，贡献不在预训练本身，而在把记忆保留从启发式打分改写为带约束的随机优化问题，并强调训练时可见监督与部署时可观测特征必须严格分离，避免 offline-only 信号泄漏到在线决策。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OSL-MR（Observability-Safe Learning for Memory Retention）。核心做法是定义 observability-safe 的训练框架：在线策略只能使用部署时可观测特征，离线监督只用于训练 evidence learner；再结合预算可行性、证据效用、miss penalty、重新获取延迟和 stale risk 等延迟成本，学习记忆保留策略，而不是逐条局部打分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和主 baseline 数字。可确认的是，评测围绕长时程 agent memory retention，比较对象应包括启发式记忆打分、检索优化或压缩式记忆系统；论文主张其方法在现实可观测约束下更稳健，但缺少摘要级别的量化结果，需读正文确认 setup 是否干净、收益是否来自更强监督而非 formulation 本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles memory retention for long-horizon language agents under finite context windows, where retention decisions must account for budget limits, delayed miss costs, and stale-information risk.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-memory paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its main contribution is to cast memory retention as a constrained stochastic optimization problem and to enforce a strict separation between offline supervision and online-observable features, which is a useful systems principle.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes OSL-MR, an observability-safe framework for memory retention. The method trains an evidence learner from realized supervision available offline, while constraining the deployed policy to use only online-observable signals. The objective explicitly models budget feasibility, evidence utility, miss penalties, reacquisition delay, and stale-memory costs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset sizes, or concrete gains. The evaluation appears to compare against heuristic scoring, retrieval-based memory management, and learned compression baselines in long-horizon agent settings. The claimed benefit is robustness under realistic observability constraints, but the quantitative strength and cleanliness of the setup need verification in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 帮助有限，但“训练可见信号与部署可观测信号分离”这个约束很干净，做 agent memory 或 RL 数据闭环的人可只看 formulation。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the train-time vs deploy-time observability split is a clean idea; worth skimming the formulation if you work on agent memory or RL data loops.

paper.title: SWE-Marathon: Can Agents Autonomously Complete Ultra-Long-Horizon Software Work?
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to complete long-horizon workflows that require sustained progress over hours, millions of tokens, and complex environments. Yet current agent benchmarks largely evaluate short-form tasks, such as single pull requests, small tickets, or 5-10 minute exercises, limiting our ability to measure agents' capabilities in planning, long-context understanding, and memory use. We introduce SWE-Marathon, a benchmark of 20 long-horizon tasks spanning software engineering

summary.core_problem: 如何评测coding agents在“超长时程、数千万token、持续数小时”的软件工程任务中的自主完成能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是benchmark与评测协议：把SWE评测从“单PR/短ticket”推到长时程，直接暴露长上下文、记忆、验证与终止策略的系统性短板；对训练/后训练如何对齐长链路行为也有反向约束。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Marathon：20个长时程任务，每个任务提供可执行环境、人写参考解、分层验证套件；通过记录真实agent尝试日志，统计token消耗、成功率与失败模式（自验证差、误判不可行、过早终止等）。
summary.experiments: 基准规模：20 tasks；日志平均总token约27.2M/attempt（远超常见SWE-bench类）；当前前沿coding agents完成率<30%；并给出失败原因分布与现象性观察（摘要级信息，具体模型/设置需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate coding agents on ultra-long-horizon software work that spans hours and tens of millions of tokens.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/evaluation contribution: pushes SWE evaluation beyond short PR/ticket tasks, surfacing systematic weaknesses in long-context use, memory, self-verification, and termination policies—useful constraints for post-training and agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Marathon: 20 long-horizon tasks, each with an executable environment, a human-written reference solution, and a multi-layer verification suite; analyzes logged agent attempts to characterize token usage, success rates, and failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: 20 tasks; average logged attempts consume ~27.2M tokens; frontier coding agents solve <30% of tasks; reported failure patterns include weak self-verification, self-declared infeasibility, and premature termination (model/config details require the paper).

recommendation.zh: 把“长链路=长上下文”这件事测得更狠：重点看验证套件设计和失败归因，能直接指导你做长时程agent的训练信号与终止策略。
recommendation.en: A harsher, more realistic long-horizon SWE eval—focus on the verification suite and failure taxonomy; it directly informs training signals and termination policies for long-running agents.

paper.title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents
paper.abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, they must coordinate with others over long horizons in open-ended interactive tasks. Yet existing evaluations rarely test these demands together, instead emphasising single-agent tasks, short interactions, or highly structured multi-agent settings. We introduce $alem$, a JAX-based benchmark for open-ended multi-agent coordination built on Craftax-like dynamics. Alem embeds procedurally generated coordination tasks, soft specialis

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM agent 评测多关注单智能体、短交互或高度结构化场景，缺乏长程开放式多智能体协调能力的系统性 benchmark。
summary.importance: 构造了 alem 基准（JAX实现，基于 Craftax 动力学），融合程序化生成、专业化分工、通信与可控难度，是首个面向 LLM 多智能体长程协调的基准之一。贡献类型为 Benchmark 贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 构建长程生存世界（探索、制作、交易、战斗），嵌入程序化生成的协调任务；提供同质多智能体团队的零样本评测协议，并以训练过的 MARL 智能体为参考点。
summary.experiments: 评测 13 个现代 LLM（零样本，同质团队）。关键结果：LLM 平均仅约 6% 归一化收益；在最难协调设置中，Gemini-3.1-Pro-High 接近训练了 10 亿步的 MARL 智能体性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Amos Storkey、Tim Rocktäschel、Henry Gouk 等知名学者，来自爱丁堡大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluations focus on single-agent, short-interaction, or highly structured settings; no benchmark systematically tests long-horizon open-ended multi-agent coordination.
summary_en.importance: Introduces alem, a JAX-based benchmark built on Craftax-like dynamics with procedurally generated tasks, specialization, communication, and controllable difficulty. First benchmark specifically targeting LLM multi-agent long-horizon coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: Long-horizon survival world (exploration, crafting, trading, combat) with procedurally embedded coordination tasks. Evaluates zero-shot LLM agents in homogeneous teams using trained MARL agents as reference.
summary_en.experiments: 13 modern LLMs evaluated zero-shot in homogeneous teams. LLM agents average ~6% normalized return; in hardest coordination settings, Gemini-3.1-Pro-High approaches MARL agents trained for 1B steps.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Amos Storkey, Tim Rocktäschel, Henry Gouk; from University of Edinburgh and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体协调 benchmark 设计扎实，尤其是 MARL 作为参考基线的方法学值得参考；读 §3 环境设计和 §4 评测结果即可。
recommendation.en: Strong multi-agent coordination benchmark methodology, especially the MARL reference-baseline approach. Read §3 environment design and §4 results only.

paper.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly operate in runtimes that combine visual desktop control, command-line execution, code editing, browsers, and external tools. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate these interfaces as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested. Thus, we introduce WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable arti

summary.core_problem: 现有 Computer-Use Agent 评测往往将 GUI、CLI、代码编辑等接口作为独立能力测试，缺乏长程跨接口协同的真实工作流 benchmark。
summary.importance: 提出首个面向混合接口长程任务的 CUA benchmark + 轨迹感知评测器，填补了真实桌面工作流下跨接口编排能力的评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 114 个来自 8 个真实工作域的任务，要求单个轨迹中组合 GUI 观察/动作与 CLI/代码操作；配套轨迹感知 judge 检查交付物/文件/截图/日志/动作轨迹，并检测伪造视觉证据、硬编码指标等捷径行为。
summary.experiments: 在真实 Ubuntu 桌面 + CLI-agent runtime + 最小桌面控制插件中评测前沿模型-运行时组合，给出当前模型在此类长程跨接口任务上的基线表现。
summary.authors_note: Wanli Li 等，机构未从摘要中直接确认（可能来自 MSRA/国内高校）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks treat GUI, CLI, and code editing as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested.
summary_en.importance: First long-horizon hybrid-interface CUA benchmark with a trajectory-aware judge, filling the gap for real-world cross-interface workflow evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 114 tasks across 8 real work domains requiring combined GUI observation/action and CLI/code operation in a single trajectory; a trajectory-aware judge inspects deliverables, files, screenshots, logs, action traces and detects shortcuts like fabricated visual evidence or hard-coded metrics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a real Ubuntu desktop inside a CLI-agent runtime augmented with a minimal desktop-control plugin; baseline results across frontier model-runtime combinations are reported.
summary_en.authors_note: Wanli Li et al. Institutional affiliation not directly stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计扎实，尤其短检测部分对 agent evaluation 有借鉴；只看 benchmark 构造章节和 judge 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Solid evaluation design, especially the shortcut detection is informative for agent evaluation practice; read the benchmark construction and judge design sections only.

paper.title: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents operating over long horizons ingest raw DOM and accessibility trees -- routinely tens of thousands of tokens -- at every action step, causing progressive context degradation that erodes reasoning well before tasks complete. We argue that this coupling of observation frequency to action frequency is an architectural mistake. Drawing on the insight from Recursive Language Models that querying a document outperforms reading it wholesale, we propose Signal-Driven Observation (SDO): a dedi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注长程 web agent 的一个结构性问题：每一步动作都重新吞下整棵 DOM / accessibility tree，会让上下文迅速膨胀并在任务完成前就损伤推理。
summary.importance: 价值在于它把“观察频率应不应等于动作频率”明确提出为 agent 架构问题，而不是单纯靠更长上下文硬扛。对做长上下文、检索式读写分离和 agent memory 的研究员有一点启发，但离基座 pretrain 仍较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Signal-Driven Observation（SDO）：引入一个专门的子调用读取完整 DOM，但只返回与当前任务相关的元素及 selector；并且只有在信号检测器触发时才重新观察，例如 URL 变化、新交互元素出现、动作失败或外部浏览器事件。核心思想是把 observation compression 作为架构层决策。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，这更像方法提案或立场论文，未看到完整 benchmark、模型规模或量化结果。实验部分大概率不是重点，主要贡献是问题定义与设计原则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural issue in long-horizon web agents: re-ingesting full DOM and accessibility trees at every action step causes context bloat and degrades reasoning before tasks finish.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is conceptual: observation frequency should not necessarily equal action frequency. That is mildly relevant to researchers thinking about long-context architectures, retrieval-style reading, and agent memory, though it is still far from core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Signal-Driven Observation (SDO) adds a dedicated sub-call that reads the full DOM but returns only task-relevant elements and selectors. Re-observation happens only when a lightweight signal detector fires, such as on URL transitions, newly visible interactive elements, action failures, or exogenous browser events.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, this looks more like an architectural proposal or position paper than a fully validated benchmark-heavy study. No concrete model sizes, datasets, or quantitative gains are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 想法是对的：agent 不该每步全量读页面；但目前更像 design memo，不像完成度高的论文，知道这个分离观察/行动的 framing 就够了。
recommendation.en: The framing is right—agents should not fully reread the page every step—but this reads more like a design memo than a finished paper; keep the observation/action decoupling idea and move on.

paper.title: TRACE: Trajectory Reasoning through Adaptive Cross-Step Evidence Aggregation for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents can pursue hidden malicious objectives through sequences of individually benign actions, making sabotage difficult to detect using standard trajectory-level monitoring. Existing approaches either evaluate complete trajectories in a single pass or partition them into independently scored windows, limiting their ability to connect evidence across temporally distant actions. We propose TRACE, a monitoring framework for long-horizon LLM agent trajectories. TRACE operates throug

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 轨迹中恶意目标难以被发现的问题，尤其是当每一步单看都无害、但跨步组合后才显露破坏意图时。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 监控与安全方向的方法工作，贡献在于长轨迹证据聚合机制。对通用 agent 安全评测有一定价值，但和基座预训练方法关系较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TRACE，通过 TIJ（Triage-Inspect-Judge）循环做轨迹监控：先定位高信号片段，再做针对性检查，同时在推理过程中保留跨步骤累积证据，最后给出轨迹级判决。重点是 adaptive cross-step evidence aggregation，而不是单次整轨迹打分或固定窗口独立评分。
summary.experiments: 在 SHADE-Arena 的 10 个任务域上与现有基线比较，TRACE 达到 aggregate F1 0.713、recall 0.844；对需要长距离证据连接的任务提升最大。摘要未给出 backbone、成本和误报细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UMass Amherst、Adobe Research、Dolby Labs 和 University of Oregon。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of detecting hidden malicious objectives in long-horizon LLM agent trajectories, where each individual action may look benign in isolation.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent monitoring and safety paper. Its contribution is a mechanism for aggregating evidence across long trajectories. It has some value for general agent safety evaluation, but only weak relevance to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRACE introduces a TIJ (Triage-Inspect-Judge) loop for trajectory monitoring: identify high-signal regions, inspect them selectively, maintain accumulated evidence across reasoning steps, and then issue a trajectory-level verdict. The key idea is adaptive cross-step evidence aggregation rather than one-shot whole-trajectory scoring or fixed-window independent scoring.
summary_en.experiments: On ten task domains from SHADE-Arena, TRACE reaches aggregate F1 0.713 and recall 0.844 against state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains on tasks requiring long-range evidence linking. The abstract does not provide backbone, cost, or false-positive details.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from UMass Amherst, Adobe Research, Dolby Labs, and the University of Oregon.

recommendation.zh: Agent 安全监控的工程招法，和预训练关系不大；记住“跨步证据累积优于窗口独立打分”这个点即可，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Mostly an agent-safety engineering paper; keep the 'cross-step evidence beats independent windows' takeaway and skip the full read.

paper.title: AdaMEM: Test-Time Adaptive Memory for Language Agents
paper.abstract: A central challenge for language agents is utilizing past experience to adapt to dynamic test-time conditions. While recent work demonstrates the promise of agentic memory mechanisms, most systems restrict retrieval to episode initiation. Consequently, agents are forced to rely on static guidance that becomes increasingly misaligned as long-horizon tasks unfold. To address this rigidity, we propose the Adaptive Memory Agent (AdaMEM), a novel framework for agent test-time adaptation. Without upda

summary.core_problem: 语言Agent在长程任务中过度依赖初始时刻检索的静态记忆指导，与动态变化的任务条件越来越脱节；需要在不更新模型参数的前提下实现测试时自适应。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出混合记忆架构（长期轨迹记忆+动态短期策略记忆），实现Agent行为在测试时的自适应调整，并允许在token效率和适应性之间根据推理计算量进行权衡。
summary.technical_approach: AdaMEM（Adaptive Memory Agent）框架：离线收集原始经验形成长期轨迹记忆；在线动态生成短期策略记忆以指导决策；两种记忆结合实现推理时计算水平变化下的token效率与适应性权衡。
summary.experiments: 在Agent基准测试中相对静态记忆基线提升高达13%；摘要被截断，具体基准名称和模型规模未完整给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Yunxiang Zhang, Yiheng Li, Ali Payani, Lu Wang；无法从摘要中确认机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Language agents rely on static memory guidance retrieved at episode initiation, becoming increasingly misaligned as long-horizon tasks unfold; test-time adaptation is needed without online parameter updates.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: hybrid memory architecture (long-term trajectory memory + dynamic short-term strategy memory) enabling test-time adaptation with trade-offs between token efficiency and adaptability across inference compute levels.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaMEM framework: offline-collected raw experiences form long-term trajectory memory; dynamic short-term strategy memory generated on-the-fly to guide decision-making; the two memories combine for compute-aware adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: Up to 13% relative gain over static memory baselines on agent benchmarks; abstract truncated, specific benchmark names and model sizes incomplete.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors: Yunxiang Zhang, Yiheng Li, Ali Payani, Lu Wang; institution not identifiable from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 推理时动态记忆分配有一定启发，对思考test-time scaling的内存-计算权衡有参考价值，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Dynamic memory allocation at test time is somewhat relevant for thinking about memory-compute tradeoffs in test-time scaling; skim abstract and tables only.

paper.title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
paper.abstract: LLM agents are rapidly evolving from coding assistants into autonomous software engineering systems. However, existing evaluation methodologies remain largely centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. As a result, benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative f

summary.core_problem: 解决现有软件工程 agent 评测过于静态、短程、脱离生产环境，导致 benchmark 分数无法反映真实运行时能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测基础设施工作，贡献类型是 runtime evaluation protocol 与执行平台。对预训练研究员不是主线，但如果关心 post-train 后 agent 能力是否真实可迁移，这类长时程、工具交互型评测比静态题集更接近部署约束。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RAMP，一个面向生产系统的长时程软件工程 agent 运行时评测框架。它基于统一编排与执行接口，提供真实编译器构建类任务、串行依赖、复杂工具链交互，以及 staged recovery 机制，用于分析 agent 在部分错误后的恢复与继续执行能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调其评测环境包含长执行链、工具调用、依赖管理和迭代反馈回路，任务设定比传统 benchmark 更接近真实生产工作流。当前摘要未给出参与评测的模型、样本规模和量化结果，因此更像评测资产发布而非结论型论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between static short-horizon software-agent benchmarks and real production behavior, where benchmark scores often fail to reflect runtime capability.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation infrastructure paper, contributing a runtime evaluation protocol and execution platform. It is not central for pretraining, but if you care whether post-trained agent skills transfer to deployment, long-horizon tool-interaction evaluation is more informative than static benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RAMP, a production-grounded runtime assessment framework for long-horizon software engineering agents. It provides unified orchestration and execution interfaces, realistic compiler-construction workloads, serial dependencies, complex toolchain interactions, and a staged recovery mechanism to analyze how agents recover from partial failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes long execution chains, tool use, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops, making the setup closer to production workflows than standard benchmarks. The abstract does not provide evaluated models, dataset size, or quantitative results, so this currently reads more like an evaluation asset release than a conclusion-heavy paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像评测基建，不是方法论文；知道有这么个 runtime SWE 评测就够了，除非你正做 agent eval 平台。
recommendation.en: This is evaluation plumbing rather than a method paper; know it exists, and only read deeper if you're building agent runtime eval infrastructure.

paper.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and apply

summary.core_problem: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的 GUI 智能体在处理多帧高分辨率截图时，KV Cache 会随交互步数线性增长，导致显存耗尽（如 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 处理 5 张截图即消耗 76GB 显存）。现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法假设所有注意力头共享单一显著性图，且采用固定的 Top-B 截断策略，这在 GUI 场景下会导致空间布局信息丢失和分布漂移问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 GUI 场景下注意力机制的两个核心特性：子空间级别的空间特化（Spatial Specialization）和随时间步漂移的注意力熵（Entropy Drift）。提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的 KV Cache 压缩方案，为长上下文 GUI 智能体的部署提供了实用的显存优化手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STaR-KV 框架，包含三个核心机制：1) 在线空间分析（Online Spatial Profiling）：计算注意力子空间与 2D 屏幕坐标的互信息，保留对布局敏感的子空间信息；2) 累积时间稳定性衰减（Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount）：根据子空间在多帧间的稳定性，对历史视觉 Token 进行加权，抑制静态 UI 元素的冗余缓存，保留动态组件的 Token；3) 自适应熵锐化（Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening）：根据注意力分布的归一化熵动态调整温度参数，替代固定的 Top-B 截断，在平缓分布下避免任意截断，在尖峰分布下增强选择性。
summary.experiments: 在多个 GUI 智能体基准测试上，STaR-KV 无需微调即可应用于 UI-TARS 和 OpenCUA 等模型。在相同的显存预算下，其平均性能优于现有的 SOTA KV 压缩方法（如 GUIKV、SnapKV）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Pilot 1 和 Pilot 2，这两个实验清晰地揭示了现有方法的盲区。Method 部分详细阐述了三个核心机制的实现细节，特别是互信息的计算和自适应熵锐化的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks due to the linear growth of KV cache with interaction steps when processing multiple high-resolution screenshots (e.g., UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76GB for just 5 screenshots). Existing KV cache compression methods assume a shared saliency map across all attention heads and apply a fixed Top-B cutoff, which leads to the loss of spatial layout information and distribution drift issues in GUI scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Reveals two core characteristics of attention mechanisms in GUI scenarios: subspace-level spatial specialization and entropy drift over time steps. Proposes a training-free, plug-and-play KV cache compression scheme, providing a practical memory optimization solution for deploying long-context GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STaR-KV framework, featuring three core mechanisms: 1) Online Spatial Profiling: Calculates the mutual information between attention subspaces and 2D screen coordinates to preserve layout-sensitive subspace information; 2) Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount: Weights historical visual tokens based on the stability of their governing subspaces across frames, suppressing redundant cache entries from static UI elements while preserving tokens of dynamic components; 3) Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening (AEB): Dynamically adjusts the temperature parameter based on the normalized entropy of the attention distribution, replacing the fixed Top-B cutoff to avoid arbitrary truncation in flat distributions and enhance selectivity in peaky ones.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple GUI agent benchmarks, STaR-KV can be directly applied to models like UI-TARS and OpenCUA without fine-tuning. Under matched memory budgets, it achieves stronger average performance than SOTA KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Pilot 1 and Pilot 2 in the Introduction, which clearly reveal the blind spots of existing methods. The Method section details the implementation of the three core mechanisms, especially the calculation of mutual information and the design of adaptive entropy sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pilot measurements 和压缩策略即可；它对“统一视觉 saliency + 固定 top-B”的反例比较有用。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot measurements and compression policy; the useful part is the counterexample to global visual saliency plus fixed top-B pruning.

paper.title: HLL: Can Agents Cross Humanity's Last Line of Verification?

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“CAPTCHA 识别率”本身，而是更接近部署边界的问题：多模态 GUI/Web agent 能否在真实服务设置的人机验证关口前，完成一整套感知—定位—交互—验证闭环，并且不是靠偶然猜中最终答案，而是靠可被验证的、符合规则的交互过程通过检查。现有 agent benchmark 往往把验证码过滤掉，或把它当成边缘障碍；而现有 CAPTCHA 工作又常把问题收缩成静态识别或单次 pass rate。HLL 试图把“最后一道人类验证边界”单独抽出来，做成一个可控、可诊断、可复现实验环境。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 能力评测和多模态模型部署边界有直接价值。价值主要有三层。第一，它把一个过去常被 benchmark 回避、但现实系统一定会遇到的瓶颈显式化了。第二，它强调过程有效性而不是只看最终答对，这一点对今后的 agent eval 很重要，因为很多 GUI 任务都存在“结果对了但过程不可信”的问题。第三，它提供了一个较干净的 stress test，用来拆分多模态 agent 在视觉理解、空间 grounding、动作执行、状态跟踪和交互一致性上的失效来源。对做预训练的人，启发不在于“要不要训练解验证码”，而在于：当前多模态模型的能力缺口，往往不在语义识别，而在受约束交互和闭环一致性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，HLL 的核心设计是“因子化 realism”，而不是简单堆更多验证码样式。它把 CAPTCHA 任务组织成 10 个 family，并沿三条正交轴控制难度：一是任务内在难度，二是网页干扰程度，三是动态交互验证。前两者比较直观，第三点更关键：在动态设置里，系统不只检查最终提交内容是否语义正确，还通过统一 submission payload 收集结构化 telemetry，再按 family-specific 规则判断代理是否进行了足够且有效的交互。例如是否真的点击了目标区域、是否完成了拖拽轨迹、是否满足交互顺序或状态变化要求。这样一来，benchmark 不再把“答对”视为单一事件，而是把它拆成 perception、localization、grounded action、state tracking、validation consistency 几个环节。

从评测接口看，作者把 HLL 做成轻量、agent-agnostic 的环境层，目标是尽量少改动就能接到 web-agent 或 mobile-agent pipeline 上。这一点说明它更像评测基础设施，而不是某个特定模型的 showcase。论文还强调 controlled realism：不是直接抓取野生网站验证码，而是在可控环境里系统调节 clutter、页面布局干扰和验证规则，从而让失败模式可归因。这个取舍是合理的，因为真实网页虽然更“野”，但变量太多，不利于比较不同 agent 或 memory/policy 设计。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结论看，实验重点不是刷新某个单一分数，而是证明 HLL 具有区分度，并揭示前沿 agent 在更真实交互约束下会系统性退化。作者比较了不同 CAPTCHA family、不同难度档、是否存在页面干扰、以及静态验证与动态验证两种设置。主要观察是：在干净、静态、低难度条件下，一些 agent 能取得看起来还可以的通过率；但一旦加入 clutter、需要更精确的 grounded interaction，或要求提交结果与交互证据一致，性能会明显下降。论文还给出 failure taxonomy，说明失败并不都来自视觉识别错误，很多失败来自点击定位偏差、拖拽/多步操作不稳定、状态更新理解错误，以及最终答案与实际交互轨迹不一致。

就你给出的全文片段来看，具体数值、参与评测的 agent 名单、各 family 的 pass rate、以及动态验证带来的绝对降幅没有完整展开，因此不适合编造数字。精读时应重点核对实验章节中的：1）十类 CAPTCHA 的任务分布；2）clean vs cluttered、static vs dynamic 的分层结果；3）failure taxonomy 对应的定量占比；4）统一 telemetry 规则是否会对不同 family 产生评测偏置。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐行啃实现。建议先看 Introduction，把作者为何把 CAPTCHA 定义为“human-substitution boundary”这件事吃透。然后直接看 Benchmark 设计部分，重点看三条 realism 轴和 dynamic validation 的定义，这是整篇最有信息量的地方。接着看实验里的分层结果和 failure taxonomy，判断 benchmark 是否真的测到了“交互闭环”而不是换皮视觉题。最后再看环境实现和集成方式，确认它对现有 web/mobile agent pipeline 的接入成本。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，优先看：Figure 1/2 一类的任务示意图、benchmark protocol、dynamic telemetry 规则、主结果表、错误类型分析。真正值得深挖的问题有两个：一是过程验证如何避免把 benchmark 变成手工规则游戏；二是这种评测能否迁移到更一般的高风险 GUI 操作，而不局限于 CAPTCHA。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not really about CAPTCHA recognition in isolation. It asks a deployment-facing question: can multimodal agents cross the human-verification boundary that real services intentionally place in front of account creation, search, form submission, or transactions? The key difficulty is end-to-end interaction under constraints. An agent must perceive the challenge, localize the target region, execute grounded actions, track state changes, and satisfy validation rules. Existing agent benchmarks usually remove CAPTCHAs, while prior CAPTCHA work often reduces the problem to static recognition or pass rate. HLL turns this missing bottleneck into a controlled benchmark.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it exposes a real deployment bottleneck that many agent benchmarks sidestep. Second, it shifts evaluation from final-answer correctness to process validity. That distinction is important for multimodal agents, because a correct final answer can still come from an invalid or non-grounded interaction trace. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is not that models should be trained to solve CAPTCHAs, but that current capability gaps often lie in constrained interaction, grounding precision, and consistency between perception, action, and verification, rather than in semantic recognition alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central design choice is factorized realism. Instead of collecting many CAPTCHA styles and reporting one aggregate score, HLL organizes ten CAPTCHA families and varies evaluation along three orthogonal axes: intrinsic task difficulty, webpage distraction, and dynamic interaction validation. The third axis is the most interesting. In dynamic settings, the benchmark does not only check whether the submitted answer is semantically correct. It also collects structured telemetry through a unified submission payload and applies family-specific rules to verify whether the answer is supported by sufficient and valid interaction evidence. This turns evaluation into a probe of the full perception-action loop: perception, localization, grounded action, state tracking, and validation consistency.

The benchmark is implemented as a lightweight, agent-agnostic environment layer, intended to plug into both web-agent and mobile-agent pipelines with limited adaptation. That makes it closer to evaluation infrastructure than to a model-specific demo. Another good design choice is controlled realism. Rather than relying on uncontrolled wild websites, the authors vary clutter, surrounding-page distraction, and validation rules in a controlled environment, which makes failures more attributable and comparisons cleaner.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mainly diagnostic. The paper shows that frontier agents degrade systematically once CAPTCHA solving is evaluated as a realistic interaction problem rather than a recognition problem. The comparisons span CAPTCHA families, difficulty levels, clean versus cluttered pages, and static versus dynamic validation. The main pattern is that some agents can achieve non-trivial pass rates in clean, static, easier settings, but performance drops when clutter is introduced, when precise grounded interaction is required, or when the benchmark checks consistency between the final answer and the actual interaction trace. The failure taxonomy suggests that many errors are not pure visual failures. They come from mislocalization, unstable dragging or multi-step interaction, incorrect state tracking, and mismatch between the submitted answer and the executed actions.

The full text excerpt provided here does not include the exact tables, model roster, or numerical deltas, so it would be unsafe to invent specific numbers. When reading the paper, the most important quantitative checks are: per-family pass rates, clean vs. cluttered gaps, static vs. dynamic gaps, and the distribution of failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and make sure the framing is clear: CAPTCHA is treated as a human-substitution boundary, not a niche vision task. Then go straight to the benchmark section and focus on the three realism axes, especially dynamic validation and telemetry-based checking. After that, read the main results and the failure taxonomy to see whether the benchmark is really measuring closed-loop interaction rather than repackaged visual recognition. Finally, inspect the environment layer and integration details if you care about reproducibility or adoption.

If you only have 20 to 30 minutes, prioritize the task figures, the benchmark protocol, the telemetry rules, the main result tables, and the error analysis. The deeper questions worth thinking about are whether process validation can avoid becoming a brittle rule game, and whether this evaluation style can generalize beyond CAPTCHA to other high-stakes GUI interactions.

recommendation.zh: 看 benchmark 构造和 verifier 设计即可；若没有控制脚手架差异，Agent 排名只能当噪声读。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and verifier design; without scaffold controls, agent rankings should be treated as noisy.

paper.title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
paper.abstract: Video world models aim to simulate controllable visual environments, but long-horizon rollouts depend on what the model remembers after observations leave its native context window. Explicit memories retain frames or online 3D reconstructions, which can suffer from heuristic retrieval errors, redundant appearance storage, or reconstruction artifacts. Implicit memories compress history into a compact state, but existing designs are not explicitly constrained to encode cross-view scene geometry. W

summary.core_problem: 视频世界模型长程rollout中，当观测超出原生上下文窗口后，模型记忆的编码效率与几何一致性问题。显式记忆有检索误差和冗余存储问题，隐式记忆缺乏跨视角几何约束。
summary.importance: 提出几何感知的隐式记忆框架GIM-World，通过训练时从冻结基础模型蒸馏3D结构来约束隐式记忆。
summary.technical_approach: 轻量Transformer编码器将变长历史压缩为固定大小记忆token；相机可查询的几何头在训练时从冻结基础模型蒸馏3D场景结构到记忆中；信息引导的剪枝规则保持编码成本有界；推理时丢弃几何教师，保留轻量记忆模块。
summary.experiments: 在MI（Minecraft环境）等benchmark上实验，摘要被截断，具体指标不明。
summary.authors_note: 南京大学、清华大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Memory encoding for video world models during long-horizon rollouts: explicit memories suffer from retrieval errors and redundancy, while implicit memories lack cross-view scene geometry constraints.
summary_en.importance: Proposes GIM-World, a geometry-aware implicit memory framework that distills 3D scene structure into memory tokens during training from a frozen foundation model teacher.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lightweight transformer encoder compresses variable-length history to fixed-size memory tokens; camera-queryable geometry head distills 3D structure from a frozen foundation model during training; information-guided pruning keeps compute bounded; geometry teacher is discarded at inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on MI (Minecraft) benchmarks; abstract truncated, specific metrics not fully visible.
summary_en.authors_note: Nanjing University, Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 视频世界模型的记忆设计，对LLM长上下文隐式记忆有微弱类比启发，作为literature备查即可，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Memory design for video world models; weak analogy to LLM long-context implicit memory; literature reference only, skip reading the paper.

paper.title: Retrieve What's Missing: Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval for Consistent Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Maintaining long-term geometric consistency remains challenging for long-horizon autoregressive video generation. Memory-augmented generative models address this by retrieving historical frames, but their effectiveness depends on two key design choices: what 3D-geometric evidence should represent past observations, and how memory frames should be selected from this evidence. Existing methods often rely on camera poses or field-of-view overlap, which are lightweight but too coarse to reason about

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程自回归视频生成中几何一致性难以维持的问题，尤其是历史帧记忆该如何表示和检索。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向视频生成的 retrieval-augmented memory 设计：用轻量深度几何证据替代粗糙 camera pose/FOV overlap 或昂贵 3D reconstruction。它对多模态生成的长程记忆机制有参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练核心工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation。方法用 pretrained 3D priors 构造目标视角 coverage map，作为轻量 3D memory evidence；检索时最大化 residual coverage gain，迭代选择能解释目标视角未覆盖区域的历史帧。核心思想是按目标视角可见性覆盖补全来检索，而不是按时间邻近或相机重叠粗选。
summary.experiments: 摘要称用于 long-horizon autoregressive video generation，并与依赖 camera poses、field-of-view overlap 或显式 3D reconstruction 的历史帧选择策略比较；未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 数值和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Korea University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term geometric consistency in long-horizon autoregressive video generation, focusing on how historical frames should be represented and retrieved.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a retrieval-augmented memory design for video generation, using lightweight depth-based geometric evidence instead of coarse camera-pose/FOV heuristics or expensive explicit 3D reconstruction. It is relevant to memory mechanisms in multimodal generation, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: COVRAG builds a target-view coverage map using pretrained 3D priors as lightweight 3D memory evidence. For memory selection, it maximizes residual coverage gain, iteratively retrieving historical frames that explain regions of the target view not yet covered. The main idea is to retrieve by target-view visibility coverage rather than simple temporal proximity or camera overlap.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated for long-horizon autoregressive video generation and compared against memory retrieval strategies based on camera poses, field-of-view overlap, or explicit 3D reconstruction. The abstract does not provide concrete model names, datasets, baseline numbers, or improvement margins.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution: Korea University.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成里的 RAG 记忆选择有一点借鉴意义；预训练方向只需看 coverage objective，别被长视频应用细节拖住。
recommendation.en: The RAG-style memory selection is mildly useful for video generation; for pretraining interests, inspect the coverage objective and ignore most application details.

paper.title: TRACE: Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents produce safety evidence across long trajectories, where sparse, delayed, and compositional risk signals often escape local moderation. Existing turn-level or short-context detectors struggle to reliably retain and aggregate such evidence over extended horizons. We reframe long-horizon agent safety detection as trajectory-level evidence compression and propose Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety (TRACE). TRACE uses a Compressor-Reader design: th

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 安全检测中，风险证据分散、延迟出现且跨多步组合，导致 turn-level moderation 难以捕捉的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent safety 方法，不是预训练论文，但它提出了一个对长轨迹压缩与证据保留的建模视角。对做长上下文监督、trajectory modeling、以及 post-train safety 的研究员有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TRACE，将长时程安全检测重写为 trajectory-level evidence compression。系统由 Compressor-Reader 两部分组成：Compressor 在轨迹级监督下把完整轨迹压成紧凑 latent evidence state；Reader 在访问原始轨迹时把该 latent state 当作安全参考，以减少局部判断造成的证据丢失。
summary.experiments: 在 ASSEBench、Pre-Ex-Bench、R-Judge 和 LongSafety 上评测，摘要称在所有评估 backbone 上都优于强基线，最高提升 12.6 个百分点，并在更长轨迹上退化更小。未见模型规模与训练细节，需看正文确认是否只是额外 supervision 带来的收益。
summary.authors_note: University of Science and Technology of China、National University of Singapore、South China Normal University。属于学术界 agent safety 方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses long-horizon LLM-agent safety detection, where risk evidence is sparse, delayed, and compositional, making turn-level moderation unreliable.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful view of long-trajectory compression and evidence retention. It may be relevant to researchers working on long-context supervision, trajectory modeling, and post-training safety.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRACE reframes safety detection as trajectory-level evidence compression. It uses a Compressor-Reader design: the Compressor encodes the full trajectory into a compact latent evidence state under trajectory-level supervision, and the Reader judges the raw trajectory with that latent state as a safety reference to reduce premature evidence loss.
summary_en.experiments: It is evaluated on ASSEBench, Pre-Ex-Bench, R-Judge, and LongSafety. The abstract claims best accuracy across evaluated backbones, with gains up to 12.6 points over strong baselines and smaller degradation on longer trajectories. Model scale and training details are not given in the abstract, so the full paper is needed to verify whether the gains mainly come from extra supervision.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Science and Technology of China, National University of Singapore, and South China Normal University. This sits in the academic agent-safety line of work.

recommendation.zh: 把长轨迹安全判别改写成压缩问题，这个 framing 值得记；但大概率是 task-specific head，读方法图和长轨迹 ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the reframing of long-horizon safety as compression; likely task-specific, so read the method figure and long-trajectory ablations, not the whole paper.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: MemPro: Agentic Memory Systems as Evolvable Programs

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 记忆系统静态、难演化、难随任务长期适配的问题。
summary.importance: 把 memory system 视为可演化程序而非固定缓存，这对长期 agent 设计有一定方法价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 从标题看，MemPro 将 agentic memory 建模为可编程、可修改、可进化的程序结构，而不是单一向量库或固定摘要模块；重点应在记忆读写规则、程序化更新和任务驱动演化。
summary.experiments: 缺少摘要，无法确认 benchmark 与对比方法；大概率会在长期任务、多轮交互或工具使用场景中，对比传统 memory buffer、RAG memory 或摘要式记忆。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华东师范大学与小红书。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rigidity of agent memory systems that do not adapt well over long horizons or evolving tasks.
summary_en.importance: Treating memory as an evolvable program rather than a fixed cache is methodologically interesting for long-horizon agents, though it is still far from core pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: From the title, MemPro likely models agent memory as a programmable and updateable structure with explicit read/write/evolution rules, instead of a plain vector store or static summarization module.
summary_en.experiments: No abstract is available, so the exact benchmarks and baselines are unclear; likely evaluations involve long-horizon tasks, multi-turn interaction, or tool-use settings against standard memory baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with East China Normal University and Xiaohongshu Inc.

recommendation.zh: agent memory 方向里算有点方法味，但离 pretrain 很远；只需看它怎样定义“可演化程序”，别在任务分数上花时间。
recommendation.en: There may be a real idea in treating memory as an evolvable program, but it is far from pretraining; inspect the abstraction, not the task scores.

paper.title: LongDS-Bench: On the Failure of Long-Horizon Agentic Data Analysis
paper.abstract: Real-world data analysis is inherently iterative, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate isolated or short interactive tasks, leaving agents' ability to track evolving analytical context over long horizons untested. We introduce LongDS, a benchmark for long-horizon, multi-turn data analysis where agents must maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical states. LongDS comprises 68 tasks constructed from real-world Kaggle notebooks, spanning 2,225 turns across six domains including

summary.core_problem: 现有数据分析智能体基准仅覆盖孤立或短交互任务，无法评估智能体在长程多轮交互中维护、更新、回滚、组合演化分析状态的核心能力。
summary.importance: 明确了长程上下文状态维护是当前大模型智能体的核心短板，为基座预训练的长程依赖建模、持久状态记忆能力优化提供了明确的评测锚点和优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 将长程智能体数据分析任务形式化为分析状态管理问题，覆盖状态构建、继承、更新、反事实扰动、回滚、多状态组合等核心演化模式；2. 基于真实Kaggle分析工作流构建LongDS基准，包含6个领域的68个任务、2225轮交互，平均依赖跨度达11.3轮；3. 设计针对长程状态错误的细粒度评测与归因框架。
summary.experiments: 5款当前最优模型在LongDS上的最高平均准确率仅为48.45%，性能随交互轮次增加大幅下降；错误主要为级联错误和状态管理错误，而非孤立的编码或推理错误；增加智能体交互步数无法稳定提升性能。
summary.reading_guide: 优先看引言中现有基准的局限性分析、任务形式化定义、基准构建逻辑和核心评测结果；预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing data analysis agent benchmarks only cover isolated or short-interactive tasks, and fail to evaluate agents' core capability of maintaining, updating, rolling back, and composing evolving analytical states in long-horizon multi-turn interactions.
summary_en.importance: This work clarifies that long-horizon context state maintenance is the core shortcoming of current LLM agents, and provides clear evaluation anchors and optimization directions for long-range dependency modeling and persistent state memory optimization in base model pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Formalize long-horizon agentic data analysis as analytical state management, covering core evolution patterns including state construction, inheritance, update, counterfactual perturbation, rollback, and multi-state composition; 2. Construct the LongDS benchmark based on real Kaggle analysis workflows, containing 68 tasks across 6 domains, 2,225 interaction turns, with an average dependency span of 11.3 turns; 3. Design a fine-grained evaluation and attribution framework targeting long-horizon state errors.
summary_en.experiments: The highest average accuracy of 5 leading models on LongDS reaches only 48.45%, and performance degrades sharply as the number of interaction turns increases; most errors are cascading errors and state management errors, rather than isolated coding or reasoning errors; increasing the agent's interaction step budget does not consistently improve performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the analysis of limitations of existing benchmarks in the introduction, formal task definition, benchmark construction logic and core evaluation results; estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和错误分解即可；它给长程 agent 的状态退化提供了比“多跑几步”更干净的负例。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and error breakdown; it gives a cleaner negative signal on long-horizon state decay than simply increasing agent steps.

institutions: Zhejiang University - Ant Group Joint Laboratory of Knowledge Graph

paper.title: Learning Agent-Compatible Context Management for Long-Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks such as web search and deep research in real-world applications, where accumulated context can cause long-context degradation and reasoning failures. Prior work mitigates this through context management with agent-side context control or fixed strategies such as summarization, which require training the agent itself for adaptation - making it impractical for closed-source agents and ignoring that different agents may require different strategies. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长程 Agent 中的上下文管理问题：轨迹、工具结果和中间推理不断累积后，长上下文退化会导致约束遗忘、过早放弃和重复探索。传统做法多让 Agent 自己总结或调用上下文工具，但这要求 Agent 具备相应协议能力，也不适合闭源模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“长上下文可用性”从窗口长度问题转成了 Agent 兼容的上下文分布问题。同样的原始轨迹，对不同能力模型未必都是有益输入；弱模型可能需要更强压缩来降低推理负担，强模型则能保留更多原始证据以维持 fidelity。这个观察对长上下文预训练和 Agent 后训练都有意义：训练目标不能只奖励装入更多 token，还要奖励模型在被裁剪、压缩、重排后的上下文上稳定执行。
summary.technical_approach: AdaCoM 使用一个外部 context manager 管理上下文，任务 Agent 保持冻结。基础流程是 ReAct Agent 在第 t 轮基于 managed context 生成动作，环境返回 observation 后，manager 接收当前上下文并输出结构化修改动作，得到下一轮 managed context。方法有两个关键设计。第一是架构解耦：manager 可以是较小 LLM，不需要训练或修改闭源 Agent。第二是操作灵活：不预设只做摘要，而是允许 manager 对上下文任意部分进行编辑、保留、压缩或重组。manager 通过端到端强化学习训练，奖励来自最终任务表现，因此学到的是某个冻结 Agent 真正能用好的上下文形态，而不是人工规定的摘要格式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 web search 和 deep research 类型长程任务，并在多种 Agent 上测试。论文报告 AdaCoM 能明显改善任务表现，主要通过减少约束遗忘、过早放弃和冗余探索来取得收益。分析部分提出 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off：以 vanilla ReAct 表现衡量 Agent 能力时，强 Agent 的 manager 倾向保留更多原始轨迹以减少信息损失；弱 Agent 的 manager 更倾向激进压缩，以降低长上下文干扰并提高执行可靠性。迁移实验显示，训练好的 manager 更容易在能力相近的 Agent 之间迁移，而跨能力层级迁移效果较弱。给定内容未提供具体提升数字，精读时需要回到主实验表格核对各 benchmark 和各 Agent 的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 AdaCoM 方法部分，特别是 managed context 的递推定义、manager 的结构化修改动作空间和强化学习训练流程。实验部分优先看三个信息：不同 Agent 上 AdaCoM 相对 vanilla ReAct 和固定摘要策略的提升；manager 学到的上下文长度和压缩比例；跨 Agent 迁移矩阵。最值得带走的是 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off，因为它解释了为什么单一摘要策略很难适配所有模型，也解释了为什么长上下文能力评估应同时看信息保真和推理稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context management for long-horizon LLM agents. As actions, observations, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning accumulate, the growing context can hurt later decisions. Existing approaches often ask the agent itself to summarize or manage context, which is fragile for frozen or closed-source agents and assumes a single management strategy works across models.
summary_en.importance: The useful insight is that long-context performance is not only about context-window size. It is also about whether the presented context distribution is compatible with a particular agent. Stronger agents can often use more raw trajectory evidence, while weaker agents may need more aggressive compression to avoid distraction and instruction drift. This has implications for long-context pretraining and agent post-training: models should be trained not just to accept many tokens, but to operate reliably under edited, compressed, and reorganized contexts.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaCoM introduces an external context manager while keeping the task agent frozen. In a ReAct-style workflow, the agent acts on a managed context; after the environment returns an observation, the manager receives the updated context and emits a structured modification action; applying this action produces the next managed context. The design has two important choices. First, context management is architecturally decoupled from the task agent, so it can be used with closed-source or otherwise untrainable agents. Second, the manager is not restricted to a fixed summarization operation. It can flexibly edit, retain, compress, or reorganize different parts of the trajectory. The manager is trained with end-to-end reinforcement learning using task success signals, so the learned policy is optimized for what the frozen agent can actually use.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers long-horizon web search and deep research tasks across multiple agents. AdaCoM is reported to improve performance by reducing constraint forgetting, premature abandonment, and redundant exploration. The analysis identifies a Fidelity–Reliability trade-off: managers paired with stronger agents preserve more raw trajectory content to maintain evidence fidelity, while managers paired with weaker agents compress more aggressively to keep reasoning reliable. Transfer experiments show that a trained manager transfers best between agents of similar capability, and less reliably across different capability tiers. The provided text does not include exact performance numbers, so the main tables should be checked for benchmark-level gains and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes.
