paper.title: ASH: Agents that Self-Hone via Embodied Learning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks remain a fundamental challenge in AI, as current methods rely on hand-engineered rewards or action-labeled demonstrations, neither of which scales. We introduce ASH, an agentic system that learns an embodied policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation. ASH follows a self-improvement loop; when it gets stuck, ASH learns an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own trajectories, and uses its IDM to extract supervision from re

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 embodied task 过度依赖手工奖励或专家动作标注、难以扩展的问题，尝试从无标注互联网视频中自举学习策略。
summary.importance: 贡献类型更接近 agentic embodied learning 范式探索，而非 LLM 预训练。它有一点启发性：把自生成轨迹、逆动力学模型和互联网视频监督闭环起来，说明弱监督外部数据也能被 agent 自己转化为训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: ASH 采用自我改进循环：当 agent 卡住时，先从自身轨迹学习 Inverse Dynamics Model，再用 IDM 从相关互联网视频中抽取动作监督；同时用无监督方法从大规模视频中识别关键时刻并存入长期记忆，以支持多小时规划。整体是 embodied agent、视频检索/筛选、IDM 监督抽取和长期记忆的组合系统。
summary.experiments: 评测环境是 Pokemon Emerald 和 The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap，两者都要求长时程规划。摘要称 behavioral cloning、RAG 和 zero-shot foundation model 基线会较早停滞，而 ASH 能继续提升并完成更长链条任务。未见参数规模、视频数据量和训练成本等关键信息，因而更适合作为系统思路参考，而不是直接迁移到基座训练结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Waterloo 和 National Research Council Canada。Victor Zhong 在交互式学习与语言/决策交叉方向有一定知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-horizon embodied tasks without relying on hand-engineered rewards or expert action labels, aiming to learn from unlabeled internet video instead.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an embodied-agent learning paper rather than an LLM pretraining contribution. The interesting part is the training loop: the agent converts weak external video data into supervision using its own learned inverse dynamics model.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASH runs a self-improvement loop. When the agent gets stuck, it learns an inverse dynamics model from its own trajectories, then uses that IDM to extract supervision from relevant internet videos. In parallel, it uses unsupervised learning to identify key moments from large-scale video and stores them as long-term memory for multi-hour planning. The system combines embodied control, video retrieval/filtering, IDM-based supervision extraction, and long-term memory.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is on Pokemon Emerald and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, both requiring long-horizon planning. The abstract claims behavioral cloning, retrieval-augmented, and zero-shot foundation-model baselines plateau, while ASH continues to improve. Key details such as model size, video scale, and training cost are not visible from the abstract, so this is better treated as a systems idea than a clean base-model training result.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the University of Waterloo and the National Research Council Canada. Victor Zhong is a recognizable researcher in interactive learning and language-decision settings.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“用自身轨迹学 IDM，再去互联网视频里挖监督”这个闭环值得借到 RL-pretrain 接口；先看自改进 loop，别急着信游戏结果外推。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the loop of learning an IDM from self-trajectories and mining supervision from internet video is worth borrowing for the RL–pretrain interface; read the loop, not the game hype.

paper.title: A$^2$RD: Agentic Autoregressive Diffusion for Long Video Consistency
paper.abstract: Synthesizing consistent and coherent long video remains a fundamental challenge. Existing methods suffer from semantic drift and narrative collapse over long horizons. We present A$^2$RD, an Agentic Auto-Regressive Diffusion architecture that decouples creative synthesis from consistency enforcement. A$^2$RD formulates long video synthesis as a closed-loop process that synthesizes and self-improves video segment-by-segment through a Retrieve--Synthesize--Refine--Update cycle. It comprises three

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法遵循被动开环范式，在长时间尺度上存在两个核心问题：（1）时间一致性无法维持，实体/环境在跨段出现时发生漂移；（2）叙事连贯性崩溃，出现语义漂移和内容重复。逐帧自回归模型（FAR）的错误会无修正地传播；分段式模型（SAR）在段间难以保持一致性。同时现有基准缺乏实体/环境循环出现（消失再出现）和状态变化的真实复杂性。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成领域对自回归开环范式局限性的一次明确反思。论文将agentic闭环范式引入视频扩散建模，通过检索-合成-精炼-更新的循环来实现自我修正。对于LLM基座研究者而言，其启发在于：将长程生成从『一次性自回归』转向『闭环自我修正』是一个可能的范式迁移方向，这种思路原则上也可应用于超长文本生成等其他模态。此外，多模态记忆（MVMem）的设计对长上下文建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: A²RD将长视频生成形塑为一个闭环的agentic过程，无需额外训练（training-free），基于现有Text-Image-to-Video（TI2V）模型构建。三个核心组件：（1）多模态视频记忆（MVMem）——不仅存储视觉参考，还将每个视频段拆解为文本状态（Visual Arcs追踪实体特征及时空演化、Spatial Relations记录主-谓-宾三元组、Camera状态）+ 关键帧 + 原始视频段，实现跨模态的世界状态追踪。（2）自适应段生成——根据记忆中的上下文，自动在extrapolation（外推新内容）和interpolation（内插衔接）模式间切换，保证段间边界自然过渡。（3）分层测试时自我改进——在帧级别和视频级别对生成内容进行两轮自我精炼。整个系统形成Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update循环：每生成一个新段时，从记忆中检索相关上下文→自适应合成→分层自我改进→更新记忆。此外还提出了LVbench-C基准，专门评测实体/环境循环出现（cyclic appearance）带状态变化的长程一致性。
summary.experiments: 实验在LVbench-C和多个公开基准上进行。A²RD仅通过2次自我改进迭代就在一致性和叙事连贯性上取得SOTA结果，人类评测也验证了这一结论。但具体的模型参数量、数据规模和量化提升幅度未在提供的文本中给出。值得注意的是，A²RD是training-free方案，其性能提升完全来自推理时的闭环架构设计，而非模型权重更新。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点关注第2节A²RD架构（特别是MVMem的多模态拆解设计和自适应生成模式切换），以及Figure 4的系统架构图。LVbench-C的设计思路（cyclic entity appearance with state evolution）对基准设计感兴趣的读者值得一看。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供的文本中明确标注作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long video synthesis methods follow a passive open-loop paradigm, suffering from two core failures at scale: (1) temporal consistency breaks down, with entities/environments drifting across segments, and (2) narrative coherence collapses, leading to semantic drift and content repetition. Frame-autoregressive (FAR) models propagate errors uncorrected; segment-autoregressive (SAR) models fail to maintain inter-segment consistency. Additionally, existing benchmarks lack the realistic complexity of entities/environments appearing cyclically (disappearing and reappearing) with state changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an explicit rethinking of the open-loop autoregressive paradigm in video generation. The paper introduces an agentic closed-loop paradigm to video diffusion modeling via a Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update cycle for self-correction. For LLM researchers, the insight is that shifting long-range generation from "one-shot autoregression" to "closed-loop self-improvement" represents a potential paradigm shift that could in principle apply to other modalities such as ultra-long text generation. The multimodal memory (MVMem) design also offers lessons for long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: A²RD frames long video synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process. It is training-free, built atop existing Text-Image-to-Video (TI2V) models. Three core components: (1) Multimodal Video Memory (MVMem) — stores not just visual references but disentangles each segment into Textual States (Visual Arcs tracking entity features and their temporal evolution, Spatial Relations as subject-relation-object triplets, Camera states) + Key Frames + Raw Video, enabling cross-modal world state tracking. (2) Adaptive Segment Generation — automatically switches between extrapolation (generating new content) and interpolation (bridging segments) modes based on memory context for natural boundary transitions. (3) Hierarchical Test-Time Self-Improvement — two rounds of self-refinement at both frame and video levels. The full system forms a Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update cycle. The paper also contributes LVbench-C, a benchmark for long-horizon consistency with cyclic entity appearance and optional state evolution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on LVbench-C and multiple public benchmarks. A²RD achieves SOTA consistency and narrative coherence in just 2 self-improvement iterations, corroborated by human studies. Specific parameter counts, dataset sizes, and quantitative improvement margins are not provided in the available text. Notably, A²RD is training-free — all performance gains come from inference-time closed-loop architecture design, not weight updates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on Section 2 (A²RD architecture, especially MVMem's multimodal decomposition design and adaptive mode switching) and Figure 4 (system architecture diagram). The LVbench-C design rationale (cyclic entity appearance with state evolution) is worthwhile for readers interested in benchmark design. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly stated in the provided text

recommendation.zh: Google的长视频生成工作，将agentic闭环与自回归扩散结合的思路对统一建模范式有一定参考价值，建议快速浏览方法部分。
recommendation.en: Google long video generation work. The agentic closed-loop + autoregressive diffusion combination is conceptually interesting for unified modeling paradigms; skim the method section.

paper.title: Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prun

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注长链推理中的 on-policy distillation：当 student 生成的前缀逐渐偏离 teacher 的思路后，teacher 在这些前缀上的 dense token-level reward 会变得不可靠，继续生成和打分会浪费计算，还可能引入低质量训练信号。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning post-training 很相关。OPD 处在 SFT、verifiable RL 和 teacher distillation 的交界处，近期系统把它作为降低长链推理训练成本的手段。Prune-OPD 的价值在于把“是否继续监督”从固定长度策略改成位置级可靠性判断。这个视角对预训练研究也有启发：长序列训练信号并不只是多或少的问题，还要看当前前缀下监督者的局部分布是否仍然可用。
summary.technical_approach: 基线 OPD 在 student 自己采样的轨迹上查询 teacher，并用 teacher 的 next-token distribution 给每个位置提供 dense reward，常见目标可写成 student trajectory 上的 reverse-KL 类 token-level loss。问题是 student prefix 一旦 drift，teacher 的局部分布可能仍可计算，但不再是可利用的学习目标。Prune-OPD 在每个位置比较 student 和 teacher 的候选 token 区域，主要指标是 top-k overlap ratio，也提供 teacher top-p/top-k action acceptance 作为更严格的变体。当兼容性低于阈值时，方法记录 prefix-drift event。累计 drift 会产生一个单调下降的 reliability weight，用来衰减后续位置的 OPD reward；同一个可靠性信号也用于动态控制有效 response length。它不是过滤整条样本，也不是简单截断到固定长度，而是在 token 位置上把计算和监督分配给 teacher 仍然局部可操作的区域。
summary.experiments: 作者报告在长链推理 OPD 训练中，Prune-OPD 可减少 37.6%–68.0% 的训练时间，同时保持或提升下游准确率。额外实验显示，当 student-teacher 兼容性保持较高时，控制器会保留长上下文监督，这说明它不是盲目缩短 response。论文还设计了 fixed-length pruning 对照，用来区分收益来自可靠性信号，还是仅仅来自更短的生成长度。提供的全文片段没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、teacher/student 配置、绝对准确率和每个任务的提升幅度，引用实验结论时需要回到表格核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–40 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 OPD 失败模式的定义，然后看 Background 里 token-level OPD objective 的写法，确认 reliability weight 是如何接入 loss 的。方法部分重点看 top-k overlap、top-p/top-k acceptance、prefix-drift event、monotone attenuation 和 dynamic rollout control。实验部分主要看三类对照：不开启 pruning 的 OPD、固定长度截断、基于可靠性信号的动态截断。若只关心基座研究，可重点吸收“长序列监督质量随轨迹深度变化”的诊断，而不必细读每个数学推理 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning: once the student-generated prefix drifts away from the teacher’s reasoning path, the teacher’s dense token-level rewards on that prefix become less locally exploitable, while generation and teacher scoring continue to consume compute.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to reasoning-model training. OPD sits between supervised fine-tuning, teacher distillation, and verifiable RL. The useful contribution is to replace a fixed rollout budget with a position-level reliability budget. For foundation-model training research, the broader lesson is that long-sequence supervision should be judged by local compatibility between the learner state and the supervisor, not only by sequence length or final-answer correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Standard OPD samples trajectories from the current student and queries the teacher on the same student-visited prefixes, producing dense token-level supervision, often through a reverse-KL-style objective. Prune-OPD adds an online reliability controller. At each position, it compares the student and teacher next-token distributions under the same prefix. The main signal is top-k overlap ratio; a stricter variant checks whether student actions are accepted by the teacher’s top-p or top-k set. When compatibility falls below a threshold, the method records a prefix-drift event. Accumulated drift events define a monotone reliability weight that downweights later OPD rewards. The same signal also determines an effective response length, allowing dynamic rollout control. The key distinction from fixed truncation is that Prune-OPD prunes where teacher supervision is locally unreliable, not merely after a preset number of tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The authors report training-time reductions of 37.6%–68.0% in long-horizon OPD settings while preserving or improving downstream accuracy. Additional runs indicate that the controller keeps long-context supervision when the compatibility signal remains high, which supports the claim that the method reallocates compute rather than simply shortening all responses. The paper also includes fixed-length pruning controls to test whether gains come from reliability-aware pruning rather than generic length reduction. The provided full-content excerpt does not include benchmark names, model sizes, teacher/student configurations, absolute accuracy numbers, or per-task margins, so those should be verified in the experimental tables before citation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–40 minutes. Start with the Introduction for the diagnosis of OPD prefix drift. Then read the background objective to see how token-level OPD rewards are computed and where a scalar reliability weight can be inserted. In the method section, focus on top-k overlap, top-p/top-k acceptance, prefix-drift events, monotone reward attenuation, and dynamic rollout control. In the experiments, compare standard OPD, fixed-length pruning, and reliability-aware pruning. For foundation-model researchers, the most transferable point is the depth-dependent degradation of supervision quality in long generated trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 长Horizon推理蒸馏中前缀漂移是实际训练中的真实痛点，动态截断机制可直接借鉴到推理增强蒸馏管线中。看§3的检测与截断策略即可
recommendation.en: Prefix drift in long-horizon reasoning distillation is a real pain point; the dynamic truncation mechanism is directly applicable to reasoning-enhanced distillation pipelines. Read §3 for detection and truncation strategies

paper.title: When Routine Chats Turn Toxic: Unintended Long-Term State Poisoning in Personalized Agents
paper.abstract: Personalized LLM agents maintain persistent cross-session state to support long-horizon collaboration. Yet, this persistence introduces a subtle but critical security vulnerability: routine user-agent interactions can gradually reshape an agent's long-term state, inadvertently weakening future confirmation boundaries, expanding tool-use defaults, and escalating autonomous behavior over time. We formalize this risk as \textbf{unintended long-term state poisoning}. To systematically study it, we i

summary.core_problem: 研究个性化 agent 的持久跨会话状态会如何在日常交互中被逐步“污染”，导致授权边界、工具使用和自主性长期漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是安全 benchmark 与问题定义。它把一次性 prompt injection 之外的慢性状态污染单独提出，并给出状态中心的 Harm Score，这对长期记忆 agent 的训练和评测都有参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化 unintended long-term state poisoning，构建 ULSPB：覆盖 5 类助手场景、7 种交互模式、24 轮 routine interaction，并配有 matched single-injection 对照。评测指标 Harm Score 分解为 authorization drift、tool-use escalation、unchecked autonomy 三部分，用于量化长期状态偏移的风险。
summary.experiments: 在 OpenClaw 上评测 4 个 backbone LLM。摘要表明长期、日常式交互能比单次注入更隐蔽地改变后续行为边界，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名和完整数值。实验价值主要在 benchmark 设计和对照设置，而不是算法突破。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学、香港科技大学及港科大（广州）。属于 agent 安全与长期记忆评测方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how persistent cross-session state in personalized agents can be gradually poisoned through routine interactions, causing long-term drift in authorization boundaries, tool use, and autonomy.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a security benchmark and problem formulation. It isolates chronic state poisoning from one-shot prompt injection and introduces a state-centric Harm Score. This matters for long-memory agents, though it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize unintended long-term state poisoning and build ULSPB, a bilingual benchmark spanning five assistant categories, seven interaction patterns, 24-turn routine interactions, and matched single-injection controls. Harm Score decomposes risk into authorization drift, tool-use escalation, and unchecked autonomy.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate on OpenClaw with four backbone LLMs. The abstract suggests that routine long-horizon interactions can more subtly reshape future behavior than single injections, though the abstract does not provide the full model list or detailed numbers. The value is mostly in the benchmark design and control setup rather than a new algorithm.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, HKUST, and HKUST (Guangzhou). The work sits in agent safety and long-term memory evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但做长期记忆 agent 或 continual post-train 的人该记住这个 failure mode；读 benchmark 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you work on long-memory agents or continual post-training, this failure mode is worth knowing; the benchmark design is the main thing to read.

paper.title: Can RL Teach Long-Horizon Reasoning to LLMs? Expressiveness Is Key
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet the systematic study of how training scales with task difficulty has been hampered by the lack of controlled, scalable environments. We introduce ScaleLogic, a synthetic logical reasoning framework that offers independent control over two axes of difficulty: the depth of the required proof planning (i.e., the horizon) and the expressiveness of the underlying logic. Our proposed framework supports a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“RL 能不能让模型推理更强”这个泛问题，而是一个更具体也更难的问题：当任务需要更长的证明链条时，RL 训练成本究竟如何随 horizon 增长；同时，训练难度到底主要由步数决定，还是由逻辑表达能力决定。现有数学、代码等可验证领域虽然适合做 RL，但任务分布不干净，难度轴纠缠在一起，很难把“长程规划深度”和“逻辑表达复杂度”拆开分析。ScaleLogic 的目标就是构造一个可精确验证、可低成本大规模生成、并且能独立控制 proof depth 与 logical expressiveness 的合成环境，用它系统研究 RL 在长程推理上的 scaling 行为，以及这种训练是否能迁移到真实推理基准。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义很直接。第一，它给出了一个少见的、控制变量足够干净的 RL reasoning testbed，使“训练算力如何随推理深度增长”可以被定量研究，而不是停留在 benchmark 现象。第二，论文的核心发现不是单纯的 power law，而是 scaling exponent 会随逻辑表达能力单调上升：从只含 implication 的简单逻辑，到加入 conjunction、disjunction、negation、universal quantification 的更强逻辑，达到同样精度所需训练步数对深度的敏感性显著变大。这说明长程推理的难点不只是链条更长，更在于状态空间和可行证明结构更复杂。第三，迁移实验表明，训练数据“表达什么逻辑”会影响 downstream reasoning transfer，而且高表达性数据的收益曲线更持续。这对合成推理数据设计、RL curriculum、以及用 post-train 反哺基座推理能力都有现实启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是任务生成。每个样本由一组 axioms 和若干 candidate conclusions 构成，模型需要在多选项中找出可由 axioms 推出的结论。这里的设计关键在于：不是直接问一个结论是否成立，而是给多个候选结论，并让每个候选项都需要相近的推理 effort 才能判定，从而压低 shortcut 和表面模式匹配的空间。第二层是难度控制。论文显式控制两条轴：proof-tree depth，也就是得到正确结论所需的最短证明深度；以及 logical expressiveness，也就是逻辑语言允许使用的构造。文中从 implication-only 开始，逐步加入 and / or / not / for all 等操作，使任务从接近链式演绎，扩展到需要分支、排除、组合和量化传播的证明搜索。这样做的价值在于，深度和表达性不再混在一起。第三层是 RL 训练。论文把该环境作为可验证多选推理任务，用 outcome-based RL 做 post-training，并比较不同 RL 方法与不同训练分布。一个重要设计是 curriculum：不是把所有深度和逻辑复杂度混在一起训练，而是按难度逐步推进。结果显示 curriculum 不只是提升最终精度，更改善训练稳定性和 sample efficiency。与已有工作相比，这篇论文的创新不在某个新 RL 算法，而在于把 reasoning RL 的研究对象重新参数化：从“在杂乱 benchmark 上刷分”转成“在可控逻辑环境中测 scaling law、测 transfer、测训练分布效应”。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有三组。第一组是 scaling law。论文测量达到 90% validation accuracy 所需的 RL training steps T，与 proof depth D 之间满足 T∝D^γ，且拟合优度很高，R^2>0.99。更重要的是 γ 随逻辑表达能力单调增加，从 1.04 上升到 2.60。这个量级差异说明：在简单逻辑里，深度增加带来的训练成本接近线性；但在更强表达逻辑里，成本增长明显更陡。第二组是方法与分布鲁棒性。作者报告这种 power-law 关系在不同 RL 方法下都成立，说明它更像任务结构与训练动态共同决定的现象，而不是某个算法偶然产物。同时，训练分布影响很大；精心设计的 curriculum 能提升效率并减少不稳定。第三组是下游迁移。作者把在 ScaleLogic 上训练后的模型评测到 8 个真实数学与通用推理 benchmark 上，最强表达性设置相对 base model 的平均准确率提升最高达到 +10.66 个百分点。更值得注意的是，低表达性训练设置的迁移收益较早饱和，而高表达性设置随着训练推进呈单调上升，说明“训练内容的结构”比“单纯增加 RL 步数”更决定迁移上限。摘要中没有完整列出底模规模与全部 benchmark 明细，但从全文叙述看，作者重点不是追求绝对分数，而是建立可复现的 scaling 现象与 transfer 趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先把问题设定吃透：为什么一定要同时控制 horizon 和 expressiveness，为什么多选式 provability 判断比直接生成证明更适合做干净分析。然后精读任务生成部分，重点看不同逻辑构造是如何加入的，以及作者如何避免 trivial shortcut。接着看 scaling 实验图，尤其是“达到固定精度所需训练步数 vs proof depth”的拟合曲线，核心不是 power law 这个形式本身，而是不同逻辑设置下 exponent 的变化。再看 curriculum 实验，关注训练分布如何改变稳定性与效率。最后看 downstream transfer 部分，重点判断一个问题：为什么更 expressive 的合成逻辑会带来更好的真实推理迁移。这里值得深挖的点有三个：一是 expressiveness 是否可视作 reasoning data quality 的一个结构性指标；二是 exponent 上升到底来自 credit assignment 更难、搜索空间更大，还是 reward sparsity 更强；三是这种现象能否迁移到数学、代码、工具调用等更真实的可验证环境。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than the usual “can RL improve reasoning?”: how does RL training cost scale when the required reasoning horizon grows, and how much of that difficulty comes from proof depth versus the expressiveness of the underlying logic. Existing verifiable domains such as math and coding are useful for RL, but they do not provide clean, independently controllable axes of difficulty. ScaleLogic is introduced as a synthetic environment where proof depth and logical expressiveness can be varied separately, enabling a controlled study of long-horizon reasoning under RL and of whether such training transfers to real reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological and diagnostic. It provides a controlled reasoning environment where RL scaling can be measured rather than inferred indirectly from noisy benchmark trends. The central finding is not merely that training cost follows a power law with horizon, but that the exponent increases monotonically with logical expressiveness. Moving from implication-only logic to settings with conjunction, disjunction, negation, and universal quantification makes the same increase in proof depth substantially more expensive to learn. That matters for post-training and pretrain-posttrain interface work: it suggests that long-horizon reasoning difficulty is shaped not only by chain length, but by the structure of the reasoning language itself. The transfer results also indicate that the logical content of synthetic RL data affects downstream gains, which is directly relevant to synthetic data design and curriculum construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three main components. First, problem generation: each instance contains a set of axioms and several candidate conclusions, and the model must choose which conclusion is logically derivable. This multiple-choice formulation is deliberate. Instead of asking for free-form proof generation, it keeps verification exact and cheap while forcing the model to evaluate several candidates that require comparable reasoning effort, reducing shortcut opportunities. Second, difficulty control: the framework exposes two explicit axes. One is proof-tree depth, the minimum reasoning depth needed to derive the correct answer. The other is logical expressiveness, starting from implication-only logic and progressively adding conjunction, disjunction, negation, and universal quantification. This separates “longer reasoning chains” from “richer proof search structure.” Third, RL post-training: the authors train on this verifiable environment with outcome-based RL and compare multiple RL methods and training distributions. A key design choice is curriculum training rather than mixing all depths and logic families uniformly. The paper’s novelty is less about inventing a new RL algorithm and more about reparameterizing the study of reasoning RL into a clean experimental system where scaling laws, curriculum effects, and transfer can be measured with much less confounding.
summary_en.experiments: There are three headline results. First, scaling: the number of RL training steps T needed to reach 90% validation accuracy follows T∝D^γ with proof depth D, with R^2 above 0.99 over the observed range. More importantly, γ rises monotonically with logical expressiveness, from 1.04 to 2.60. In the simplest logic, training cost grows close to linearly with depth; in more expressive logics, the growth is much steeper. Second, robustness across methods and training distributions: the same power-law pattern appears across different RL algorithms, suggesting that the phenomenon is tied to task structure and training dynamics rather than a single optimization recipe. Curriculum training improves both efficiency and stability. Third, downstream transfer: training on ScaleLogic improves average accuracy across eight real-world math and general reasoning benchmarks by up to +10.66 points over the base model in the most expressive setting. A notable qualitative result is that low-expressiveness training plateaus early, while high-expressiveness training yields a steadily improving transfer curve. The paper is not mainly about absolute benchmark leadership; it is about establishing a reproducible scaling pattern and showing that data expressiveness changes transfer behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the main setup figure to understand why the authors insist on controlling both horizon and expressiveness, and why they use multiple-choice provability instead of open-ended proof generation. Then read the task construction section carefully, especially how different logical operators are introduced and how the dataset is designed to suppress trivial heuristics. The most important figures are the scaling plots showing training steps to fixed accuracy versus proof depth; the key insight is the change in exponent across logic families, not the existence of a power law by itself. After that, read the curriculum experiments to see how training distribution affects stability and sample efficiency. End with the transfer section and ask a concrete question: why does training on more expressive synthetic logic transfer better to real reasoning tasks? The deeper points worth probing are whether expressiveness can serve as a structural notion of reasoning-data quality, whether the larger exponent is driven by harder credit assignment or larger proof search spaces, and whether similar behavior should be expected in math, code, or tool-augmented verifiable domains.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看 RL-for-reasoning 的成本模型：难的不只是 horizon，表达性会把 scaling 指数抬高，建议先看实验设定和幂律拟合图。
recommendation.en: This changes the cost model for RL reasoning: horizon is not the whole story, logical expressiveness steepens the scaling exponent; read the setup and the power-law plots first.

paper.title: DR-Venus: Towards Frontier Edge-Scale Deep Research Agents with Only 10K Open Data
paper.abstract: Edge-scale deep research agents based on small language models are attractive for real-world deployment due to their advantages in cost, latency, and privacy. In this work, we study how to train a strong small deep research agent under limited open-data by improving both data quality and data utilization. We present DR-Venus, a frontier 4B deep research agent for edge-scale deployment, built entirely on open data. Our training recipe consists of two stages. In the first stage, we use agentic sup

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很具体：在只有约 10K 开放轨迹数据、模型规模只有 4B 的条件下，怎样把一个小模型训练成可用的 deep research agent。难点不在单轮问答，而在长轨迹信息搜集：小模型对噪声轨迹、格式污染、错误工具调用更敏感；进入 RL 阶段后，又容易因为长时程任务成功样本太稀疏而出现 advantage collapse，也就是一组 rollout 里几乎没有成功轨迹，导致训练信号接近失效。论文把问题拆成两部分：一是提高监督数据质量，二是提高有限监督的利用率，尤其是让 RL 在长时程 agent 任务上对小模型也能给出足够密的、可分配到每一步的学习信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它说明小模型 agent 能力的瓶颈未必先是参数量，而常常是轨迹数据质量、监督密度和 credit assignment 方式。这对做 continual pretrain、mid-training 或 agentic post-training 的人很有参考价值。第二，它把 IGPO 一类信息增益式奖励真正落到长时程 research agent 上，给出一个比稀疏终局奖励更稳定的 RL 配方，属于训练信号设计上的实用推进。第三，它展示了一个很现实的结论：在开放数据极少时，重采样长轨迹、做 turn-level reward、再配合 test-time scaling，能补回相当一部分规模差距。贡献量级不是在基础建模范式上改写规则，但在小模型 agent 训练 recipe 上是扎实且可复用的工程研究。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是两阶段。第一阶段做 agentic SFT，目标是先把基本的 search-browse-answer 行为学出来。这里的关键不是简单拿现成轨迹微调，而是先做严格清洗，再做长轨迹重采样。论文强调小模型对脏数据更脆弱，所以会过滤格式异常、工具调用不一致、低质量推理痕迹等问题样本；同时提高长时程轨迹在训练中的占比，让模型更多接触真正决定 deep research 能力的多步搜索与证据整合过程，而不是被短而容易的样本主导。第二阶段做 agentic RL。作者不是沿用只看最终答对与否的 trajectory-level sparse reward，而是基于 IGPO 设计 turn-level reward，把每一步是否带来信息增益、是否朝着更充分的证据获取推进，转成更密的训练信号；同时加入 format penalty，约束输出结构和工具调用行为，减少 RL 过程中常见的格式漂移和策略发散。这个设计的核心区别在于：它不把长轨迹任务当成单一终局优化问题，而是把“有效搜集信息”本身作为中间目标显式奖励。这样做的直接收益是 credit assignment 更清楚，rollout 中即便最终没完全答对，也能从局部有效步骤中获得梯度信号。论文还分析了工具使用分布，发现成功轨迹更依赖 browse 而不是停留在浅层 search，RL 进一步把策略校准到更有效的证据获取模式上。
summary.experiments: 模型主角是 DR-Venus-4B，完全基于约 10K 开放数据训练。按作者描述，SFT 版已经稳定超过多数 9B 以下 agent 系统，RL 版在此基础上继续提升，并把与 30B 级系统的差距明显缩小。摘要和正文可确认的定量信息主要有三类：一是规模，模型为 4B，训练数据约 10K open trajectories；二是相对结果，DR-Venus-4B-SFT 在多数 benchmark 上优于既有 <9B agent，DR-Venus-4B-RL 进一步超过 SFT 基线；三是分析性结果，Pass@K 显示小模型的能力上限高于单次采样表现，说明 test-time scaling 对这类 agent 特别有效。消融重点有两个：长轨迹重采样显著提升有限 SFT 数据的利用效率；turn-level RL 明显优于传统 trajectory-level 稀疏优化，尤其在长时程任务上更稳定。工具分析也给出行为层面的证据：成功轨迹使用 browse 的比例更高，RL 后这种差异更明显。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠抄写各 benchmark 的精确分数和提升点数，但论文主张的实验结论是清楚的：数据清洗 + 长轨迹重采样 + IGPO 风格 turn-level reward，是性能提升的主要来源。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法和实验部分值得挑着细看。先看 Introduction，抓住作者的问题设定：不是做通用 agent，而是做 edge-scale、open-data、long-horizon deep research。然后直接看 Method 里两处：SFT 数据清洗与长轨迹重采样怎么做；RL 的 turn-level reward 如何定义，尤其是 information gain 和 format penalty 分别解决什么问题。实验部分优先看三类表：1）与 <9B 和 30B 级系统的主结果对比；2）SFT 数据处理和 RL reward 设计的消融；3）Pass@K 与工具使用分析。阅读时要重点想两个问题：为什么小模型比大模型更依赖高质量轨迹；为什么长时程 agent 任务里，密奖励比终局奖励更关键。预计 25-35 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你关心 agentic RL 配方，建议把 reward 设计和失败案例再多看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a narrow but important question: how to train a capable deep-research agent at the 4B scale using only about 10K open trajectories. The challenge is not ordinary QA, but long-horizon search-and-synthesis. Small models are much more brittle to noisy traces, malformed tool calls, and low-quality reasoning trajectories. Once RL starts, the problem becomes even harder: long-horizon tasks often yield rollout groups with no successful trajectories at all, which causes advantage collapse and makes policy optimization extremely inefficient. The paper frames the problem as improving both data quality and data utilization, with special emphasis on making RL provide dense enough supervision for small models in long-horizon agent settings.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-adjacent research is practical rather than paradigm-shifting. First, it shows that for small agentic models, the main bottleneck is often not parameter count but supervision quality, reward density, and credit assignment. That matters for continual pretraining, mid-training, and agent-oriented post-training. Second, it operationalizes an information-gain-style reward design on a realistic deep-research setup, showing a more stable alternative to sparse trajectory-level rewards. Third, it supports a useful scaling lesson: with very limited open data, careful trajectory curation, long-horizon resampling, and turn-level RL can recover a meaningful fraction of the gap to much larger systems. The contribution is best understood as a solid training recipe for small open-data agents, not as a new foundation-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. Stage 1 is agentic SFT to establish basic search-browse-answer behavior. The key is not simply fine-tuning on available traces, but aggressively cleaning them and resampling toward long-horizon trajectories. The paper argues that small models are disproportionately harmed by noisy supervision, so it filters malformed outputs, inconsistent tool traces, and poor reasoning patterns. It also increases the training weight of long trajectories so that the model learns the behaviors that actually matter for deep research: multi-step search, evidence gathering, and synthesis, rather than overfitting to short easy examples. Stage 2 is agentic RL. Instead of optimizing only a sparse final-answer reward at the trajectory level, the paper builds on IGPO and introduces turn-level rewards tailored to long-horizon research tasks. Each step is rewarded for information gain—whether the action and reasoning move the agent toward better evidence acquisition—and penalized for format violations to stabilize behavior. This is the central design choice: the method does not treat the task as a single terminal success/failure event, but explicitly rewards intermediate progress in evidence collection. That improves credit assignment and allows partially useful trajectories to contribute learning signal even when the final answer is not fully correct. The paper also analyzes tool-use patterns and finds that successful trajectories rely more on browsing than shallow search, with RL further calibrating the policy toward more effective evidence acquisition.
summary_en.experiments: The main model is DR-Venus-4B, trained entirely on roughly 10K open trajectories. According to the paper, the SFT model already outperforms most prior agentic systems below 9B on the majority of benchmarks, and the RL model improves further while narrowing the gap to 30B-class systems. The reliably recoverable quantitative facts from the provided full text are: model size is 4B; training data is about 10K open trajectories; DR-Venus-4B-SFT beats most sub-9B baselines on most benchmarks; DR-Venus-4B-RL improves over the SFT baseline. The analysis results are also important: Pass@K indicates that the capability ceiling of small deep-research agents is substantially higher than single-sample performance suggests, implying strong returns from test-time scaling. The main ablations support two claims: long-horizon trajectory resampling materially improves SFT data efficiency, and turn-level RL is much more effective than sparse trajectory-level optimization on long-horizon tasks. Tool-use analysis provides behavioral evidence as well: successful runs browse more, and RL amplifies that pattern. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark scores and deltas should not be fabricated, but the experimental message is clear: data cleaning, long-trajectory resampling, and IGPO-style turn-level rewards are the main drivers.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but several sections deserve focused attention. Start with the introduction to lock in the setting: edge-scale, open-data, long-horizon deep research, not generic agent work. Then go straight to the method section and inspect two pieces carefully: how the SFT data is cleaned and resampled, and how the turn-level reward is defined, especially the roles of information gain and format penalties. In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main comparison against sub-9B and 30B-class systems, the ablations on data processing and reward design, and the Pass@K plus tool-use analyses. The useful reading questions are: why are small models more dependent on trajectory quality than larger ones, and why do long-horizon agent tasks benefit so much from dense intermediate rewards instead of terminal rewards alone? Around 25-35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas; spend more time on the reward design if you care about agentic RL recipes.

commentary.article_excerpt: 大模型任我行 关注 蚂蚁：训练长程深度研究小模型 📖标题：DR-Venus: Towards Frontier Edge-Scale Deep Research Agents with Only 10K Open Data 🌐来源：arXiv, 2604.19859v1 🛎️文章简介 🔸研究问题：如何在仅使用约 1 万条开放数据的情况下，训练出具备前沿长程深度研究能力的边缘侧小语言模型智能体？ 🔸主要贡献：论文提出了 DR-Venus，一个完全基于开放数据训练的 4B 参数深度研究智能体，其性能显著超越同尺度及更大参数的现有开源模型。 📝重点思路 🔸采用两阶段训练策略，首先通过智能体监督微调（SFT）建立基础能力，随后利用智能体强化学习（RL）提升长程任务执行可靠性。 🔸在 SFT 阶段实施严格的数据清洗流程，包括环境对齐、禁用工具剪枝、去重及正确性过滤，并引入轮次感知重采样技术，大幅提升长轨迹数据的利用率。 🔸在 RL 阶段基于 IGPO 算法设计轮次级奖励机制，结合信息增益奖励与格式感知正则化惩罚，解决了小模型在长程任务中奖励稀疏和信用分配困难的问题。 🔸引入 IG-Scale 策略自适应调整信息增益奖励与结果奖励的权重平衡，防止在长程交互中因结果奖励稀缺导致的优化偏差。 🔎分析总结 🔸实验表明，仅经过高质量 SFT 训练的 4B 模型已在多数基准测试中超越此前 9B 以下的智能体系统，证明数据质量比模型规模更关键。 🔸引入基于 IGPO 的强化学习后，模型在长程任务中的格式准确性、工具使用稳定性及最终答案正确率上均有显著提升，而传统 GRPO 方法效果不佳。 🔸消融实验证实，对长轨迹数据进行重采样能有效挖掘有限开放数据的价值，是提升小模型深研能力的关键手段。 🔸Pass@K 评估显示，小模型具备惊人的能力上限，测试时扩展（Test-time Scaling）能进一步释放其潜力，甚至在多次采样下超越 30B 级大模型。 🔸工具使用分析发现，成功轨迹显著依赖浏览（Browse）操作而非单纯搜索，强化学习进一步校准了模型向更有效的证据获取行为靠拢。 💡个人观点 论文证明了通过极致的数据清洗、针对性的长轨迹重采样以及细粒度的轮次级强化学习奖励设计，可以在极小的参数量（4B）和极少的开放数据（10K）条件下，训练出具备工业级部署潜力的前沿智能体。 #LLM #大模型 #大模型训练 #论文分享 #蚂蚁 3天前

paper.title: On Training Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks: An Empirical Study of Horizon Length
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents that solve tasks through extended sequences of environment interactions. While prior work has primarily focused on system-level optimizations or algorithmic improvements, the role of task horizon length in shaping training dynamics remains poorly understood. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study that examines horizon length through controlled task constructions. Specifically, we construct controlled tasks in wh

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究一个很具体的问题：在决策规则和推理结构不变时，仅仅把任务所需的交互步数拉长，会怎样影响 LLM agent 的 SFT/RL 训练稳定性和最终能力。
summary.importance: 对基座和 post-train 接口有直接启发。长程任务失败不一定来自推理难度增加，也可能来自 horizon 本身带来的训练信号退化：成功概率随步数连乘下降，探索空间变大，延迟奖励让信用分配更噪。这个结论会影响长轨迹数据构造、agent SFT 的轨迹切分、RL rollout 设计、curriculum 设计，以及用短 horizon 数据训练后外推到长 horizon 的评估方式。贡献更接近训练动态诊断和经验原则，不是新架构或新优化器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是受控变量实验。作者把 LLM 建模为 token-level MDP，再把 agent 与环境交互建模为有限 horizon MDP。状态包含任务目标、记忆和环境观测；动作由模型生成；一条轨迹由多轮状态、动作和环境转移组成。关键设计是构造一组任务：底层决策规则相同，推理结构相同，只改变到达目标所需的动作序列长度。这样可以把“horizon length”从“任务更难”里拆出来单独观察。训练侧覆盖常见的 SFT 行为克隆和 RL，尤其关注长 horizon 下探索、稀疏回报和高方差更新带来的不稳定。缓解思路是 horizon reduction：把训练时需要完成的有效目标距离缩短，降低探索和信用分配压力，再观察模型是否能在推理时泛化到未见过的更长 horizon。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕受控任务族展开：固定决策规则与推理复杂度，只改变 goal distance 或成功所需动作步数。报告的主要现象是，短 horizon 下可以稳定学习的策略，在 horizon 增大后会出现明显训练不稳定，甚至性能崩塌；这种退化在推理结构不变时仍然存在，说明 horizon 是独立瓶颈。作者还测试了 horizon reduction 类训练策略，结果显示训练稳定性和最终表现都有改善，并观察到 horizon generalization：模型在较短 horizon 上训练后，推理阶段可迁移到未见过的更长 horizon。给出的全文内容没有包含具体表格数值、模型参数量、数据规模或提升百分比，因此不应补写未经确认的数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，horizon 的形式化定义和任务构造方式，确认作者是否真正控制住了推理复杂度；第二，训练曲线和失败案例，尤其是性能崩塌是否来自探索不足、奖励稀疏还是轨迹长度导致的 token-level 误差累积；第三，horizon reduction 的实现细节和外推实验，判断它更像 curriculum、轨迹分解，还是一种对奖励延迟的工程性缓解。对预训练研究员，最值得带走的是变量隔离方式和长轨迹训练信号质量的分析框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The study asks whether horizon length alone can make LLM agent training unstable, even when the decision rule and reasoning structure of the task are held fixed.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a clean training-dynamics observation for long-horizon agents. Failures on multi-step tasks are often attributed to weak reasoning, poor tool use, or insufficient orchestration. This work isolates another factor: the required number of environment actions. Longer horizons reduce end-to-end success probability, enlarge the exploration space, and make delayed feedback harder to assign to individual decisions. For pretraining and post-training researchers, this matters for trajectory data design, agent SFT, RL rollout construction, curriculum schedules, and evaluation of long-horizon generalization. The contribution is an empirical diagnosis and a training principle rather than a new model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames an LLM as a stochastic policy in a token-level MDP, then extends the view to an environment-interaction MDP with finite horizon. Each state includes the task goal, agent memory, and current observation; each action is generated by the model; a full episode is a sequence of states, actions, and transitions. The experimental design is the important part: construct controlled task families where the underlying rule and reasoning pattern stay the same, while only the number of required action steps changes. This separates horizon from task complexity. Training is discussed under standard agent SFT and RL settings, with attention to exploration difficulty, sparse or delayed reward, and high-variance updates. The proposed mitigation is horizon reduction: train on shorter effective goal distances to reduce credit-assignment and exploration burden, then test whether the resulting policy can extrapolate to longer horizons.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare matched tasks with different required goal distances. The reported finding is that policies that learn reliably on short horizons can become unstable as the horizon grows, sometimes collapsing in performance, despite unchanged reasoning complexity. Horizon reduction improves training stability and final performance. The authors also report horizon generalization, where models trained under shorter horizons can handle longer, unseen horizons at inference time. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete numerical tables, model sizes, dataset sizes, or percentage gains, so exact numbers cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the formal definition of horizon, the controlled task construction, and the learning curves that separate horizon effects from reasoning complexity. The most useful parts are the failure analysis under longer horizons and the implementation of horizon reduction. Check whether the observed instability is driven by exploration failure, delayed reward, or accumulated per-step error. The practical takeaway is a clearer way to reason about long-trajectory training signals for LLM agents.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但把 long-horizon agent 训练失败更干净地归因到 horizon 本身；先看实验设定和短到长训练曲线，若你做 RL-for-agents，值得立刻复现实验模板。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining priors, but it cleanly attributes long-horizon agent failures to horizon itself; read the controlled setup and short-to-long curves first, and reuse the template if you work on RL-trained agents.

commentary.article_excerpt: 代码熊大模型论文分享 关注 🎯任务长度竟成训练瓶颈？新研究揭示关键 大家有没有想过，为什么大语言模型（LLM）在解决需要多步交互的任务时，表现经常不尽如人意？🤔 现有研究大多关注系统优化或算法改进，却忽略了一个根本因素——任务本身的“长度”。这篇来自ICML 2026的论文，系统地研究了任务长度对LLM训练的影响，结果发现：仅仅增加任务所需的行动序列长度，就会导致训练不稳定、性能崩溃！即使推理难度不变，长任务也会带来探索困难和信用分配挑战，让模型难以学习。这就像让AI走迷宫，迷宫结构一样，但路径越长，它就越容易迷路。作者认为，长度本身就是训练瓶颈，我们需要正视这个被忽视的问题。 那么，如何解决这个长度瓶颈呢？论文提出了一个简单但强大的原则——长度缩减（horizon reduction）🎯。核心思想是：在训练时使用较短的任务版本，让模型更容易学习稳定的策略，然后利用一种叫做“长度泛化（horizon generalization）”的现象，让模型在推理时自然地处理更长的任务。具体来说，作者设计了受控实验，确保任务规则和推理结构不变，只改变目标距离（即行动序列长度）。结果发现，直接在长任务上训练RL会导致梯度方差大、学习信号噪声高，而先在短任务上训练再微调，不仅训练更稳定，最终性能反而更好！这就像教小孩学数学，先让他做简单的题打好基础，再挑战难题。 实验部分非常扎实！作者在多种任务设置下验证了长度缩减的有效性，包括不同的环境、不同的模型大小。结果显示，使用长度缩减训练的模型，在长任务上的成功率显著高于直接训练；更神奇的是，这些模型还能在推理时泛化到更长的任务上，而无需额外训练。🔥 例如，在某个导航任务中，直接训练的成功率不到20%，而长度缩减方法达到了60%以上。此外，作者还分析了长度泛化的机制，认为短任务训练帮助模型学会了更鲁棒的推理模式，从而能够应对更长的交互序列。这项研究不仅揭示了长度作为独立因素的重要性，还提供了一条实用的训练路径，未来有望应用于代码生成、机器人控制等需要长期规划的复杂场景。 Arxiv：2605.02572 🔗 关键词：大语言模型，强化学习，任务长度，训练稳定性，泛化 每天分享AI前沿研究，点个关注不迷路，一起探索AI的无限可能！🚀 #多模态人工智能 #大模型 #人工智能 #学术研究 #LLM #AI #深度学习 #科技前沿 #强化学习 #机器学习 昨天 17:15

paper.title: On Training Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks: An Empirical Study of Horizon Length
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents that solve tasks through extended sequences of environment interactions. While prior work has primarily focused on system-level optimizations or algorithmic improvements, the role of task horizon length in shaping training dynamics remains poorly understood. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study that examines horizon length through controlled task constructions. Specifically, we construct controlled tasks in wh

summary.core_problem: 在“推理结构与决策规则不变”的前提下，仅仅把任务所需的交互步数（horizon/goal distance）拉长，会如何改变 LLM agent 的训练动态？论文要回答的是：长时程失败到底是“更难的推理”导致的，还是“更长的序列决策链”本身就会引入独立的训练瓶颈与不稳定性。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义在于：它把 long-horizon agent 的困难从“系统工程/算法技巧”拉回到一个更可控的变量——horizon，并用受控任务证明 horizon 是独立致因。对做 RL post-train（GRPO/各类 critic-free）或 agent SFT 的团队，这个结论直接影响数据构造与课程学习：与其盲目堆更长轨迹，不如优先做可验证的 horizon reduction（分解、子目标、重写环境接口），再依赖推理时的 horizon generalization 去覆盖更长任务。论文贡献类型偏“训练动态诊断 + 经验原则”，不是新目标函数或新架构。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 概念与变量控制：作者把 LLM 视作 token-level policy，在环境交互的 MDP 里定义 horizon（T 步交互）与“goal distance/完成所需动作序列长度”。核心设计是构造一组 controlled tasks：保持决策规则、状态-动作语义、推理结构一致，只改变完成任务所需的步数，从而把“长链条”与“更复杂推理”解耦。
2) 训练范式覆盖：同时考察 SFT（行为克隆）与 RL（以 GRPO 等 critic-free 为代表的 policy optimization），观察随着 horizon 增长出现的训练不稳定：探索难度指数上升、回报延迟导致 credit assignment 噪声变大、梯度方差上升，最终表现为训练曲线剧烈波动甚至性能坍塌。
3) 解决原则：提出并验证 horizon reduction 作为简单但有效的训练原则。直观上是把“必须连续走完 T 步才给信号”的问题，改造成更短的可学习片段（例如更短的子任务/更近的目标/更密的反馈或可分解的交互接口），从而降低探索与信用分配的难度。
4) 泛化现象：在训练时用较短 horizon 学到稳定策略后，推理时可以迁移到更长 horizon（horizon generalization）。这暗示模型学到的是可组合的局部决策规律，而不是对固定步数的记忆。
summary.experiments:
论文主结果是“只增大 horizon 就会显著恶化训练稳定性”，并且这种恶化在 SFT 与 RL 下都可复现，常见现象包括：短 horizon 可稳定收敛的策略，在长 horizon 上出现高方差波动与阶段性崩溃；即便推理结构不变也会发生。
同时，采用 horizon reduction 后，训练稳定性与最终成功率显著改善，并观察到对未见过的更长 horizon 的推理时泛化（horizon generalization）。
（给定你提供的全文片段尚未包含实验章节与表格，文中涉及的具体数值、模型规模、任务套件名称与提升幅度无法可靠摘录；需要补充 §Experiments/Appendix 才能写出精确数字与关键消融。）
summary.reading_guide:
优先精读：
- Figure 1 及其对 horizon/goal distance 的形式化定义：这是全文“变量可控”的关键。
- 受控任务构造的章节（通常在方法/benchmark 设计部分）：看作者如何保证“推理结构不变，只变步数”，以及如何避免引入隐含难度（例如观测噪声、动作空间变化）。
- 训练不稳定性的诊断段落：关注作者把不稳定归因到探索与 credit assignment 的证据链（曲线形态、失败模式分类、是否有方差/梯度统计）。
- horizon reduction 的实现细节：它到底是环境改写、奖励塑形、子目标分解，还是数据层面的轨迹截断/重标注；这些决定了可迁移性。
- horizon generalization 的实验设置：训练/测试 horizon 如何划分，是否控制 token budget 与工具调用次数，避免“更长 horizon=更多算力”混淆。
预计泛读 30-45 分钟可抓住结论；要复现实验与迁移到自家 agent 训练，需通读实验与附录。

summary_en.core_problem: If you keep the decision rules and reasoning structure fixed, but only increase the required interaction length (horizon / goal distance), how does that alone affect the training dynamics of LLM agents? The paper isolates whether long-horizon failures come from harder reasoning, or from horizon length as an independent source of instability.
summary_en.importance: For pretrain↔post-train practice, the key takeaway is diagnostic and procedural: horizon is not just an environment budget but a causal factor that can break training even when “reasoning difficulty” is held constant. This directly informs how to build agent SFT/RL curricula and data: instead of naively collecting longer trajectories, prioritize horizon reduction (task decomposition, closer subgoals, denser verifiable feedback), then rely on inference-time horizon generalization to cover longer tasks. The contribution is mainly empirical training-dynamics evidence plus a pragmatic principle, rather than a new architecture or objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Controlled-variable task design: model the LLM as a token-level stochastic policy in an MDP, define horizon T and goal distance, and construct task suites where the underlying rules/semantics/reasoning pattern are identical while only the required action-sequence length changes.
2) Training regimes: evaluate both SFT (behavior cloning) and RL (with modern critic-free policy optimization such as GRPO-style methods) to see how increasing horizon impacts stability.
3) Mechanistic diagnosis: attribute failures to exploration difficulty scaling with horizon and delayed-reward credit assignment producing high-variance learning signals, observed as volatile learning curves and performance collapse.
4) Mitigation principle: validate horizon reduction as a simple intervention—shorten the effective learning horizon via decomposition/subgoals/interface changes—improving stability and final performance.
5) Generalization: demonstrate “horizon generalization”, where models trained on shorter horizons can execute successfully on longer horizons at inference, suggesting compositional local policies rather than memorization of fixed-length trajectories.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline empirical finding is that increasing horizon alone can turn stable learning (on short horizons) into severe instability and collapse, across both SFT and RL settings, even when reasoning complexity is controlled.
Applying horizon reduction substantially improves training stability and end performance, and models exhibit inference-time generalization to longer, unseen horizons.
(Numeric details—model sizes, dataset/task scales, exact success-rate deltas, and ablation tables—are not present in the provided excerpt; they require the full Experiments/Appendix sections to report faithfully.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- The formal definition of horizon/goal distance (and the motivating figure): it underpins the entire controlled study.
- The controlled task construction section: verify how they keep reasoning constant while varying only horizon, and what confounders they rule out.
- The instability analysis: look for concrete evidence beyond curves (failure taxonomies, variance/gradient statistics, exploration diagnostics).
- The exact implementation of horizon reduction: whether it is environment refactoring, reward shaping, subgoal scaffolding, or data/trajectory restructuring—this determines how portable the idea is.
- The horizon generalization protocol: how train/test horizons are split and whether compute/token budgets are controlled.
Skimming for conclusions takes ~30–45 minutes; reproducing or adapting the recipe requires a careful pass through experiments and appendices.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 setup 很干净；如果你在做 RL-style agent 或长链 tool use，先看它怎么把“horizon 本身”从系统噪声里剥出来，§实验设计值得直接借鉴。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup is unusually clean; if you work on RL-style agents or long tool-use chains, read how they isolate horizon itself from system noise and borrow the experimental design.

paper.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
paper.abstract: Benchmarks within the OpenClaw ecosystem have thus far evaluated exclusively assistant-level tasks, leaving the academic-level capabilities of OpenClaw largely unexamined. We introduce AcademiClaw, a bilingual benchmark of 80 complex, long-horizon tasks sourced directly from university students' real academic workflows -- homework, research projects, competitions, and personal projects -- that they found current AI agents unable to solve effectively. Curated from 230 student-submitted candidates

summary.core_problem: OpenClaw 生态的现有评测偏“助理型任务”，缺少对真实学术/专业工作流中高难度、长时程、强执行约束任务的系统评估。论文要解决的是：如何构建一个来源真实、难度自然对齐前沿能力、并且可在 Docker 沙箱内可验证评分的 academic-level agent benchmark。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性一般，但对 post-train（agent SFT/RL）、长时程能力诊断与数据合成方向有现实价值：它提供了更“硬”的任务分布（含 GPU/CUDA 执行、跨框架调试、形式化推理等），以及多维度验证方式，能更清晰地区分模型在工具使用、形式推理、执行鲁棒性上的短板。它也提示一个常见误区：token 消耗与质量几乎不相关，单纯拉长思考/轨迹并不等价于更好策略。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 任务来源：采用 bottom-up 收集，让本科生提交“他们亲自尝试过、现有 agent 做不好”的真实学术工作流任务；从 230 个候选经专家审核筛到 80 个最终任务，覆盖 25+ 领域，双语。
2) 执行与隔离：每个任务封装在隔离的 Docker 容器内，包含提示、参考材料与评分脚本/规程；其中 16 个任务需要 CUDA GPU 执行，这在同类 agent benchmark 中较少见。
3) 评分体系：不是单一 pass/fail，而是组合六类验证信号：确定性检查、代码执行、LLM-as-judge、VLM 评估、端到端浏览器测试、结构化输出校验；并配套安全审计维度。
4) 统一评测协议：在同一 OpenClaw agent 框架下评测多家前沿模型，分析总体通过率、任务级别的能力边界、行为模式差异（read-first / execute-first / minimalist）与 token-质量关系。
summary.experiments:
评测对象包含 Claude Opus 4.6、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、MiniMax M2.7。在该基准上，最佳模型通过率约 55%（以 score≥75/100 计）。
更细的诊断结论：
- 约 22% 的任务在不同模型间出现最高约 90 分的巨大分差，显示明显 capability boundary。
- 生成式任务相对更好，形式化推理（如奥赛级题）普遍失败。
- token 消耗跨模型差异超过 5×，但与质量几乎零相关（r≈-0.03）。
（若需要更贴近“预训练研究”的可用信号，建议进一步查看：哪些任务类型对模型规模/训练数据更敏感，是否提供轨迹与中间产物以支持 error attribution。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看任务收集与筛选流程（能判断任务分布是否“可复现、可扩展”）。
- 再看评分与验证设计（六种验证如何组合、各自覆盖的失败模式、LLM-as-judge 的偏差控制）。
- 最后看模型对比与现象分析：capability boundary、三类行为 phenotype、token-质量脱钩。
预计 40-60 分钟可读完并抓住 benchmark 设计要点；若要用它做训练闭环（数据合成/RL），需要进一步深挖任务可程序化分解与奖励信号落地方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing OpenClaw benchmarks largely target assistant-like tasks and under-measure academic/professional workflows that are long-horizon, execution-heavy, and domain-intensive. The paper builds an academic-level benchmark with real user-sourced tasks and robust, sandboxed verification.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is moderate, but it is practically useful for agent post-training (SFT/RL), long-horizon diagnostics, and data-generation pipelines. It offers a harder task distribution (including CUDA/GPU execution and cross-stack debugging) and multi-signal evaluation that better separates weaknesses in tool use, formal reasoning, and execution robustness. A notable empirical warning is that more tokens/longer traces do not reliably translate into higher quality (near-zero token–quality correlation).
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Bottom-up task sourcing: undergraduate students submit tasks from real academic workflows that current agents fail on; 230 candidates are expert-reviewed down to 80 bilingual tasks spanning 25+ domains.
2) Sandboxed execution: each task runs in an isolated Docker container with prompts, reference materials, and evaluation procedures; 16 tasks require CUDA GPU execution.
3) Multi-dimensional scoring: combine six verification mechanisms—deterministic checks, code execution, LLM-as-judge, VLM-based assessment, end-to-end browser testing, and structured-output validation—plus safety auditing.
4) Standardized evaluation: benchmark multiple frontier models under the same OpenClaw agent framework; analyze aggregate pass rates, task-level capability boundaries, behavioral phenotypes (read-first / execute-first / minimalist), and token usage vs quality.
summary_en.experiments:
Models evaluated include Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, and MiniMax M2.7. The best model reaches ~55% pass rate (score ≥ 75/100).
Additional findings: ~22% of tasks show up to ~90-point score swings across models (clear capability boundaries); generative tasks are handled better than formal reasoning (olympiad-level problems remain unsolved); token usage varies by >5× across models but is almost uncorrelated with quality (r ≈ -0.03).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in three passes:
- Task collection and curation: to judge realism, difficulty calibration, and reproducibility.
- Evaluation design: how the six verification signals are combined, and how judge bias is controlled.
- Results analysis: capability boundaries, behavioral phenotypes, and the token–quality disconnect.
~40–60 minutes is enough to extract the benchmark design and key phenomena; using it for training loops requires deeper inspection of task decomposability and how to turn rubrics into reward signals.

recommendation.zh: 把“真实长链路学术工作流”做成可执行基准这点有用；但先只看任务构成与评分rubric，没看到强基线前别过度解读排名。
recommendation.en: Useful as an executable long-horizon academic-workflow benchmark; skim the task taxonomy and scoring rubrics first, and don’t over-trust any leaderboard until strong baselines are shown.

paper.title: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, interactive settings where success depends on reusing experience accumulated over extended histories. However, existing agent memory systems are fundamentally constrained by text-context budgets: storing or revisiting raw trajectories is prohibitively token-expensive, while summarization and text-only retrieval trade token savings for information loss and fragmented evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Optical Context Retrie

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 记忆受文本上下文预算限制、摘要压缩又丢失细节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 设计上的一个非标准思路：把历史轨迹转成图像作为高密度记忆载体，再按需 OCR 回读。对做长上下文、外部记忆和多模态统一表示的人有一点启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OCR-Memory。核心做法是把历史交互轨迹渲染成带唯一视觉锚点的图像，检索时先 locate 再 transcribe：先通过视觉锚点定位相关区域，再把局部内容转写回文本供 agent 使用。它试图用视觉存储替代纯文本缓存，在 retrieval 时只回收必要片段，降低 prompt token 开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调适用于 long-horizon interactive agent 场景，并与原始轨迹存储、摘要记忆、文本检索记忆进行比较，主打更低 token 成本和更完整证据保留。摘要未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模和量化提升，因此更像系统想法而非已被充分验证的通用结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、筑波大学、延世大学等机构；从摘要看更偏 agent memory 系统设计，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory bottleneck of long-horizon LLM agents, where storing raw text trajectories is too expensive and summarization loses detail.
summary_en.importance: This is an unusual agent-memory design: encode past trajectories as images and recover relevant content through OCR-style retrieval. It is mildly interesting for people thinking about external memory and multimodal representations, but it is not close to core pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: OCR-Memory renders historical trajectories into images annotated with unique visual identifiers. At retrieval time, it follows a locate-and-transcribe pipeline: first find relevant regions via visual anchors, then transcribe only the needed local content back into text for the agent. The goal is to replace text-heavy storage with a denser visual memory substrate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for long-horizon interactive agents and implies comparisons against raw trajectory storage, summarization-based memory, and text-only retrieval. The claimed benefits are lower prompt-token overhead and better evidence preservation. However, the abstract gives no benchmark names, model sizes, or quantitative gains, so the result currently reads more like a systems idea than a settled general finding.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Hong Kong, the University of Tsukuba, Yonsei University, and others. From the abstract, the work is primarily an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model training paper.

recommendation.zh: 想法有趣但更像系统 hack：把 token 预算转成视觉带宽；只看方法图和成本分析，若缺少强 benchmark，别把它当通用记忆范式。
recommendation.en: Interesting, but mostly a systems hack that trades token budget for visual bandwidth; read the method figure and cost analysis, and do not treat it as a general memory paradigm without strong benchmarks.

paper.title: MemEvoBench: Benchmarking Memory MisEvolution in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with persistent memory enhances interaction continuity and personalization but introduces new safety risks. Specifically, contaminated or biased memory accumulation can trigger abnormal agent behaviors. Existing evaluation methods have not yet established a standardized framework for measuring memory misevolution. This phenomenon refers to the gradual behavioral drift resulting from repeated exposure to misleading information. To address this gap, we introd

summary.core_problem: 论文要评测带持久记忆的 LLM Agent 在长期交互中如何因误导信息、噪声工具输出和偏置反馈而发生 memory misevolution，即记忆驱动的行为漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark：把长期记忆安全从单轮越狱或短程工具错误，扩展到多轮记忆污染与行为演化评测。对做 Agent memory 的人有用，但对基座预训练研究是外围信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemEvoBench，覆盖 7 个领域、36 类风险的 QA-style 任务，并把 20 个 Agent-SafetyBench 环境改造成含噪工具返回的 workflow-style 任务。核心设计是混合 benign 与 misleading memory pool，在多轮交互中观察记忆累积如何改变后续行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在代表性模型上进行了评测，但未给出具体模型名单、规模和量化结果。就定位看，这是安全 benchmark，不是方法论文，也不直接回答如何在预训练阶段缓解该问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks how LLM agents with persistent memory undergo memory misevolution—behavioral drift caused by misleading information, noisy tool outputs, and biased feedback over long interactions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark: it extends agent safety evaluation from single-turn jailbreaks or short-horizon tool errors to multi-turn memory contamination and behavioral drift. Useful for agent-memory work, but peripheral to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces MemEvoBench, with QA-style tasks spanning 7 domains and 36 risk types, plus workflow-style tasks adapted from 20 Agent-SafetyBench environments with noisy tool returns. The key design is mixing benign and misleading memory pools across multi-round interactions to simulate memory evolution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says representative models are evaluated, but does not provide model names, scales, or quantitative results. This is a safety benchmark rather than a method paper, and it does not directly answer how to mitigate the issue at pretraining time.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory safety，可收下 benchmark 设计；否则知道有“记忆误演化”这个 failure mode 就够了，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory safety, keep the benchmark design; otherwise, it is enough to know that 'memory misevolution' is a real failure mode without reading the full paper.

paper.title: POINTS-Seeker: Towards Training a Multimodal Agentic Search Model from Scratch

summary.core_problem: 核心问题：现有多模态搜索/浏览类Agent大多是在通用LMM上“后挂工具+SFT/RL”得到的，导致agentic行为更像表层技能而非内生能力；同时长链路交互会引发上下文膨胀与“attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle”，即使证据已在历史中也难以被模型稳定定位与利用。论文试图回答：能否在“从零训练”的路线中，把搜索式自主探究（ReAct式规划-行动-观察-整合）作为模型形成期的核心能力注入，并在不牺牲证据保真度的前提下解决长时序交互的上下文瓶颈？
summary.importance:
对预训练/持续学习研究的启发主要在两点：
(1) 训练阶段划分的新范式：提出介于通用预训练与任务后训练之间的“Agentic Seeding”阶段，把长轨迹、工具交互、规划推理当作“形成期课程”而非下游技能灌输，属于对预训练课程设计/能力成因的直接探索。
(2) 长上下文与记忆的另类路径：V-Fold用“视觉空间承载历史”替代纯文本压缩/截断，实质是把上下文容量问题转化为多模态表征与对齐问题；这对长上下文建模、记忆外化、以及多模态token预算分配有方法论价值。
但从基座预训练角度，它更偏“多模态agent后训练/课程学习+上下文压缩机制”，不是纯粹的新语言建模目标或scaling law工作；价值在于训练配方与长程交互数据如何塑形能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两条主线构成：Agentic Seeding（能力注入）与V-Fold（长程交互抗退化）。
1) Agentic Seeding：作者明确反对仅在成熟LMM上做工具调用SFT/RL的“外挂式”路线，主张在预训练之后、SFT/RL之前插入一个专门阶段，密集喂入长视野推理与ReAct轨迹，使模型在表征层面内化“提出子问题→检索/浏览→读证据→再规划→综合回答”的交互模式。其关键点是数据形态从静态QA/描述转为多步trajectory（含action、observation、history），让模型学习在历史中维护状态、在不确定性下继续探索。
2) 轨迹增强VQA数据：论文在方法章节中定义了交互形式（action/observation/history），并构建“trajectory-augmented VQA”以支撑SFT/RL训练：模型在每步决定调用何种工具或直接回答，工具返回网页URL/标题/片段等观测，历史不断累积。
3) SFT与RL管线：在轨迹数据上进行监督学习以对齐工具协议与多步推理格式，并进一步用RL强化长链路成功率（文中强调其目标是鲁棒自主搜索而非仅格式正确）。
4) V-Fold：针对长链路导致的注意力稀释，提出自适应“折叠”机制：保留最近窗口的交互为高精度文本；将更早的历史通过渲染（rendering）折叠进视觉模态，让模型“看见”历史证据而不是把它们作为大量文本token继续占用上下文。直觉上，这是用VLM的视觉-语言对齐能力来承载压缩后的历史，避免文本侧token冗余导致的检索失败。训练上声称非常省：只需在SFT中加入约5k条渲染轨迹即可让模型学会在部署时使用该折叠策略。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的实验结论与设置要点：
- 模型：POINTS-Seeker-8B。
- 评测：6个基准（MMSearch、MMSearch-Plus、FVQA、SimpleVQA、LiveVQA、BrowseComp-VL）。
- 结论：在上述基准上“持续SOTA”，并显著超过依赖post-hoc fine-tuning的既有多模态搜索agent。
- 关键现象与验证：论文强调长链路交互的性能瓶颈来自attention dilution（类Lost-in-the-Middle），V-Fold用于缓解；并声称仅用约5k渲染轨迹即可学到折叠能力。
注意：你提供的全文内容在实验数值（各benchmark具体分数、提升幅度、RL细节、消融表格）处被截断，无法从当前文本中可靠抽取“具体数字提升/数据规模/训练步数”等硬指标；若补充论文实验章节与表格，可进一步给出逐项对比与消融结论（例如：仅Agentic Seeding vs 仅V-Fold vs 两者结合；不同折叠阈值/窗口大小；不同工具集合；长轨迹长度分桶性能等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟抓主线）：
1) Introduction：重点看作者对“从零训练agentic search”与“post-hoc工具微调”的差异化论证，以及Figure 3(b)关于attention dilution/Lost-in-the-Middle的失败案例。
2) Method 3.2（Agentic Seeding）：关注它在训练阶段划分上的定位（pretrain之后、SFT/RL之前）以及轨迹数据的组织形式（action/observation/history），这部分对“课程学习如何塑形agent能力”最关键。
3) Method 3.6（V-Fold）：重点理解“滑窗保留文本 + 历史渲染进视觉”的双通道表示，以及为何只需少量渲染轨迹就能泛化到部署。
4) Experiments（若你补全全文）：优先找(1)长链路长度分桶曲线/随turn增长的退化图；(2) V-Fold消融与不同压缩策略对比（截断/摘要/检索式记忆 vs V-Fold）；(3) Agentic Seeding是否带来更少的无效工具调用、更高的证据命中率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two coupled failures in multimodal web-search agents: (i) today’s agents are mostly “general LMM + tool-use post-training”, making agentic behavior a thin task layer rather than an intrinsic capability; (ii) long-horizon interactions inflate context and cause attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle, where the model misses already-present evidence in the history. The central question is whether we can build a natively agentic multimodal search model “from scratch” by injecting ReAct-style long trajectories during the model’s formative stage, and how to preserve evidence fidelity under long interaction histories without naive truncation/summarization.
summary_en.importance:
For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the contribution is mainly methodological rather than a new LM objective: 
1) A training-stage reframing (“Agentic Seeding”) that sits between pretraining and downstream SFT/RL, treating long-horizon tool-interaction trajectories as a core curriculum to shape representations—useful for thinking about capability formation and continual/curriculum learning.
2) A long-context mitigation route that offloads stale textual history into the visual channel (V-Fold), effectively turning context-length pressure into a multimodal representation/allocation problem. This is relevant to memory externalization and token-budget design in multimodal LMs.
Overall it’s more agentic multimodal training + context management than classic scaling-law/tokenizer work, but it offers concrete ideas on how data form (trajectories) and representation (visualized history) can unlock robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two main components:
1) Agentic Seeding: instead of teaching tool use post-hoc, the authors introduce a dedicated stage after pretraining that densely trains on long-horizon reasoning and ReAct-like trajectories (plan→act/tool-call→observe→update→answer). The model learns to maintain state over an interaction history defined by (query, actions, observations, …), internalizing autonomous inquiry patterns as part of its core behavior.
2) Trajectory-augmented VQA data + SFT/RL pipeline: they formalize actions (tool invocation or final answer), observations (URLs/titles/snippets returned by tools), and interaction history, then perform SFT to learn protocols and multi-step reasoning formats, followed by RL to improve long-horizon success.
3) V-Fold: an adaptive history folding mechanism to combat attention dilution. Recent turns remain as high-fidelity text in a sliding window; older history is rendered into the visual modality so the model can still “see” raw evidence via vision-language alignment without paying large text-token costs. Training is claimed to be lightweight: ~5k rendered trajectories added during SFT are sufficient for the model to generalize the folding behavior at deployment.
summary_en.experiments:
What can be reliably extracted from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Model: POINTS-Seeker-8B.
- Benchmarks: MMSearch, MMSearch-Plus, FVQA, SimpleVQA, LiveVQA, BrowseComp-VL.
- Claims: consistent SOTA across all six, outperforming prior post-hoc tool-augmented agents; V-Fold addresses long-horizon degradation; only ~5k rendered trajectories are needed to learn folding.
However, the excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures with exact scores, dataset sizes, training budgets, or ablation numbers. With the full Experiments section, the most important details to extract would be: gains attributable to Agentic Seeding vs standard post-training, turn-length robustness curves, and comparisons against truncation/summarization baselines for long histories.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Intro: focus on the argument for “native agentic” training and the attention-dilution failure mode (the Lost-in-the-Middle analogy).
- Method §3.2: Agentic Seeding’s placement in the training recipe and the exact trajectory format (action/observation/history).
- Method §3.6: V-Fold’s dual representation (text window + rendered visual history) and the training-efficiency claim (~5k trajectories).
- Experiments (if available): prioritize long-horizon robustness plots, V-Fold ablations vs truncation/summarization, and evidence-grounding metrics (e.g., evidence hit rate, tool-call efficiency).

recommendation.zh: 建议看训练配方：把 agentic 行为前置成“Agentic Seeding”课程并用 V-Fold 外化历史，可能改变你对长轨迹能力应在何阶段注入的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim for the recipe: an explicit “Agentic Seeding” stage plus V-Fold history externalization may shift your prior on when long-horizon/tool-use behavior should be injected during training.

paper.title: HINTBench: Horizon-agent Intrinsic Non-attack Trajectory Benchmark

summary.core_problem: 在“无外部攻击/无污染工具/无对抗环境”的良性条件下，长时序LLM Agent仍可能因自身内在失误进入高后果风险轨迹；论文要解决的是：如何系统化定义并评测这种“intrinsic risk”，并把评测从轨迹级二分类推进到风险步骤定位与失误类型诊断。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“面向Agent的后训练/对齐数据与评测”有启发：它把风险从结果判定扩展到过程审计（trajectory auditing），并提供细粒度监督（risk-step + taxonomy），可用于训练更强的安全审计器/过程监督模型。对基座研究的间接价值在于：为长上下文过程建模、步骤级信用分配（credit assignment）、以及“安全相关错误模式”的数据构造提供了可操作的标注框架。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是提出评测设定与数据集而非新训练算法。论文形式化了轨迹τ=(s_t,a_t,o_t)的审计输出：轨迹级风险标签y∈{0,1}，以及带类型的风险元组集合R_τ（用于步骤定位与类型识别）。关键创新是统一的“五约束”分类法（Goal/Factual/Capability/Procedural/State），对应Agent每步决策必须满足的五个维度：目标是否偏离、事实是否错误、能力边界是否被误判、流程是否违规、状态更新/记忆是否出错；并在此之上进一步细分为更细粒度的风险模式（文中提到粗粒度5类、细粒度11种模式）。数据集HINTBench包含629条完整执行轨迹（523 risky/106 safe），平均33步，显著长于既有轨迹安全基准（文中对比ATBench 8.9步、R-Judge 5.4步）。评测任务分三层：风险检测→粗粒度风险步定位→细粒度风险步定位+失误诊断；并对通用LLM审计与专用guard模型迁移能力做系统对比。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见的关键结论是“轨迹级检测”与“步骤级审计”存在显著能力鸿沟：强LLM在判断整条轨迹是否含风险相对更可行，但在risk-step localization与细粒度failure diagnosis上仍明显困难；同时现有guard模型对该“非攻击、内生风险”分布迁移较差。论文在引言中给出数据规模与长度统计（629条、平均33步、risky占比高），并强调Q：长时序导致风险起点与后果显现之间存在延迟，使定位与归因更难。由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数值（如各模型F1/Acc、各任务指标、各象限/类别混淆矩阵），此处无法可靠复述具体分数；建议以论文实验章节的主表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议（约20–30分钟）：1）Introduction：把握“intrinsic vs extrinsic risk”的定义边界与为何长时序使风险潜伏传播；2）Methodology：看审计输出形式（轨迹级+步骤级typed tuples）与三类任务定义；3）Taxonomy相关表格/图（文中提到Table/Figure组织五约束与11模式）：这是数据可复用的核心；4）Experiments主表：重点看LLM vs guard在“检测→定位→诊断”三层任务上的性能落差与错误类型分布。若你关心预训练/持续学习，可额外思考：该taxonomy能否转化为过程监督信号（step-level reward/penalty）或用于合成“安全过程数据”。

summary_en.core_problem: Even under benign conditions (no prompt injection, no poisoned tools, no adversarial environment), long-horizon LLM agents can drift into high-stakes unsafe trajectories due to intrinsic failures. The paper targets how to define and benchmark such intrinsic risk, moving beyond trajectory-level labels to step-level risk localization and failure-type diagnosis.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining algorithms, but meaningful for post-training/alignment and data-centric safety research: it reframes safety evaluation as process auditing over long trajectories and provides fine-grained supervision (risky steps + typed failure taxonomy). For foundation-model researchers, the main value is a reusable annotation schema for long-context process modeling, step-level credit assignment, and constructing training data for safety auditors or process-supervised models.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is primarily a benchmark/taxonomy contribution rather than a new training method. The auditor is defined to output (i) a trajectory-level risk label and (ii) a set of typed risk tuples for step localization and diagnosis. The key design is a unified five-constraint taxonomy—Goal, Factual, Capability, Procedural, and State constraints—intended to cover what an agent must satisfy at each step (objective alignment, truthfulness, capability awareness, correct procedure, and state/updates). The benchmark, HINTBench, contains 629 full agent trajectories (523 risky, 106 safe) with an average length of 33 steps, explicitly longer than prior trajectory safety benchmarks cited in the paper. It supports three tasks: risk detection, coarse-grained risk-step localization (5 categories), and fine-grained localization/diagnosis (11 patterns). The paper evaluates both general-purpose LLMs as auditors and specialized guard models, focusing on transfer to intrinsic-risk settings.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical takeaway is a large gap between trajectory-level detection and step-level auditing: even strong LLMs struggle with risk-step localization and fine-grained failure diagnosis, and existing guard models transfer poorly to this non-attack intrinsic-risk distribution. From the provided full-text excerpt we can reliably cite dataset statistics (629 trajectories, 33 steps avg; comparisons to ATBench/R-Judge on length), but not the exact metric values (e.g., F1/accuracy per model/task) because the experimental tables are not included in the excerpt; refer to the paper’s main results tables for precise numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (20–30 min): (1) Introduction for the intrinsic-vs-extrinsic framing and the “latent risk propagation” argument in long horizons; (2) Methodology for the formal task definitions and the typed risk tuple output; (3) the taxonomy table/figure (5 constraints + 11 patterns), which is the most reusable artifact; (4) the main experiment tables contrasting LLM auditors vs guard models across detection vs localization vs diagnosis. If your focus is pretraining/continual learning, consider how the taxonomy could be converted into step-level supervision signals or used for synthetic data generation.

recommendation.zh: 把风险评测从“结果”拉到“过程审计+风险步定位”这点可直接用来做对齐数据；只需看 taxonomy 与标注协议，别指望预训练层面结论。
recommendation.en: Its value is shifting safety eval from outcomes to trajectory auditing with risk-step localization—actionable for alignment data; skim the taxonomy/annotation protocol, not for pretraining claims.

paper.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization

summary.core_problem: 如何提升基于多模态大模型(MLLM)的GUI自动化在长时序/长地平线任务中的稳定性与可控性，缓解记忆退化、进度混乱与数值/算术幻觉。
summary.importance: 提出“执行agent + 轻量copilot工具”的协作范式与对应的策略优化方法（TIPO），属于较通用的tool-use与长地平线训练框架探索；对后训练阶段如何学会选择性调用工具、以及记忆/计算能力模块化有启发。
summary.technical_approach: UI-Copilot框架：主GUI agent负责操作执行；轻量copilot按需提供两类能力（Retriever用于记忆检索、Calculator用于数值计算）。关键设计包括memory decoupling（持久观测与瞬时执行上下文分离）以及Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO)：将工具选择学习（单轮预测）与任务执行学习（on-policy多轮rollout）分开优化，以提升工具调用的可学性与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体benchmark名称/规模与量化结果细节，仅描述针对长地平线GUI场景的改进；缺少模型参数量、训练数据/轨迹规模、与强基线（如纯ReAct/纯toolformer式调用/现有GUI agent训练法）的明确对比幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Improving long-horizon MLLM-based GUI automation by mitigating memory degradation, progress confusion, and numerical/math hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a collaborative agent+copilot tool-use paradigm and a dedicated policy-optimization recipe (TIPO). It is a fairly general contribution to tool invocation learning and long-horizon agent training, offering insights for post-training and modular capability design.
summary_en.technical_approach: UI-Copilot: a GUI policy agent executes actions while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance as a Retriever (memory) or Calculator (numerics). Uses memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context. Proposes Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO): optimize tool selection via single-turn prediction and task execution via on-policy multi-turn rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmark names, model/data scale, or numeric gains; it only claims improvements on long-horizon GUI scenarios. Strong-baseline comparisons are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 关注它如何把长地平线稳定性拆成“主策略+轻量工具copilot”并做策略优化；对后训练配方有用，但结论强度取决于任务/工具设定是否干净。
recommendation.en: Look at the decomposition into a main policy plus a lightweight tool-copilot with policy optimization; useful for post-training recipes, but strength depends on how clean the task/tool setup is.

paper.title: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents

summary.core_problem: 解决 Web agent 长时程任务中“技能表示不落地/不可恢复”的问题：纯文本技能不可执行、纯代码技能不可解释，导致难以错误恢复与自适应。
summary.importance: 属于通用 Web agent 方法：提出“可执行程序 + 步级自然语言解释”的技能形态，并配套技能抽取/组织/部署流程；对 agent 记忆与可组合技能库有启发，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: WebXSkill 三阶段：①从（合成的）agent 轨迹中挖掘可复用动作子序列并抽象为参数化 action program，同时为每步配套自然语言指导；②用基于 URL 的图结构索引技能以便情境检索；③部署时支持直接执行与 agent 基于步级语义进行改写/恢复（两种模式）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称与量化结果细节；描述目标是提升长地平线网页任务成功率与可恢复性，并通过技能检索与可执行技能调用实现。

summary_en.core_problem: Address the grounding gap in long-horizon web agents: textual skills are not executable, while code skills are executable but opaque, hurting recovery and adaptation.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution for general web agents: an executable skill representation paired with step-level natural-language guidance, plus extraction/organization/deployment. Indirectly relevant to foundation pretraining via agent memory/compositionality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage WebXSkill: (1) mine reusable action subsequences from synthetic agent trajectories and abstract them into parameterized action programs with step-level NL guidance; (2) organize/index skills in a URL-based graph for context-aware retrieval; (3) deploy skills for direct execution and agent-driven adaptation/recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks or numeric gains; claims improvements on long-horizon web workflows via skill retrieval and executable skill invocation.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道“可执行程序+逐步解释”这类技能封装：只看技能抽取与恢复机制那节，能启发你做可调试的 web 任务记忆库。
recommendation.en: Worth noting the “executable program + stepwise rationale” skill packaging: read the extraction + recovery section to inform debuggable web-skill memory.
